import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Resultant.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Prod
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

/-! Actual bounded polynomials, endowed with their coefficient norm.
No polynomial, derivative or determinant identity is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev Coeff (n : ℕ) := Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n

instance coeffNormedAddCommGroup (n : ℕ) : NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff n) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)
    (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective

instance coeffNormedSpace (n : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff n) :=
  NormedSpace.induced ℝ _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)

/-- Retain exactly the coefficients of orders less than `n`. -/
def cut (n : ℕ) : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ i)

@[simp] theorem degreeLTEquiv_coeff {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) (i : Fin n) :
    degreeLTEquiv ℝ n p i = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

@[simp] theorem cut_coeff (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (i : Fin n) :
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = p.coeff i := by
  exact congrFun ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).apply_symm_apply (fun j : Fin n => p.coeff j)) i

@[simp] theorem cut_coe {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : cut n (p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  simp

/-- Coefficient truncation of the actual polynomial product, as a bilinear map. -/
def mulLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun p q => cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])))
    (by intros; simp [add_mul])
    (by intros; simp [smul_mul_assoc])
    (by intros; simp [mul_add])
    (by intros; simp [mul_smul_comm])

def mulCLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →L[ℝ] Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap :
      (Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r)).toLinearMap.comp
      (mulLM m n r))

@[simp] theorem mulCLM_apply {m n r : ℕ} (p : Coeff m) (q : Coeff n) :
    mulCLM m n r p q = cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])) := rfl

/-- The linear inclusion of a polynomial of degree `< n` into degree `< n+1`. -/
def liftLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+1)).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype

def liftCLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (liftLM n)

lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_bound {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) {k : ℕ} (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).coeff k = 0 := by
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    ((Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))

@[simp] theorem coe_lift {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (liftCLM n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  by_cases hk : k < n+1
  · exact cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,hk⟩
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

def topMonomial (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  ⟨X^n, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)⟩

def monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  topMonomial n + liftCLM n p

@[simp] theorem coe_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]) = X^n + (p : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [monicPoly, topMonomial]

lemma bounded_natDegree {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)

/-- The affine monic-coordinate map has the actual Frechet derivative equal
    to its coefficient inclusion, including the degree-zero case. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicPoly (liftCLM n) p := by
  exact (liftCLM n).hasFDerivAt.const_add (topMonomial n)

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/BlockJacobian.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree
open Module

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- The derivative block occurring in polynomial numerator/denominator gluing. -/
def repeatedBlock (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E) +
      L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E))

@[simp] theorem repeatedBlock_apply (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    repeatedBlock L C x = (L x.1, C x.1 + L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF) (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, repeatedBlock]

/-- An exact determinant theorem: no nonsingularity assumptions on either block. -/
theorem det_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [toMatrix_repeatedBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, pow_two]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/Triangular.lean:
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual triangular linear maps, with fully specified coefficient bases. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def lowerBlock (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (E × F) →L[ℝ] (E × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F) + M.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F))

@[simp] lemma lowerBlock_apply (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (M : F →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × F) :
    lowerBlock L C M x = (L x.1, C x.1 + M x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap) (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, lowerBlock]

theorem det_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap).det *
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_lowerBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Triangular
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Determinant

/-! Basis-independent determinant calculus for the actual finite-dimensional
Fréchet derivative. Used after explicit coefficient permutation equivalences. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- Determinant of the actual derivative of an endomorphism. -/
def endJacobian (f : E → E) (x : E) : ℝ := LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap

lemma endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt {f : E → E} {L : E →L[ℝ] E} {x : E}
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f L x) : endJacobian f x = LinearMap.det L.toLinearMap := by
  rw [endJacobian, hf.fderiv]

theorem endJacobian_comp {f g : E → E} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g x)) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    endJacobian (f ∘ g) x = endJacobian f (g x) * endJacobian g x := by
  rw [endJacobian, (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x hg.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
  exact LinearMap.det_comp _ _

/-- Conjugation transports coordinates without changing the derivative determinant. -/
theorem endJacobian_conjugate (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (f : E → E) (x : F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (e.symm x)) :
    endJacobian (fun z => e (f (e.symm z))) x = endJacobian f (e.symm x) := by
  have h := e.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt)
  have he : fderiv ℝ (fun z => e (f (e.symm z))) x =
      e.toContinuousLinearMap.comp ((fderiv ℝ f (e.symm x)).comp e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, he]
  change LinearMap.det (e.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.comp
    ((fderiv ℝ f (e.symm x)).toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap)) = _
  exact LinearMap.det_conj _ e.toLinearEquiv

/-- Triangular block determinant, independent of the choice of bases. -/
lemma endDet_lowerBlock [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.det (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.det L.toLinearMap * LinearMap.det M.toLinearMap := by
  simpa only [LinearMap.det_toMatrix] using
    det_lowerBlock (Module.finBasis ℝ E) (Module.finBasis ℝ F) L C M

/-- A map on the first factor and identity on the second factor. -/
def keepFunction (f : E → E) (z : E × F) : E × F := (f z.1,z.2)

lemma hasFDerivAt_keepFunction {f : E → E} (x : E × F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.1) :
    HasFDerivAt (keepFunction (F := F) f)
      ((fderiv ℝ f x.1).prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)) x := by
  exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt).prodMk
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt

lemma endJacobian_keepFunction [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (f : E → E) (x : E × F) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.1) :
    endJacobian (keepFunction (F := F) f) x = endJacobian f x.1 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction x hf)]
  change LinearMap.det (LinearMap.prodMap (fderiv ℝ f x.1).toLinearMap (LinearMap.id : F →ₗ[ℝ] F)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.det_prodMap, LinearMap.det_id, mul_one]
  rfl

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/LeadingCoefficients.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

/-! Leading-coefficient charts for the actual bounded polynomial spaces. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).Monic := by
  rw [coe_monicPoly]
  exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property)

@[simp] lemma monicPoly_coeff_top {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).coeff n = 1 := by
  simp [coe_monicPoly, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p le_rfl]

@[simp] lemma natDegree_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).natDegree = n := by
  apply le_antisymm (bounded_natDegree _)
  exact Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (by
    rw [monicPoly_coeff_top]
    exact one_ne_zero)

lemma cut_X_pow_of_le (n k : ℕ) (hnk : n ≤ k) : cut n (X^k) = 0 := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (X^k) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = 0
  rw [cut_coeff]
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, show (i : ℕ) ≠ k from by omega]

/-- Assemble a leading coefficient and all lower coefficients, without division. -/
def joinLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) where
  toFun x := x.1 • topMonomial n + liftCLM n x.2
  map_add' x y := by simp [add_smul]; abel
  map_smul' c x := by simp [smul_add, smul_smul]

@[simp] lemma coe_joinLeadingLM {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (joinLeadingLM n x : ℝ[X]) = x.1 • (X^n : ℝ[X]) + (x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [joinLeadingLM, topMonomial]

/-- Split a bounded polynomial into its leading coefficient and its truncation. -/
def splitLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →ₗ[ℝ] (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  ((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype).prod
    ((cut n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

@[simp] lemma splitLeadingLM_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    splitLeadingLM n p = ((p : ℝ[X]).coeff n, cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := rfl

lemma split_joinLeading {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    splitLeadingLM n (joinLeadingLM n x) = x := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2 le_rfl]
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl]

lemma join_splitLeading {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    joinLeadingLM n (splitLeadingLM n p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_joinLeadingLM]
  ext k
  simp only [splitLeadingLM_apply, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with h | h | h
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt h), mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,h⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, mul_one, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt h), mul_zero,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ h.le, zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

/-- The exact linear isomorphism between high-first and ordinary polynomial coefficients. -/
def leadingEquiv (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  { joinLeadingLM n with
    invFun := splitLeadingLM n
    left_inv := split_joinLeading
    right_inv := join_splitLeading }

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    leadingEquiv n x = joinLeadingLM n x := rfl

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (leadingEquiv n).symm p = splitLeadingLM n p := rfl

lemma monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    monicPoly p = leadingEquiv n (1,p) := by
  simp [monicPoly, leadingEquiv, joinLeadingLM]

/-- Leading degree first, then increasing lower degrees. -/
def leadingBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (Unit ⊕ Fin n) ℝ (Coeff (n+1)) :=
  ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).map (leadingEquiv n)

/-- Truncation is exact whenever the original polynomial already satisfies the bound. -/
lemma coe_cut_of_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n) :
    (cut n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  let q : Coeff n := ⟨p, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩
  exact congrArg (fun z : Coeff n => (z : ℝ[X])) (cut_coe q)

/-- Actual monic polynomials are recovered from their non-leading coefficients. -/
lemma monic_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = n) :
    (monicPoly (cut n p) : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  rw [coe_monicPoly, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with hk | hk | hk
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt hk), zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n p ⟨k,hk⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
    rw [← hd, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, hp]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hk), zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ hk.le,
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/Scaling.lean:
import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! The monic-numerator scaling factor, including zero scale and degree zero. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Generic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) : ℝ × E := (x.1, x.1 • x.2)

def scaleChartDerivative (x : ℝ × E) : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).prod
    (x.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight x.2)

/-- The actual derivative of multiplication of the lower coefficients by the scale. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) :
    HasFDerivAt scaleChart (scaleChartDerivative x) x := by
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.prodMk
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.smul
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt)

lemma toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 0
      (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Unit) => b.repr x.2 i) (x.1 • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

/-- An all-dimensional, all-scale determinant identity, not a generic-rank statement. -/
theorem det_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap).det =
      x.1 ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp [Matrix.det_smul]

end Generic

/-- Multiplication of an actual monic polynomial by its unrestricted scalar. -/
def scaleMonic {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) := x.1 • monicPoly x.2

lemma scaleMonic_eq_comp {n : ℕ} :
    scaleMonic (n := n) = (leadingEquiv n) ∘ scaleChart := by
  funext x
  rw [scaleMonic, monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv]
  symm
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, scaleChart, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
    (leadingEquiv n).map_smul x.1 (1,x.2)

def scaleMonicDerivative {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (ℝ × Coeff n) →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (scaleChartDerivative x)

theorem hasFDerivAt_scaleMonic {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt scaleMonic (scaleMonicDerivative x) x := by
  rw [scaleMonic_eq_comp]
  exact (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp
    x (hasFDerivAt_scaleChart x)

lemma toMatrix_comp_equiv {E F G : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module ℝ G]
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (e : F ≃ₗ[ℝ] G) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix bE (bF.map e) (e.toLinearMap.comp L) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Basis.map_repr]

/-- The Jacobian in the manuscript's leading-first numerator coefficient order. -/
def monicScalingJacobian {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n))
    (leadingBasis n) (fderiv ℝ scaleMonic x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The exact factor c^n for a monic polynomial of degree n. -/
theorem monicScalingJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    monicScalingJacobian x = x.1 ^ n := by
  rw [monicScalingJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_scaleMonic x).fderiv, leadingBasis]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _
    ((leadingEquiv n).toLinearMap.comp (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap)).det = _
  rw [toMatrix_comp_equiv, det_scaleChartDerivative]
  simp

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual polynomial coefficient gluing and its actual Frechet derivative. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PolyPair (m n : ℕ) := Coeff m × Coeff n
abbrev GlueInput (m n : ℕ) := PolyPair m n × PolyPair m n

def pairBasis (m n : ℕ) : Module.Basis (Fin (m+n)) ℝ (PolyPair m n) :=
  ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

lemma coeff_natDegree_le {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  simpa using bounded_natDegree (liftCLM n p)

def sylvCLM {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) :
    PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (sylvesterMap f g hf hg)

@[simp] theorem sylvCLM_cut {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X])
    (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) (x : PolyPair m n) :
    sylvCLM f g hf hg x = cut (m+n) (f * (x.2 : ℝ[X]) + g * (x.1 : ℝ[X])) := by
  exact (cut_coe (sylvesterMap f g hf hg x)).symm

def monoSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)
    (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _)

def lowSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM x.1 x.2 (coeff_natDegree_le _) (coeff_natDegree_le _)

/-- The non-leading coefficients of `U*V`, and all coefficients of `R*V+U*S`.
Here U and V are actual monic polynomials with the supplied low coefficients;
R and S have arbitrary coefficients of degrees below m and n. -/
def glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n) :=
  (mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2),
   mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n) x.2.1 (monicPoly x.1.2) +
     mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) x.2.2)

/-- The complete derivative, including the off-diagonal numerator terms. -/
def glueDerivative {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] (Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n)) :=
  repeatedBlock (monoSylv x.1) (lowSylv x.2)

set_option maxHeartbeats 600000 in
theorem hasFDerivAt_glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    HasFDerivAt glue (glueDerivative x) x := by
  let A : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let B : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let R : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let S : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  have ha := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (A x)).comp x A.hasFDerivAt
  have hb := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (B x)).comp x B.hasFDerivAt
  have hp := ((mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply hb
  have hr := ((mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x R.hasFDerivAt).clm_apply hb
  have hs := ((mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply S.hasFDerivAt
  apply (hp.prodMk (hr.add hs)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  all_goals
    simp only [glueDerivative, repeatedBlock_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
      Function.comp_apply, A, B, R, S,
      monoSylv, lowSylv, sylvCLM_cut,
      mulCLM_apply, coe_lift]
  · change cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X])) =
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X]))
    rw [map_add, mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
  · change (cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]))) +
      (cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]))) =
      cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])) +
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]))
    simp only [map_add]
    rw [mul_comm (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]), mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
    abel

/-- The Jacobian of the actual real coefficient map, in specified coefficient bases. -/
def gluingJacobian {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((pairBasis m n).prod (pairBasis m n))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)))
    (fderiv ℝ glue x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The two-polynomial gluing formula for every degree, every numerator and
all coefficients. Common roots and zero resultant are included. -/
theorem gluingJacobian_eq_resultant_sq {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    gluingJacobian x =
      Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2) m n ^ 2 := by
  rw [gluingJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_glue x).fderiv]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ (repeatedBlock _ _).toLinearMap).det = _
  rw [det_repeatedBlock]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (sylvesterMap (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2)
      (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _))).det ^ 2 = _
  rw [pairBasis, Polynomial.toMatrix_sylvesterMap']
  rfl

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Gluing
import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients

/-! Multiplication of actual monic coefficient vectors. This supplies the
one-copy Sylvester derivative needed in the arbitrary-child induction. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def monicMultiply {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : Coeff (m+n) :=
  mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n) (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)

lemma monicMultiply_eq_cut {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    monicMultiply x = cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.2 : ℝ[X])) := rfl

theorem hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicMultiply (monoSylv x) x := by
  let ins : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] GlueInput m n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (PolyPair m n)).prod 0
  have h := ((hasFDerivAt_glue (ins x)).comp x ins.hasFDerivAt).fst
  apply h.congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  rfl

def monicMultiplyJacobian {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (fderiv ℝ monicMultiply x).toLinearMap).det

theorem monicMultiplyJacobian_eq {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    monicMultiplyJacobian x =
      Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2) m n := by
  rw [monicMultiplyJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply x).fderiv]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (sylvesterMap (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)
      (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _))).det = _
  rw [pairBasis, Polynomial.toMatrix_sylvesterMap']
  rfl

theorem monicMultiply_reconstruct {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    (monicPoly (monicMultiply x) : ℝ[X]) =
      (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  rw [monicMultiply_eq_cut]
  apply monic_reconstruct
  · exact (monic_monicPoly x.1).mul (monic_monicPoly x.2)
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul (monic_monicPoly x.1).ne_zero (monic_monicPoly x.2).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicPoly, natDegree_monicPoly]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.ProductDerivative

/-! Basis-aware determinant composition for growing coefficient families. -/
open Matrix Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Linear
variable {E₀ E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E₀] [NormedSpace ℝ E₀]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def keepLeft (L : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E₀ × E) →L[ℝ] (E₀ × F) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E₀ E).prod (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E₀ E))

@[simp] lemma keepLeft_apply (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E₀ × E) :
    keepLeft L x = (x.1, L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_keepLeft {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (b₀ : Basis ι ℝ E₀) (bE : Basis κ ℝ E)
    (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (b₀.prod bE) (b₀.prod bF) (keepLeft L).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) 0 0 (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, keepLeft, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

lemma det_keepLeft {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (b₀ : Basis ι ℝ E₀) (bE : Basis κ ℝ E)
    (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b₀.prod bE) (b₀.prod bF) (keepLeft L).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_keepLeft, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp

lemma toMatrix_both_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.reindex e) (bF.reindex e) L =
      Matrix.reindex e e (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L) := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Matrix.reindex_apply]

lemma det_both_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.reindex e) (bF.reindex e) L).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_both_reindex, Matrix.det_reindex_self]

end Linear
end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.JacobianComposition

/-! Actual multiplication of arbitrarily many monic factors and its full
Fréchet Jacobian, with every degree and coefficient value allowed. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def ProductInput : List ℕ → Type
  | [] => Coeff 0
  | m :: ms => Coeff m × ProductInput ms

instance productInputNormed : (ms : List ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by
    letI := productInputNormed ms
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff m × ProductInput ms))

instance productInputNormedSpace : (ms : List ℕ) → NormedSpace ℝ (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by
    letI := productInputNormedSpace ms
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff m × ProductInput ms))

def familyBasis : (ms : List ℕ) → Basis (Fin ms.sum) ℝ (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => degreeLT.basis ℝ 0
  | m :: ms => ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

/-- Low coefficients of the true product of all monic input polynomials. -/
def familyProduct : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → Coeff ms.sum
  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x => monicMultiply (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)

def familyProductDerivative : (ms : List ℕ) → (x : ProductInput ms) →
    ProductInput ms →L[ℝ] Coeff ms.sum
  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x =>
    (monoSylv (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)).comp
      (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2))

theorem hasFDerivAt_familyProduct (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    HasFDerivAt (familyProduct ms) (familyProductDerivative ms x) x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact hasFDerivAt_const (0 : Coeff 0) x
  | cons m ms ih =>
    have hfst := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
    have hsnd := (ih x.2).comp x
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt
    exact (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).comp x (hfst.prodMk hsnd)

/-- All individual factors as actual polynomials, retaining possible repetitions. -/
def familyPolynomials : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → List ℝ[X]
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: ms, x => (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) :: familyPolynomials ms x.2

theorem familyProduct_reconstruct (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x) : ℝ[X]) = (familyPolynomials ms x).prod := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (monicPoly (0 : Coeff 0) : ℝ[X]) = 1
    simp [coe_monicPoly]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (monicPoly (monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)) : ℝ[X]) = _
    rw [monicMultiply_reconstruct, ih]
    rfl

/-- Resultant product in recursive factor-versus-remaining-product form. -/
def familyResultant : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ℝ
  | [], _ => 1
  | m :: ms, x =>
    Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x.2)) m ms.sum *
      familyResultant ms x.2

lemma det_monoSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
      (monoSylv x).toLinearMap).det =
        Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2) m n := by
  simpa only [monicMultiplyJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply x).fderiv] using
    monicMultiplyJacobian_eq x

theorem det_familyProductDerivative (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
      (familyProductDerivative ms x).toLinearMap).det = familyResultant ms x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0) (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0)
      (0 : Coeff 0 →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff 0)).det = 1
    simp
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum))
      ((monoSylv (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).toLinearMap.comp
        (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2)).toLinearMap)).det =
      _ * familyResultant ms x.2
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp
      (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv) (pairBasis m ms.sum)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum)), Matrix.det_mul, det_monoSylv]
    congr 1
    rw [pairBasis, det_both_reindex, det_keepLeft, ih]

/-- The determinant is taken from fderiv of the actual coefficient map. -/
def familyProductJacobian (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
    (fderiv ℝ (familyProduct ms) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem familyProductJacobian_eq (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = familyResultant ms x := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x).fderiv,
    det_familyProductDerivative]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.EndJacobian
import HydrologyTree.Scaling
import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct

/-! Actual simultaneous scaling of every child numerator, including all zero
scales. This is one component of the full branching-tree Jacobian chain. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

instance productInputFiniteDimensional (ms : List ℕ) : FiniteDimensional ℝ (ProductInput ms) :=
  Module.Finite.of_basis (familyBasis ms)

section Products
variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def productEndMap (f : E → E) (g : F → F) (z : E × F) : E × F := (f z.1,g z.2)

lemma hasFDerivAt_productEndMap (f : E → E) (g : F → F) (z : E × F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z.2) :
    HasFDerivAt (productEndMap f g)
      ((fderiv ℝ f z.1).prodMap (fderiv ℝ g z.2)) z := by
  exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp z (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt).prodMk
    (hg.hasFDerivAt.comp z (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt)

lemma endJacobian_productEndMap [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (f : E → E) (g : F → F) (z : E × F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z.2) :
    endJacobian (productEndMap f g) z = endJacobian f z.1 * endJacobian g z.2 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap f g z hf hg)]
  exact LinearMap.det_prodMap _ _

end Products

/-- Interpret the leading coefficient as an independent scale, and lower
coefficients as those of a monic polynomial, then carry out actual multiplication. -/
def scaleLeading (n : ℕ) (q : Coeff (n+1)) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  leadingEquiv n (scaleChart ((leadingEquiv n).symm q))

lemma scaleLeading_actual (n : ℕ) (q : Coeff (n+1)) :
    scaleLeading n q = (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n • monicPoly (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  have h := congrFun (scaleMonic_eq_comp (n := n)) ((leadingEquiv n).symm q)
  exact h.symm

lemma differentiable_scaleLeading (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (scaleLeading n) := by
  intro q
  exact (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp q
    ((hasFDerivAt_scaleChart ((leadingEquiv n).symm q)).differentiableAt.comp q
      (leadingEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

lemma endJacobian_scaleChart (n : ℕ) (q : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    endJacobian scaleChart q = q.1 ^ n := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_scaleChart q),
    ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)),
    det_scaleChartDerivative]
  simp

/-- The actual scaling determinant is proved with no division by the scale. -/
theorem endJacobian_scaleLeading (n : ℕ) (q : Coeff (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (scaleLeading n) q = (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n ^ n := by
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    scaleChart q (hasFDerivAt_scaleChart _).differentiableAt
  rw [endJacobian_scaleChart] at h
  exact h

/-- A child with n internal edges has a cofactor of degree n and denominator
of degree n+1. This list transformation reflects those actual dimensions. -/
abbrev ChildFactorDegrees (ms : List ℕ) := ms.map (fun n => n+1)
abbrev ScaledFamilyInput (ms : List ℕ) := ProductInput (ChildFactorDegrees ms)

def scaleFamily : (ms : List ℕ) → ScaledFamilyInput ms → ScaledFamilyInput ms
  | [], q => q
  | m :: ms, q => (scaleLeading m q.1, scaleFamily ms q.2)

def scaleFamilyWeight : (ms : List ℕ) → ScaledFamilyInput ms → ℝ
  | [], _ => 1
  | m :: ms, q => (q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff m ^ m * scaleFamilyWeight ms q.2

lemma differentiable_scaleFamily (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (scaleFamily ms) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact differentiable_id
  | cons m ms ih =>
    intro q
    exact (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap (scaleLeading m) (scaleFamily ms) q
      (differentiable_scaleLeading m q.1) (ih q.2)).differentiableAt

/-- Exact product of all monic numerator-scaling factors at an arbitrary root. -/
theorem endJacobian_scaleFamily (ms : List ℕ) (q : ScaledFamilyInput ms) :
    endJacobian (scaleFamily ms) q = scaleFamilyWeight ms q := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => change endJacobian id q = 1; simp [endJacobian]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change endJacobian (productEndMap (scaleLeading m) (scaleFamily ms)) q = _
    rw [endJacobian_productEndMap _ _ _ (differentiable_scaleLeading m q.1)
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms q.2), endJacobian_scaleLeading, ih]
    rfl

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilyResultants.lean:
import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct

/-! Exact pairwise resultant expansion of the arbitrary-family product Jacobian. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- One factor for every ordered-by-position pair i<j, repetitions allowed. -/
def pairwiseResultants : List ℝ[X] → ℝ
  | [] => 1
  | p :: ps => (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants ps

lemma familyPolynomials_degree_sum (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ((familyPolynomials ms x).map Polynomial.natDegree).sum = ms.sum := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih => simp only [familyPolynomials, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, natDegree_monicPoly, ih]

lemma familyPolynomials_monic (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ∀ p ∈ familyPolynomials ms x, p.Monic := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => simp [familyPolynomials]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    intro p hp
    simp only [familyPolynomials, List.mem_cons] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | hp
    · exact monic_monicPoly _
    · exact ih _ p hp

lemma monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) : ps.prod.Monic := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => exact Polynomial.monic_one
  | cons p ps ih =>
    exact (hs p (by simp)).mul (ih (fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])))

lemma natDegree_monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) :
    ps.prod.natDegree = (ps.map Polynomial.natDegree).sum := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hp := hs p (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic := fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])
    rw [List.prod_cons, Polynomial.natDegree_mul hp.ne_zero (monic_list_prod ps ht).ne_zero,
      ih ht]
    rfl

lemma resultant_list_prod (p : ℝ[X]) (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic) :
    p.resultant ps.prod = (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have hq := hs q (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ r ∈ qs, r.Monic := fun r hr => hs r (by simp [hr])
    rw [List.prod_cons,
      Polynomial.natDegree_mul hq.ne_zero (monic_list_prod qs ht).ne_zero,
      Polynomial.resultant_mul_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, ih ht]
    rfl

/-- The recursive derivative determinant is exactly the product over all pairs. -/
theorem familyResultant_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyResultant ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x.2)) m ms.sum *
        familyResultant ms x.2 = _
    rw [ih]
    change _ = ((familyPolynomials ms x.2).map fun q =>
      (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]).resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
    congr 1
    have h := resultant_list_prod (monicPoly x.1) (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
      (familyPolynomials_monic ms x.2)
    rw [← familyProduct_reconstruct] at h
    simpa only [natDegree_monicPoly] using h

/-- Full all-degree, all-coefficient product-Jacobian formula in pairwise form. -/
theorem familyProductJacobian_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian_eq, familyResultant_eq_pairwise]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Operations

/-! Smoothness of the actual monic factor product; differentiating its derivative
is justified rather than assumed as a hidden Hessian input. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma contDiff_monicPoly (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (monicPoly (n := n)) :=
  contDiff_const.add (liftCLM n).contDiff

lemma contDiff_monicMultiply (m n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (monicMultiply (m := m) (n := n)) := by
  have ha := (contDiff_monicPoly m).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).contDiff
  have hb := (contDiff_monicPoly n).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).contDiff
  exact ((mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n)).contDiff.comp ha).clm_apply hb

/-- Every finite factor product has the differentiability needed by the tangent lift. -/
theorem contDiff_familyProduct (ms : List ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (familyProduct ms) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact contDiff_const
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms =>
      monicMultiply (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2))
    have ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms => x.1) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).contDiff
    have hb : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms => familyProduct ms x.2) :=
      ih.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).contDiff
    exact (contDiff_monicMultiply m ms.sum).comp (ha.prodMk hb)

lemma familyProductDerivative_eq_fderiv (ms : List ℕ) :
    familyProductDerivative ms = fderiv ℝ (familyProduct ms) := by
  funext x
  exact (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x).fderiv.symm

/-- The derivative-valued map is itself differentiable everywhere. -/
theorem differentiable_familyProductDerivative (ms : List ℕ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (familyProductDerivative ms) := by
  rw [familyProductDerivative_eq_fderiv]
  exact ((contDiff_familyProduct ms).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable_one

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/TangentJacobian.lean:
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp

/-! The Jacobian of a differentiable tangent lift has two copies of the
original Jacobian. Derivative-valued regularity is an explicit proved input
at each later application, not an unproved family Hessian assertion. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def tangentLift (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) : F × F :=
  (f x.1, L x.1 x.2)

def tangentDerivative (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  repeatedBlock (L x.1) ((fderiv ℝ L x.1).flip x.2)

/-- Full tangent-lift derivative, including the second-order off-diagonal block. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_tangentLift (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f (L x.1) x.1) (hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ L x.1) :
    HasFDerivAt (tangentLift f L) (tangentDerivative L x) x := by
  let P : (E × E) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E
  let Q : (E × E) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E
  have h1 := hf.comp x P.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 := (hL.hasFDerivAt.comp x P.hasFDerivAt).clm_apply Q.hasFDerivAt
  apply (h1.prodMk h2).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change L x.1 z.2 + (fderiv ℝ L x.1 z.1) x.2 =
      (fderiv ℝ L x.1 z.1) x.2 + L x.1 z.2
    exact add_comm _ _

/-- The determinant is the square without any invertibility assumption. -/
theorem tangentLift_jacobian {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f (L x.1) x.1) (hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ L x.1) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (fderiv ℝ (tangentLift f L) x).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF (L x.1).toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_tangentLift f L x hf hL).fderiv, tangentDerivative,
    det_repeatedBlock]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilyGluing.lean:
import HydrologyTree.FamilyResultants
import HydrologyTree.FamilySmoothness
import HydrologyTree.TangentJacobian

/-! The all-arity polynomial gluing theorem in actual coefficient spaces.
All derivatives, smoothness and polynomial identities are proved; there is no
coprimality, positivity or nonsingularity hypothesis. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Actual numerator sum, one numerator in place of each corresponding factor. -/
def familyNumerator : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ProductInput ms → ℝ[X]
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | _ :: ms, p, r =>
      (r.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly (familyProduct ms p.2) : ℝ[X]) +
      (monicPoly p.1 : ℝ[X]) * familyNumerator ms p.2 r.2

lemma monoSylv_polynomial {m n : ℕ} (p r : PolyPair m n) :
    (monoSylv p r : ℝ[X]) =
      (monicPoly p.1 : ℝ[X]) * (r.2 : ℝ[X]) +
      (monicPoly p.2 : ℝ[X]) * (r.1 : ℝ[X]) := rfl

/-- The derivative applied to the numerator data is exactly the full numerator
polynomial, not merely a sampled evaluation or a truncated approximation. -/
theorem familyProductDerivative_polynomial (ms : List ℕ)
    (p r : ProductInput ms) :
    (familyProductDerivative ms p r : ℝ[X]) = familyNumerator ms p r := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (monoSylv (p.1,familyProduct ms p.2)
      (r.1,familyProductDerivative ms p.2 r.2) : ℝ[X]) = _
    rw [monoSylv_polynomial, ih]
    dsimp only [familyNumerator]
    ring

/-- Arbitrarily many monic factors with their arbitrary strict-degree numerators. -/
def familyGlue (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    Coeff ms.sum × Coeff ms.sum :=
  (familyProduct ms x.1, cut ms.sum (familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2))

lemma familyGlue_eq_tangentLift (ms : List ℕ) :
    familyGlue ms = tangentLift (familyProduct ms) (familyProductDerivative ms) := by
  funext x
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change cut ms.sum (familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2) = familyProductDerivative ms x.1 x.2
    rw [← familyProductDerivative_polynomial, cut_coe]

/-- The full second output encodes the true numerator polynomial. -/
theorem familyGlue_numerator_exact (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    ((familyGlue ms x).2 : ℝ[X]) = familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2 := by
  rw [familyGlue_eq_tangentLift]
  exact familyProductDerivative_polynomial ms x.1 x.2

theorem hasFDerivAt_familyGlue (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    HasFDerivAt (familyGlue ms) (tangentDerivative (familyProductDerivative ms) x) x := by
  rw [familyGlue_eq_tangentLift]
  exact hasFDerivAt_tangentLift _ _ _ (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x.1)
    (differentiable_familyProductDerivative ms x.1)

def familyGlueJacobian (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((familyBasis ms).prod (familyBasis ms))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum))
    (fderiv ℝ (familyGlue ms) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The full gluing Jacobian, for every finite factor family and all coefficients,
is the square of the pairwise resultant product, including every singular case. -/
theorem familyGlueJacobian_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    familyGlueJacobian ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x.1)^2 := by
  rw [familyGlueJacobian, familyGlue_eq_tangentLift,
    tangentLift_jacobian _ _ _ _ _ (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x.1)
      (differentiable_familyProductDerivative ms x.1),
    det_familyProductDerivative, familyResultant_eq_pairwise]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/RootUpdate.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Scaling
import HydrologyTree.Triangular

/-! The actual coefficient transformation P=(X+d)F-N at a rooted compartment. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Generic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def rootChart (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) : E × (ℝ × E) :=
  (x.1, (x.2.1 + C x.1, D x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1 - x.2.2))

def rootFiber (f : E) : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).prod
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight f - ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E)

@[simp] lemma rootFiber_apply (f : E) (h : ℝ × E) :
    rootFiber f h = (h.1, h.1 • f - h.2) := rfl

def rootChartDerivative (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] (E × (ℝ × E)) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)
    (C.prod (D + x.2.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) (rootFiber x.1)

/-- This is the Frechet derivative of the actual root coefficient operation. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rootChart (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    HasFDerivAt (rootChart C D) (rootChartDerivative C D x) x := by
  let F : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E (ℝ × E)
  let B : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × E))
  let N : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] E :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × E))
  have hb := B.hasFDerivAt.add (C.hasFDerivAt.comp x F.hasFDerivAt)
  have hn := ((D.hasFDerivAt.comp x F.hasFDerivAt).add
    (B.hasFDerivAt.smul F.hasFDerivAt)).sub N.hasFDerivAt
  apply (F.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hb.prodMk hn)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + C h.1 = C h.1 + h.2.1
      abel
    · change D h.1 + (x.2.1 • h.1 + h.2.1 • x.1) - h.2.2 =
        (D h.1 + x.2.1 • h.1) + (h.2.1 • x.1 - h.2.2)
      abel

lemma toMatrix_rootFiber {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (f : E) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (rootFiber f).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 0
        (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Unit) => b.repr f i) (-1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rootFiber, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

theorem det_rootFiber {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (f : E) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (rootFiber f).toLinearMap).det =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [toMatrix_rootFiber, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp [Matrix.det_neg]

/-- The root operation is a polynomial coordinate change with determinant ±1
at every coefficient vector, not just away from a discriminant or zero rates. -/
theorem det_rootChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b))
      (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b))
      (rootChartDerivative C D x).toLinearMap).det = (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [rootChartDerivative, det_lowerBlock, det_rootFiber]
  simp

end Generic

/-- Coefficient crossing the truncation boundary when a polynomial is multiplied by X. -/
def shiftTop (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    (((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype)

/-- Lower coefficients of the actual polynomial X*f. -/
def shiftLow (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    (((cut n).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype)

/-- Physical Schur-complement root polynomial, before any response cancellation. -/
def rootPolynomial {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) : ℝ[X] :=
  (X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) - (x.2.2 : ℝ[X])

lemma rootPolynomial_cut {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    cut n (rootPolynomial x) = shiftLow n x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1 - x.2.2 := by
  simp only [rootPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add, map_sub, map_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^n = X^(n+1) by rw [pow_succ'],
    cut_X_pow_of_le n (n+1) (by omega)]
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl, smul_zero]
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_coe, cut_coe]
  change 0 + 0 + (shiftLow n x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1) - x.2.2 = _
  abel

lemma rootPolynomial_coeff_next {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (rootPolynomial x).coeff n = x.2.1 + shiftTop n x.1 := by
  simp only [rootPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^n = X^(n+1) by rw [pow_succ']]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.1 le_rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2.2 le_rfl,
    if_pos rfl, if_neg (show n ≠ n+1 from by omega), mul_one, mul_zero,
    sub_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [ite_true, mul_one]
  rfl

/-- The actual (unreduced) root polynomial coefficient chart. -/
def rootCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  (x.1, ((rootPolynomial x).coeff n, cut n (rootPolynomial x)))

lemma rootCoefficientMap_eq {n : ℕ} :
    rootCoefficientMap (n := n) = rootChart (shiftTop n) (shiftLow n) := by
  funext x
  simp [rootCoefficientMap, rootChart, rootPolynomial_cut, rootPolynomial_coeff_next]

theorem hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    HasFDerivAt rootCoefficientMap (rootChartDerivative (shiftTop n) (shiftLow n) x) x := by
  rw [rootCoefficientMap_eq]
  exact hasFDerivAt_rootChart _ _ _

def rootCoefficientJacobian {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)))
    (fderiv ℝ rootCoefficientMap x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The true polynomial coefficient-map derivative has determinant (-1)^n,
without assuming invertibility, positivity, or absence of common roots. -/
theorem rootCoefficientJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    rootCoefficientJacobian x = (-1 : ℝ)^n := by
  rw [rootCoefficientJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap x).fderiv,
    det_rootChartDerivative]
  simp

lemma degree_rootProduct {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    ((X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X])).degree = ((n+1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
  rw [Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X_add_C,
    Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicPoly x.1).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicPoly]
  simp [Nat.cast_add, add_comm]

lemma rootNumerator_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]).degree < ((X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X])).degree := by
  rw [degree_rootProduct]
  exact (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp x.2.2.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n)

/-- The root update never drops degree, including zero edge rates. -/
theorem rootPolynomial_monic {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (rootPolynomial x).Monic := by
  exact ((Polynomial.monic_X_add_C x.2.1).mul (monic_monicPoly x.1)).sub_of_left
    (rootNumerator_degree_lt x)

theorem rootPolynomial_natDegree {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (rootPolynomial x).natDegree = n+1 := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some
  rw [rootPolynomial, Polynomial.degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt (rootNumerator_degree_lt x),
    degree_rootProduct]

/-- The checked coefficient map determines the entire actual root polynomial. -/
theorem rootPolynomial_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (monicPoly (cut (n+1) (rootPolynomial x)) : ℝ[X]) = rootPolynomial x :=
  monic_reconstruct _ (rootPolynomial_monic x) (rootPolynomial_natDegree x)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.EndJacobian
import HydrologyTree.RootUpdate

/-! The root polynomial operation and monic numerator scaling combined in a
single explicitly triangular map. Its determinant is valid at zero scales. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {P E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

abbrev RootTransitionSpace (P E : Type*) := P × ((ℝ × ℝ) × E)

def rootTransition (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E)
    (x : RootTransitionSpace P E) : RootTransitionSpace P E :=
  (x.1, ((x.2.1.1 + α x.1, β x.1 + x.2.1.1 * α x.1 - x.2.1.2),
    L x.1 + x.2.1.1 • K x.1 - x.2.1.2 • x.2.2))

def rootTransitionCross (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E) (d : ℝ) :
    P →L[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ) × E) := (α.prod (β + d • α)).prod (L + d • K)

def rootTransitionFiberCross (K : P →L[ℝ] E) (p : P) (q : E) : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (K p) -
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight q

def rootTransitionDerivative (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E)
    (x : RootTransitionSpace P E) : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] RootTransitionSpace P E :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ P) (rootTransitionCross α β L K x.2.1.1)
    (lowerBlock (rootFiber (α x.1)) (rootTransitionFiberCross K x.1 x.2.2)
      (-x.2.1.2 • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))

theorem hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E)
    (x : RootTransitionSpace P E) :
    HasFDerivAt (rootTransition α β L K) (rootTransitionDerivative α β L K x) x := by
  let A : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] P := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ P _
  let B : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ) × E) := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ P _
  let D : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) E).comp B)
  let C : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) E).comp B)
  let Q : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] E := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) E).comp B
  have ha := α.hasFDerivAt.comp x A.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 := D.hasFDerivAt.add ha
  have h2 := ((β.hasFDerivAt.comp x A.hasFDerivAt).add (D.hasFDerivAt.mul ha)).sub C.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 := ((L.hasFDerivAt.comp x A.hasFDerivAt).add
    (D.hasFDerivAt.smul (K.hasFDerivAt.comp x A.hasFDerivAt))).sub
      (C.hasFDerivAt.smul Q.hasFDerivAt)
  apply (A.hasFDerivAt.prodMk ((h1.prodMk h2).prodMk h3)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · apply Prod.ext
      · change h.2.1.1 + α h.1 = α h.1 + h.2.1.1
        exact add_comm _ _
      · change β h.1 + (x.2.1.1 * α h.1 + α x.1 * h.2.1.1) - h.2.1.2 =
          (β h.1 + x.2.1.1 * α h.1) + (h.2.1.1 * α x.1 - h.2.1.2)
        ring
    · change L h.1 + (x.2.1.1 • K h.1 + h.2.1.1 • K x.1) -
          (x.2.1.2 • h.2.2 + h.2.1.2 • x.2.2) =
        (L h.1 + x.2.1.1 • K h.1) +
          ((h.2.1.1 • K x.1 - h.2.1.2 • x.2.2) + (-x.2.1.2) • h.2.2)
      simp only [neg_smul]
      abel

lemma endDet_scalarRootFiber (p : ℝ) : LinearMap.det (rootFiber p).toLinearMap = -1 := by
  simpa only [LinearMap.det_toMatrix, Fintype.card_unique, pow_one] using
    det_rootFiber (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ) p

/-- Root coefficient update plus numerator scaling: exact all-scale determinant. -/
theorem endJacobian_rootTransition [FiniteDimensional ℝ P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E) (x : RootTransitionSpace P E) :
    endJacobian (rootTransition α β L K) x =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E + 1) * x.2.1.2 ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_rootTransition α β L K x),
    rootTransitionDerivative, endDet_lowerBlock, endDet_lowerBlock, endDet_scalarRootFiber]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul, LinearMap.det_id,
    LinearMap.det_smul, one_mul, mul_one]
  rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_pow, pow_succ]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathRootTransform

/-! Exact coefficient interpretation of the one-child root transformation.
All coefficient permutations, including degree-zero tails, are explicit. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PathCoefficients (n : ℕ) := Coeff (n+1) × Coeff n
abbrev PathPolyData (n : ℕ) := RootTransitionSpace (Coeff (n+1)) (Coeff n)

lemma cut_cut {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    cut n (cut m p : ℝ[X]) = cut n p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (cut m p : ℝ[X]) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i =
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i
  rw [cut_coeff, cut_coeff]
  exact cut_coeff m p ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h⟩

/-- High-first two coefficients and the remaining low coefficients. -/
def topTwoEquiv (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+2) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ) × Coeff n) :=
  (leadingEquiv (n+1)).symm |>.trans
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ).prodCongr (leadingEquiv n).symm) |>.trans
    (LinearEquiv.prodAssoc ℝ ℝ ℝ (Coeff n)).symm

@[simp] lemma topTwoEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (p : Coeff (n+2)) :
    topTwoEquiv n p =
      (((p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1), (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n), cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := by
  change (((p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1), ((cut (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X])).coeff n),
      cut n (cut (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X])) = _
  rw [cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩, cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n)]

/-- A rate-independent permutation of the actual parent polynomial coefficients. -/
def parentCoefficientEquiv (n : ℕ) : PathCoefficients (n+1) ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathPolyData n :=
  (LinearEquiv.prodComm ℝ (Coeff (n+2)) (Coeff (n+1))).trans
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff (n+1))).prodCongr (topTwoEquiv n))

def pathTop (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

def pathNext (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp
    (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

def pathLow (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((cut n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

def pathShift (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (((cut n).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp
    (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

/-- The actual characteristic polynomial when one child is attached at the root. -/
def pathStepPolynomial {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) : ℝ[X] :=
  (X + C z.2.1.1) * (monicPoly z.1 : ℝ[X]) - C z.2.1.2 * (monicPoly z.2.2 : ℝ[X])

def pathStepCoefficients {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) : PathCoefficients (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z), z.1)

lemma pathStepPolynomial_top {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :
    (pathStepPolynomial z).coeff (n+1) = z.2.1.1 + pathTop n z.1 := by
  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.1 le_rfl,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.2.2 (Nat.le_succ n),
    if_neg (show n+1 ≠ n+2 from by omega), if_neg (show n+1 ≠ n from by omega),
    if_pos rfl, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
  simp only [ite_true, mul_one]
  rfl

lemma pathStepPolynomial_next {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :
    (pathStepPolynomial z).coeff n = pathNext n z.1 + z.2.1.1 * pathTop n z.1 - z.2.1.2 := by
  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.2.2 le_rfl,
    if_neg (show n ≠ n+2 from by omega), if_neg (show n ≠ n+1 from by omega),
    if_pos rfl, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, ite_true]
  rfl

lemma pathStepPolynomial_low {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :
    cut n (pathStepPolynomial z) =
      pathShift n z.1 + z.2.1.1 • pathLow n z.1 - z.2.1.2 • z.2.2 := by
  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add, map_sub, map_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  simp only [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_X_pow_of_le n (n+2) (by omega),
    cut_X_pow_of_le n (n+1) (by omega), cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl,
    smul_zero, cut_coe, zero_add, add_zero]
  rfl

/-- The explicit triangular endomorphism is exactly the actual coefficient
operation followed by the stated coefficient permutation. -/
theorem parentCoefficient_step_eq {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :
    parentCoefficientEquiv n (pathStepCoefficients z) =
      rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) z := by
  change (z.1, topTwoEquiv n (cut (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z))) = _
  rw [topTwoEquiv_apply]
  rw [cut_coeff (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z) ⟨n+1, by omega⟩,
    cut_coeff (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z) ⟨n, by omega⟩, cut_cut (show n ≤ n+2 by omega)]
  rw [pathStepPolynomial_top, pathStepPolynomial_next, pathStepPolynomial_low]
  rfl

lemma finrank_coeff (n : ℕ) : Module.finrank ℝ (Coeff n) = n := by
  simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)

/-- Actual one-child polynomial coefficient determinant at all real data. -/
theorem pathStep_jacobian (n : ℕ) (z : PathPolyData n) :
    endJacobian (fun w => parentCoefficientEquiv n (pathStepCoefficients w)) z =
      (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * z.2.1.2^n := by
  have he : (fun w => parentCoefficientEquiv n (pathStepCoefficients w)) =
      rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) := by
    funext w; exact parentCoefficient_step_eq w
  rw [he, endJacobian_rootTransition, finrank_coeff]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.FamilyScaling
import HydrologyTree.FamilyGluing
import HydrologyTree.PathPolynomial

/-! Exact common-coordinate normalization for the actual all-child gluing and
root coefficient update. Every normalization is a specified linear equivalence. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Coordinates
variable {E F I : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]

lemma basis_normalized_jacobian (bE : Basis I ℝ E) (bF : Basis I ℝ F)
    (f : E → F) (x : E) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    endJacobian (fun z => (bE.equiv bF (Equiv.refl I)).symm (f z)) x =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap).det := by
  let e := bE.equiv bF (Equiv.refl I)
  have h := e.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x hf.hasFDerivAt
  calc
    _ = LinearMap.det (e.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ f x)).toLinearMap := endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt h
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix bE]
      congr 1
      ext i j
      simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, e, Basis.equiv]

end Coordinates

abbrev FamilyPairs (ns : List ℕ) := ProductInput ns × ProductInput ns

def familyPairEquiv (ns : List ℕ) : FamilyPairs ns ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff ns.sum × Coeff ns.sum) :=
  ((familyBasis ns).prod (familyBasis ns)).equiv
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum)) (Equiv.refl _)

def normalizedFamilyGlue (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyPairs ns) : FamilyPairs ns :=
  (familyPairEquiv ns).symm (familyGlue ns z)

lemma differentiable_normalizedFamilyGlue (ns : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedFamilyGlue ns) := by
  intro z
  exact (familyPairEquiv ns).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_familyGlue ns z).differentiableAt

theorem normalizedFamilyGlue_jacobian (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyPairs ns) :
    endJacobian (normalizedFamilyGlue ns) z = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ns z.1)^2 := by
  unfold normalizedFamilyGlue familyPairEquiv
  rw [basis_normalized_jacobian _ _ _ _
    (hasFDerivAt_familyGlue ns z).differentiableAt]
  exact familyGlueJacobian_eq_pairwise ns z

abbrev FamilyRootInputs (ns : List ℕ) := FamilyPairs ns × ℝ

def rootRegroupEquiv (N : ℕ) : ((Coeff N × Coeff N) × ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff N × (ℝ × Coeff N)) where
  toFun z := (z.1.1,(z.2,z.1.2))
  invFun z := ((z.1,z.2.2),z.2.1)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def familyRootEquiv (ns : List ℕ) : FamilyRootInputs ns ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff ns.sum × (ℝ × Coeff ns.sum)) :=
  ((familyPairEquiv ns).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ)).trans (rootRegroupEquiv ns.sum)

/-- Parent coefficients, reordered without changing or scaling any scalar. -/
def rootOutputEquiv (N : ℕ) : (Coeff (N+1) × Coeff N) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff N × (ℝ × Coeff N)) :=
  (LinearEquiv.prodComm ℝ (Coeff (N+1)) (Coeff N)).trans
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff N)).prodCongr (leadingEquiv N).symm)

lemma rootOutputEquiv_actual (N : ℕ) (z : Coeff N × (ℝ × Coeff N)) :
    rootOutputEquiv N (cut (N+1) (rootPolynomial z),z.1) = rootCoefficientMap z := by
  change (z.1, (((cut (N+1) (rootPolynomial z) : Coeff (N+1)) : ℝ[X]).coeff N,
    cut N (cut (N+1) (rootPolynomial z) : ℝ[X]))) = _
  rw [cut_coeff (N+1) _ ⟨N,Nat.lt_succ_self N⟩, cut_cut (Nat.le_succ N)]
  rfl

def normalizedFamilyRoot (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyRootInputs ns) : FamilyRootInputs ns :=
  (familyRootEquiv ns).symm (rootCoefficientMap (familyRootEquiv ns z))

lemma differentiable_normalizedFamilyRoot (ns : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedFamilyRoot ns) := by
  intro z
  exact (familyRootEquiv ns).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    ((hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap (familyRootEquiv ns z)).differentiableAt.comp z
      (familyRootEquiv ns).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

/-- Exact root-update determinant after transport into the common family coordinates. -/
theorem normalizedFamilyRoot_jacobian (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyRootInputs ns) :
    endJacobian (normalizedFamilyRoot ns) z = (-1 : ℝ)^ns.sum := by
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate
    (familyRootEquiv ns).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv rootCoefficientMap z
      (hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap _).differentiableAt
  have hlocal : endJacobian rootCoefficientMap (familyRootEquiv ns z) = (-1 : ℝ)^ns.sum := by
    rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap _),
      ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum).prod
        ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum))), det_rootChartDerivative]
    simp
  exact h.trans hlocal

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.FamilyNormalization

/-! Complete all-child local coefficient-Jacobian assembly: actual monic
numerator scaling, actual gluing and actual root polynomial update are composed
with their Frechet derivatives. The global physical-tree induction is separate. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev BranchStepInputs (ms : List ℕ) := FamilyRootInputs (ChildFactorDegrees ms)

def branchScaleStep (ms : List ℕ) : BranchStepInputs ms → BranchStepInputs ms :=
  keepFunction (F := ℝ) (productEndMap id (scaleFamily ms))

def branchGlueStep (ms : List ℕ) : BranchStepInputs ms → BranchStepInputs ms :=
  keepFunction (F := ℝ) (normalizedFamilyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms))

def normalizedBranchStep (ms : List ℕ) : BranchStepInputs ms → BranchStepInputs ms :=
  normalizedFamilyRoot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) ∘ (branchGlueStep ms ∘ branchScaleStep ms)

lemma differentiable_branchScaleStep (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (branchScaleStep ms) := by
  intro z
  exact (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction z
    (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap id (scaleFamily ms) z.1 differentiableAt_id
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).differentiableAt).differentiableAt

lemma differentiable_branchGlueStep (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (branchGlueStep ms) := by
  intro z
  exact (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction z (differentiable_normalizedFamilyGlue _ z.1)).differentiableAt

lemma differentiable_normalizedBranchStep (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedBranchStep ms) :=
  (differentiable_normalizedFamilyRoot _).comp
    ((differentiable_branchGlueStep ms).comp (differentiable_branchScaleStep ms))

lemma branchScaleStep_jacobian (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    endJacobian (branchScaleStep ms) z = scaleFamilyWeight ms z.1.2 := by
  rw [branchScaleStep, endJacobian_keepFunction _ _
    (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap id (scaleFamily ms) z.1 differentiableAt_id
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).differentiableAt,
    endJacobian_productEndMap _ _ _ differentiableAt_id
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms z.1.2), endJacobian_scaleFamily]
  simp [endJacobian]

lemma branchGlueStep_jacobian (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    endJacobian (branchGlueStep ms) z =
      pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)^2 := by
  rw [branchGlueStep, endJacobian_keepFunction _ _
    (differentiable_normalizedFamilyGlue _ z.1), normalizedFamilyGlue_jacobian]

/-- All local Jacobian factors are composed, rather than merely proved in isolation.
No nonzero scale, simple root, positive rate, or nonempty-child assumption. -/
theorem normalizedBranchStep_jacobian (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    endJacobian (normalizedBranchStep ms) z =
      (-1 : ℝ)^(ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum *
        pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)^2 *
          scaleFamilyWeight ms z.1.2 := by
  rw [normalizedBranchStep,
    endJacobian_comp (differentiable_normalizedFamilyRoot _ _)
      ((differentiable_branchGlueStep ms _).comp z (differentiable_branchScaleStep ms z)),
    endJacobian_comp (differentiable_branchGlueStep ms _) (differentiable_branchScaleStep ms z),
    normalizedFamilyRoot_jacobian, branchGlueStep_jacobian, branchScaleStep_jacobian]
  change (-1 : ℝ)^(ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum *
    (pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)^2 *
      scaleFamilyWeight ms z.1.2) = _
  ring

def branchStepPolynomial (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) : ℝ[X] :=
  (X+C z.2) * (monicPoly (familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1) : ℝ[X]) -
    familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1 (scaleFamily ms z.1.2)

/-- Actual parent characteristic/cofactor coefficient output at a root. -/
def branchStepCoefficients (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum :=
  (cut ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) (branchStepPolynomial ms z),
    familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)

def branchCoefficientEquiv (ms : List ℕ) :
    (Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
      BranchStepInputs ms :=
  (rootOutputEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum).trans (familyRootEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm

lemma familyRootEquiv_glued (ns : List ℕ) (x : FamilyPairs ns) (d : ℝ) :
    familyRootEquiv ns (normalizedFamilyGlue ns x,d) =
      ((familyGlue ns x).1,(d,(familyGlue ns x).2)) := by
  change rootRegroupEquiv ns.sum
    (familyPairEquiv ns ((familyPairEquiv ns).symm (familyGlue ns x)),d) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

lemma branchStepPolynomial_root (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    branchStepPolynomial ms z =
      rootPolynomial ((familyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (z.1.1,scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).1,
        (z.2,(familyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (z.1.1,scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).2)) := by
  unfold branchStepPolynomial rootPolynomial
  rw [familyGlue_numerator_exact]
  rfl

/-- The composed normal-form transformation is exactly the actual coefficient map,
followed by the specified unscaled coefficient permutation. -/

  change (familyRootEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm

      (normalizedFamilyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (z.1.1,scaleFamily ms z.1.2),z.2))) = _
  rw [familyRootEquiv_glued]
  apply (familyRootEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).injective

  have he : (fun w => branchCoefficientEquiv ms (branchStepCoefficients ms w)) = normalizedBranchStep ms := by
    funext w
    exact (normalizedBranchStep_actual ms w).symm
