import HydrologyTree.BranchStep
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Pi

/-! Exact serialization of independently indexed child coefficient spaces into
the all-arity gluing coordinates. No dimension matching is assumed. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def finPiHeadTail {k : ℕ} (E : Fin (k+1) → Type*)
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, Module ℝ (E i)] :
    ((i : Fin (k+1)) → E i) ≃ₗ[ℝ] E 0 × ((i : Fin k) → E i.succ) where
  toFun f := (f 0, fun i => f i.succ)
  invFun z := Fin.cases z.1 z.2
  left_inv f := by funext i; exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- Degree list with definitional head/tail reduction. -/
@[reducible] def finDegreeList : {k : ℕ} → (Fin k → ℕ) → List ℕ
  | 0, _ => []
  | k+1, m => m 0 :: finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)

lemma finDegreeList_eq_ofFn {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ) : finDegreeList m = List.ofFn m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [finDegreeList, List.ofFn_succ, ih]

/-- Serialize actual bounded polynomials without changing coefficient values. -/
def piCoefficientsFinEquiv : {k : ℕ} → (m : Fin k → ℕ) →
    ((i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ProductInput (finDegreeList m)
  | 0, m => by
    have : Subsingleton (Coeff 0) := (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective.subsingleton
    exact LinearEquiv.ofSubsingleton _ _
  | k+1, m =>
    (finPiHeadTail (fun i => Coeff (m i))).trans
      ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff (m 0))).prodCongr
        (piCoefficientsFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))

lemma piCoefficientsFinEquiv_polynomials {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i)) :
    familyPolynomials (finDegreeList m) (piCoefficientsFinEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ]
    change (monicPoly (p 0) : ℝ[X]) ::
      familyPolynomials (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ))
        (piCoefficientsFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I]

@[reducible] def degreeSequence (m : I → ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  finDegreeList (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))

/-- The enumeration depends only on the finite index type, never on rates. -/
def piCoefficientsEquiv (m : I → ℕ) :
    ((i : I) → Coeff (m i)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ProductInput (degreeSequence m) :=
  (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft' ℝ (fun i : I => Coeff (m i)) (Fintype.equivFin I)).trans
    (piCoefficientsFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)))

lemma degreeSequence_sum (m : I → ℕ) : (degreeSequence m).sum = ∑ i : I, m i := by
  rw [degreeSequence, finDegreeList_eq_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  exact (Fintype.equivFin I).symm.sum_comp m

lemma degreeSequence_addOne (m : I → ℕ) :
    degreeSequence (fun i => m i+1) = ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m) := by
  simp only [degreeSequence, finDegreeList_eq_ofFn, ChildFactorDegrees, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def]

def productInputCast {ms ns : List ℕ} (h : ms = ns) : ProductInput ms ≃ₗ[ℝ] ProductInput ns := by
  subst ns
  exact LinearEquiv.refl ℝ _

def piScaleSlotsEquiv (m : I → ℕ) :
    ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ScaledFamilyInput (degreeSequence m) :=
  (piCoefficientsEquiv (fun i => m i+1)).trans (productInputCast (degreeSequence_addOne m))

lemma piCoefficientsEquiv_polynomials (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i)) :
    familyPolynomials (degreeSequence m) (piCoefficientsEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) =>
        (monicPoly (p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)) : ℝ[X])) := by
  apply piCoefficientsFinEquiv_polynomials

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Triangular
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SchurComplement
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Block

/-! Actual conservative tree rate coordinates, with arbitrary finite size.
Vertices are topologically numbered from the designated leak/root 0.
The parameter at 0 is the leak; at every other vertex it is the transfer rate
toward its parent. No positivity or nonzero-rate premise is used below. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- A finite rooted tree in a topological vertex numbering. Every nonroot
vertex i+1 has exactly one parent, with smaller vertex number. -/
structure OrderedTree (n : ℕ) where
  parent : Fin n → Fin (n+1)
  parent_le : ∀ i, (parent i).val ≤ i.val

abbrev VertexValues (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) → ℝ
abbrev EdgeValues (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
abbrev TreeRates (n : ℕ) := VertexValues n × EdgeValues n

lemma parent_ne_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (i : Fin n) :
    t.parent i ≠ i.succ := by
  intro h
  have hle := t.parent_le i
  have := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_succ] at this
  omega

/-- Parent-incidence matrix of the actual labelled tree. -/
def parentIncidence {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun v e => if t.parent e = v then 1 else 0

/-- Derivative of c_e=a_e f_e with respect to the inward/diagonal parameters. -/
def childWeighted {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun e v => if e.succ = v then f e else 0

def parentCLM {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : EdgeValues n →L[ℝ] VertexValues n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' (parentIncidence t))

@[simp] lemma parentCLM_apply {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    parentCLM t f v = ∑ e, if t.parent e = v then f e else 0 := by
  simp [parentCLM, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    parentIncidence, ite_mul]

/-- Physical rate chart: d_v is the sum of all rates leaving v, and c_e is
exactly the product of the two opposed rates on edge e. -/
def rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : TreeRates n :=
  (x.1 + parentCLM t x.2, fun e => x.1 e.succ * x.2 e)

def rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    TreeRates n →L[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)) +
    (parentCLM t).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun e : Fin n =>
      x.1 e.succ • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))) +
      x.2 e • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))))

/-- The rate-coordinate Jacobian is derived from the actual polynomial map. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (rateChart t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  apply HasFDerivAt.prodMk
  · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt.add
      ((parentCLM t).hasFDerivAt.comp x
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt)
  · apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro e
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt.mul
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt

lemma toMatrix_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (parentIncidence t) (childWeighted x.2)
        (Matrix.diagonal fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rateChartDerivative, childWeighted,
      parentIncidence, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rename_i v j
  symm
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro e _ he
    simp [Ne.symm he]
  · simp

lemma childWeighted_mul_parent {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (childWeighted f * parentIncidence t) i j = if t.parent j = i.succ then f i else 0 := by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, childWeighted, parentIncidence, ite_mul, eq_comm]

lemma rateSchur_upperTriangular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t).IsUpperTriangular := by
  intro i j hij
  have hne : t.parent j ≠ i.succ := by
    intro h
    have hle := t.parent_le j
    have hh := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ] at hh
    have hijv : j.val < i.val := hij
    omega
  have hneq : i ≠ j := ne_of_gt (show j < i from hij)
  simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, childWeighted_mul_parent,
    hne, hneq]

lemma rateSchur_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t) i i = x.1 i.succ := by
  simp [childWeighted_mul_parent, parent_ne_child]

/-- The exact physical-rate Jacobian, for every tree size and all real rates.
In particular, zero edges are not excluded by an inverse-rate calculation. -/
theorem det_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap).det = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [toMatrix_rateChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₁₁,
    Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular (rateSchur_upperTriangular t x)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact rateSchur_diagonal t x i

/-- The true Frechet Jacobian, not a separately prescribed formal matrix. -/
def physicalRateJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fderiv ℝ (rateChart t) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem physicalRateJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRateJacobian t x = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [physicalRateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rateChart t x).fderiv,
    det_rateChartDerivative]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathPolynomial
import HydrologyTree.RateChart

/-! Nested endpoint-path rate coordinates and their explicit permutation to
all physical inward, outward and leak coordinates. No parameter is discarded. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def PathRates : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℝ
  | n+1 => PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)

instance pathRatesNormed : (n : ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesNormed n
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

instance pathRatesSpace : (n : ℕ) → NormedSpace ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesSpace n
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

instance pathRatesFinite : (n : ℕ) → FiniteDimensional ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional ℝ ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesFinite n
    exact inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional ℝ (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

/-- Add one new root with leak ell and outgoing rate f to the previous child rates. -/
def prependRateEquiv (n : ℕ) : (TreeRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates (n+1) where
  toFun z := (Fin.cons z.2.1 z.1.1, Fin.cons z.2.2 z.1.2)
  invFun x := ((Fin.tail x.1, Fin.tail x.2),(x.1 0,x.2 0))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
  map_add' z w := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
  map_smul' a z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

@[simp] lemma prependRateEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (z : TreeRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    prependRateEquiv n z = (Fin.cons z.2.1 z.1.1, Fin.cons z.2.2 z.1.2) := rfl

def singletonRateEquiv : ℝ ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates 0 where
  toFun a := (fun _ => a, Fin.elim0)
  invFun x := x.1 0
  left_inv a := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega); subst i; rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  map_add' a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  map_smul' a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i

/-- Explicit linear permutation from the nested rate order to original arrays. -/
def pathRateEquiv : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n
  | 0 => singletonRateEquiv
  | n+1 => ((pathRateEquiv n).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).trans (prependRateEquiv n)

@[simp] lemma pathRateEquiv_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    pathRateEquiv (n+1) z = prependRateEquiv n (pathRateEquiv n z.1,z.2) := rfl

/-- The actual root leak as a continuous linear function of all path rates. -/
def pathLeak (n : ℕ) : PathRates n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (((LinearMap.proj 0).comp
    (LinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).comp (pathRateEquiv n).toLinearMap)

@[simp] lemma pathLeak_apply (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    pathLeak n z = (pathRateEquiv n z).1 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pathLeak_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) : pathLeak (n+1) z = z.2.1 := rfl

/-- The exact monomial, including all zero-rate boundaries. -/
def pathWeight : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n+1, z => (pathLeak n z.1)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n * pathWeight n z.1

def pathRateMonomial (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)

lemma pathRateMonomial_prepend (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    pathRateMonomial (n+1) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      y.1 0^(n+1) * f^n * pathRateMonomial n y := by
  rw [pathRateMonomial, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [prependRateEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.add_sub_add_right,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rfl

theorem pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    pathWeight n z = pathRateMonomial n (pathRateEquiv n z) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pathWeight, pathRateMonomial]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathWeight, pathRateEquiv_succ, pathRateMonomial_prepend, ih, pathLeak_apply]

/-- The sign depends only on size and the explicit coefficient ordering. -/
def pathOrientation : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * pathOrientation n

lemma pathOrientation_sq (n : ℕ) : pathOrientation n ^ 2 = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [pathOrientation]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathOrientation, mul_pow, ih, mul_one, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (n+1) 2, pow_mul]
    norm_num

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathRates

/-! Explicit coordinate permutations for the endpoint-path coefficient map.
The normalization reads existing coefficients; it does not divide, rescale,
fit, or impose the desired Jacobian as an assumption. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Rearrange p,(d,c),q into (p,q),(d,c). -/
def pathShuffle (n : ℕ) : PathPolyData n ≃ₗ[ℝ] (PathCoefficients n × (ℝ × ℝ)) where
  toFun z := ((z.1,z.2.2),z.2.1)
  invFun z := (z.1.1,(z.2,z.1.2))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' z w := rfl
  map_smul' a z := rfl

/-- A degree-one monic polynomial has just one non-leading coefficient. -/
def baseCoefficientEquiv : PathCoefficients 0 ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun z := (z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0
  invFun a := (cut 1 (C a),0)
  left_inv z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 1).injective
      funext i
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      change ((cut 1 (C ((z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0)) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = _
      rw [cut_coeff 1 _ (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
      simp
    · apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective
      funext i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  right_inv a := by
    change ((cut 1 (C a) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = a
    rw [cut_coeff 1 (C a) (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
    simp
  map_add' z w := by simp
  map_smul' a z := by simp

/-- The order of all original coefficient coordinates, recursively permuted. -/
def pathCoefficientEquiv : (n : ℕ) → PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathRates n
  | 0 => baseCoefficientEquiv
  | n+1 => (parentCoefficientEquiv n).trans (pathShuffle n) |>.trans
      ((pathCoefficientEquiv n).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))

/-- From normalized child coefficients and (d,c) to the local polynomial data. -/
def pathTransitionEquiv (n : ℕ) : PathRates (n+1) ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathPolyData n :=
  (((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm.prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))).trans
    (pathShuffle n).symm

lemma pathCoefficientEquiv_succ (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients (n+1)) :
    pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) p = (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm (parentCoefficientEquiv n p) := rfl

/-- The actual one-child coefficient operation in the explicit common order. -/
def normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) : PathRates (n+1) :=
  pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) (pathStepCoefficients (pathTransitionEquiv n z))

lemma normalizedPathStep_conjugate (n : ℕ) : normalizedPathStep n =
    fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z)) := by
  funext z
  rw [normalizedPathStep, pathCoefficientEquiv_succ, parentCoefficient_step_eq]

/-- Smoothness follows from the actual polynomial root operation. -/
theorem differentiable_normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedPathStep n) := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  intro z
  exact (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    ((hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt.comp z
        (pathTransitionEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

theorem normalizedPathStep_jacobian (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPathStep n) z = (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
    (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)) z
    (hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt
  change endJacobian (fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z))) z = _ at h
  rw [h, endJacobian_rootTransition, finrank_coeff]
  rfl

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/CoordinateEnergy.lean:
import HydrologyTree.PathNormalization

/-! Unscaled coordinate transport: a direct finite bilinear-form proof that
all path coefficient and physical-array reorderings preserve coefficient dot
products. This closes the possible hidden size-dependent scaling of Jacobians. -/
open Polynomial Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def coefficientDot (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff i

def pathCoefficientDot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) : ℝ :=
  coefficientDot (n+1) p.1 q.1 + coefficientDot n p.2 q.2

def physicalRateDot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : Fin (n+1), x.1 i * y.1 i) + ∑ i : Fin n, x.2 i * y.2 i

@[reducible] def nestedPathDot : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n → PathRates n → ℝ
  | 0, x, y => x*y
  | n+1, x, y => nestedPathDot n x.1 y.1 + x.2.1*y.2.1 + x.2.2*y.2.2

lemma coefficientDot_succ (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff (n+1)) :
    coefficientDot (n+1) p q = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n +
      coefficientDot n (cut n (p : ℝ[X])) (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  simp only [coefficientDot, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc,
    Fin.val_last, cut_coeff]
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma coefficientDot_two (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff (n+2)) :
    coefficientDot (n+2) p q =
      (p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1) * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1) +
      (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n +
      coefficientDot n (cut n (p : ℝ[X])) (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  rw [coefficientDot_succ (n+1), coefficientDot_succ n,
    cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩,
    cut_coeff (n+1) (q : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩,
    cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n), cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n)]
  ring

lemma prependRateEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) (a b c d : ℝ) :
    physicalRateDot (n+1) (prependRateEquiv n (x,(a,b)))
      (prependRateEquiv n (y,(c,d))) = physicalRateDot n x y + a*c + b*d := by
  simp only [physicalRateDot, prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
  ring

/-- The recursive rate equivalence is unscaled in the original physical arrays. -/
theorem pathRateEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : PathRates n) :
    physicalRateDot n (pathRateEquiv n x) (pathRateEquiv n y) = nestedPathDot n x y := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pathRateEquiv, singletonRateEquiv, physicalRateDot, nestedPathDot]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathRateEquiv_succ, pathRateEquiv_succ, prependRateEquiv_dot, ih]

lemma pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients (n+1)) :
    pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) p =
      (pathCoefficientEquiv n (p.2,cut n (p.1 : ℝ[X])),
        ((p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1),(p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff n)) := by
  change (pathCoefficientEquiv n (p.2, (topTwoEquiv n p.1).2),
    (topTwoEquiv n p.1).1) = _
  rw [topTwoEquiv_apply]

/-- The output-coordinate equivalence only reorders existing coefficients. -/
theorem pathCoefficientEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    nestedPathDot n (pathCoefficientEquiv n p) (pathCoefficientEquiv n q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 * (q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = _
    simp [pathCoefficientDot, coefficientDot, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ, pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ]
    change nestedPathDot n (pathCoefficientEquiv n _) (pathCoefficientEquiv n _) + _ + _ = _
    rw [ih]
    unfold pathCoefficientDot
    rw [coefficientDot_two]
    ring

/-- Dot product in an arbitrary finite basis. -/
def basisDot {E I : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Fintype I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (x y : E) : ℝ := ∑ i, b.repr x i * b.repr y i

/-- A bilinear-form-preserving coefficient map has determinant square one. -/
theorem det_sq_of_basisDot_preserved {E F I : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (bE : Basis I ℝ E) (bF : Basis I ℝ F)
    (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : ∀ x y, basisDot bF (L x) (L y) = basisDot bE x y) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L).det ^ 2 = 1 := by
  let M := LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L
  have hM : M.transpose * M = 1 := by
    ext i j
    change (∑ k : I, M k i * M k j) = (1 : Matrix I I ℝ) i j
    simp only [M, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change basisDot bF (L (bE i)) (L (bE j)) = _
    rw [hL]
    simp [basisDot, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hM
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at hd
  simpa only [pow_two] using hd

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilyCoordinateEnergy.lea:
import HydrologyTree.BranchStep
import HydrologyTree.CoordinateEnergy

/-! Exact coefficient-dot preservation for all family charts. This rules out
unproved, size-dependent scale factors when global Jacobians are transported. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma basisDot_reindex {E I J : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (b : Basis I ℝ E) (e : I ≃ J) (x y : E) :
    basisDot (b.reindex e) x y = basisDot b x y := by
  simp only [basisDot, Basis.repr_reindex_apply]
  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => b.repr x i * b.repr y i)

lemma basisDot_prod {E F I J : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (c : Basis J ℝ F) (x y : E × F) :
    basisDot (b.prod c) x y = basisDot b x.1 y.1 + basisDot c x.2 y.2 := by
  simp [basisDot]

lemma basisDot_degreeLT (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff n) :
    basisDot (degreeLT.basis ℝ n) p q = coefficientDot n p q := by
  simp [basisDot, coefficientDot, Polynomial.degreeLT.basis_repr]

lemma basisDot_equiv {E F I : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [Fintype I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (c : Basis I ℝ F) (x y : E) :
    basisDot c (b.equiv c (Equiv.refl I) x) (b.equiv c (Equiv.refl I) y) = basisDot b x y := by
  simp [basisDot, Basis.equiv]

@[reducible] def familyCoordinateDot : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ProductInput ms → ℝ
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x, y => coefficientDot m x.1 y.1 + familyCoordinateDot ms x.2 y.2

lemma familyBasis_dot (ms : List ℕ) (x y : ProductInput ms) :
    basisDot (familyBasis ms) x y = familyCoordinateDot ms x y := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change basisDot (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0) x y = 0
    simp [basisDot]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change basisDot (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex
      (finSumFinEquiv : (Fin m ⊕ Fin ms.sum) ≃ Fin (m+ms.sum))) x y =
        coefficientDot m x.1 y.1 + familyCoordinateDot ms x.2 y.2
    rw [basisDot_reindex, basisDot_prod, basisDot_degreeLT, ih]

lemma familyPairEquiv_dot (ms : List ℕ) (x y : FamilyPairs ms) :
    coefficientDot ms.sum (familyPairEquiv ms x).1 (familyPairEquiv ms y).1 +
      coefficientDot ms.sum (familyPairEquiv ms x).2 (familyPairEquiv ms y).2 =
      familyCoordinateDot ms x.1 y.1 + familyCoordinateDot ms x.2 y.2 := by
  have h := basisDot_equiv ((familyBasis ms).prod (familyBasis ms))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)) x y
  simpa only [familyPairEquiv, basisDot_prod, basisDot_degreeLT, familyBasis_dot] using h

lemma leadingEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    coefficientDot (n+1) (leadingEquiv n x) (leadingEquiv n y) =
      x.1*y.1 + coefficientDot n x.2 y.2 := by
  rw [coefficientDot_succ]
  have hx := split_joinLeading x
  have hy := split_joinLeading y
  rw [splitLeadingLM_apply] at hx hy
  rw [show ((leadingEquiv n x : Coeff (n+1)) : ℝ[X]).coeff n = x.1 from congrArg Prod.fst hx,
    show ((leadingEquiv n y : Coeff (n+1)) : ℝ[X]).coeff n = y.1 from congrArg Prod.fst hy,
    show cut n (leadingEquiv n x : ℝ[X]) = x.2 from congrArg Prod.snd hx,
    show cut n (leadingEquiv n y : ℝ[X]) = y.2 from congrArg Prod.snd hy]

lemma branchCoefficientEquiv_apply (ms : List ℕ)
    (p : Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) :
    branchCoefficientEquiv ms p =
      ((familyPairEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm
        (p.2, cut (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum (p.1 : ℝ[X])),
          (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) := rfl

/-- Both gluing coordinate blocks and the root coordinate are pure coefficient
reorderings; no determinant magnitude is inferred numerically. -/
lemma branchCoefficientEquiv_dot (ms : List ℕ)
    (p q : Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) :
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (branchCoefficientEquiv ms p).1.1
        (branchCoefficientEquiv ms q).1.1 +
      familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (branchCoefficientEquiv ms p).1.2
        (branchCoefficientEquiv ms q).1.2 +
      (branchCoefficientEquiv ms p).2 * (branchCoefficientEquiv ms q).2 =
      pathCoefficientDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum p q := by
  let N := (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum
  have hp : leadingEquiv N ((p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N, cut N (p.1 : ℝ[X])) = p.1 := join_splitLeading p.1
  have hq : leadingEquiv N ((q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N, cut N (q.1 : ℝ[X])) = q.1 := join_splitLeading q.1
  have h := familyPairEquiv_dot (ChildFactorDegrees ms)
    ((familyPairEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm (p.2,cut N (p.1 : ℝ[X])))
    ((familyPairEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm (q.2,cut N (q.1 : ℝ[X])))
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  rw [branchCoefficientEquiv_apply,branchCoefficientEquiv_apply]
  change _ + (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N * (q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N = _
  rw [← h]
  unfold pathCoefficientDot
  rw [coefficientDot_succ N]
  ring

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/ScaledSerialization.lean:
import HydrologyTree.PiSerialization
import HydrologyTree.FamilyCoordinateEnergy

/-! Actual child numerator slots in finite-list gluing coordinates. The leading
coefficient is its connector scale and the remaining coefficients are a monic
child cofactor. Serialization changes no coefficient value. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def piScaledFinEquiv : {k : ℕ} → (m : Fin k → ℕ) →
    ((i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ScaledFamilyInput (finDegreeList m)
  | 0, m => by
    change ((i : Fin 0) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Coeff 0
    have : Subsingleton (Coeff 0) := (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective.subsingleton
    exact LinearEquiv.ofSubsingleton _ _
  | k+1, m =>
    (finPiHeadTail (fun i => Coeff (m i+1))).trans
      ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff (m 0+1))).prodCongr
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))

lemma piScaledFin_polynomials {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList m)) (piScaledFinEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ]
    change (monicPoly (p 0) : ℝ[X]) ::
      familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

lemma piScaledFin_weight {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamilyWeight (finDegreeList m) (piScaledFinEquiv m p) =
      ∏ i : Fin k, (p i : ℝ[X]).coeff (m i) ^ (m i) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [finDegreeList,scaleFamilyWeight]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    change (p 0 : ℝ[X]).coeff (m 0) ^ (m 0) *
      scaleFamilyWeight (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

lemma piScaledFin_scale {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamily (finDegreeList m) (piScaledFinEquiv m p) =
      piScaledFinEquiv m (fun i => scaleLeading (m i) (p i)) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    change (_ : Coeff 0) = _
    have : Subsingleton (Coeff 0) := (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective.subsingleton
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | succ k ih =>
    change (scaleLeading (m 0) (p 0),
      scaleFamily (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ))) = _
    rw [ih]
    rfl

lemma piScaledFin_dot {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p q : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList m))
      (piScaledFinEquiv m p) (piScaledFinEquiv m q) =
        ∑ i : Fin k, coefficientDot (m i+1) (p i) (q i) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    change (0 : ℝ) = ∑ i : Fin 0, coefficientDot (m i+1) (p i) (q i)
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    change coefficientDot (m 0+1) (p 0) (q 0) +
      familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => q i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I]

def piScaledEquiv (m : I → ℕ) :
    ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ScaledFamilyInput (degreeSequence m) :=
  (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft' ℝ (fun i => Coeff (m i+1)) (Fintype.equivFin I)).trans
    (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)))

lemma piScaled_polynomials (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m)) (piScaledEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => (monicPoly (p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)) : ℝ[X])) :=
  piScaledFin_polynomials _ _

lemma piScaled_weight (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamilyWeight (degreeSequence m) (piScaledEquiv m p) =
      ∏ i : I, (p i : ℝ[X]).coeff (m i) ^ (m i) := by
  have h := piScaledFin_weight (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
  exact h.trans ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm.prod_comp (fun i => (p i : ℝ[X]).coeff (m i)^m i))

lemma piScaled_scale (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamily (degreeSequence m) (piScaledEquiv m p) =
      piScaledEquiv m (fun i => scaleLeading (m i) (p i)) :=
  piScaledFin_scale _ _

lemma piScaled_dot (m : I → ℕ) (p q : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m))
      (piScaledEquiv m p) (piScaledEquiv m q) =
        ∑ i : I, coefficientDot (m i+1) (p i) (q i) := by
  have h := piScaledFin_dot (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => q ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
  exact h.trans ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm.sum_comp (fun i => coefficientDot (m i+1) (p i) (q i)))

lemma piScaled_product (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    (monicPoly (familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m)) (piScaledEquiv m p)) : ℝ[X]) =
      ∏ i : I, (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X]) := by
  rw [familyProduct_reconstruct,piScaled_polynomials,List.prod_ofFn]
  exact (Fintype.equivFin I).symm.prod_comp (fun i : I => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X]))

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.RateChart
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Charpoly.Basic

/-! The actual conservative bidirected compartment matrix. Edge rates and
original boundary-exit diagonals are retained; no transfer-function reduction
is performed in these definitions. -/
open Matrix Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The actual mass-conserving pair of directed transfers on one tree edge. -/
def edgeMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (e : Fin n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  x.1 e.succ • (Matrix.single (t.parent e) e.succ (1 : ℝ) - Matrix.single e.succ e.succ (1 : ℝ)) +
    x.2 e • (Matrix.single e.succ (t.parent e) (1 : ℝ) - Matrix.single (t.parent e) (t.parent e) (1 : ℝ))

/-- Edgewise construction of the actual compartment generator, with sole leak at 0. -/
def compartmentMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  (∑ e : Fin n, edgeMatrix t x e) - x.1 0 • Matrix.single 0 0 (1 : ℝ)

lemma sum_single_column {n : ℕ} (i j w : Fin (n+1)) (r : ℝ) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), (Matrix.single i j r) v w) = if j = w then r else 0 := by
  by_cases h : j = w
  · subst w
    simp [Matrix.single_apply]
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, h]

lemma directed_transfer_column_sum {n : ℕ} (i j w : Fin (n+1)) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1),
      (c • (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℝ) - Matrix.single j j (1 : ℝ))) v w) = 0 := by
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_single_column, sub_self]

lemma edgeMatrix_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (e : Fin n) (w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), edgeMatrix t x e v w) = 0 := by
  simp only [edgeMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [directed_transfer_column_sum, directed_transfer_column_sum, add_zero]

/-- Exact columnwise water conservation, for every real rate vector. -/
theorem compartment_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), compartmentMatrix t x v w) = if w = 0 then -x.1 0 else 0 := by
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [edgeMatrix_column_sum, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_sub,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_single_column]
  by_cases h : w = 0
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

/-- The vector field induced by the actual compartment matrix conserves total
water except for the root discharge. This is a matrix identity, not an ODE premise. -/
theorem compartment_total_flux {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (s : VertexValues n) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), (compartmentMatrix t x *ᵥ s) v) = -x.1 0 * s 0 := by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, compartment_column_sum]
  simp

lemma compartment_diagonal_edge {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (e : Fin n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    edgeMatrix t x e v v = -(if e.succ = v then x.1 e.succ else 0) -
      (if t.parent e = v then x.2 e else 0) := by
  have hp := parent_ne_child t e
  by_cases h1 : e.succ = v <;> by_cases h2 : t.parent e = v
  · exact False.elim (hp (h2.trans h1.symm))
  all_goals simp [edgeMatrix, Matrix.single_apply, h1, h2, eq_comm]

/-- The physical chart's d coordinate is the actual negative diagonal of A. -/
theorem compartment_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v v = -(rateChart t x).1 v := by
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [compartment_diagonal_edge]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  rw [rateChart]
  change -(∑ e : Fin n, if e.succ = v then x.1 e.succ else 0) -
      (∑ e : Fin n, if t.parent e = v then x.2 e else 0) -
      (x.1 0 • Matrix.single 0 0 (1 : ℝ)) v v = -(x.1 v + parentCLM t x.2 v)

  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) v
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
  · have hi : (0 : Fin (n+1)) ≠ i.succ := Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, hi, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]

/-- Every off-diagonal rate is nonnegative whenever the physical rates are. -/
theorem compartment_offdiag_nonneg {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ v, 0 ≤ x.1 v) (hf : ∀ e, 0 ≤ x.2 e)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) : 0 ≤ compartmentMatrix t x v w := by
  have hz : ∀ i : Fin (n+1), (Matrix.single i i (1 : ℝ)) v w = 0 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = v
    · subst i
      simp [Matrix.single_apply, hvw, Ne.symm hvw]
    · simp [Matrix.single_apply, hi, Ne.symm hi]
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, edgeMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.sub_apply,
    hz, sub_zero, mul_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro e _
  apply add_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (ha _)
    simp only [Matrix.single_apply]
    split <;> norm_num
  · apply mul_nonneg (hf _)
    simp only [Matrix.single_apply]
    split <;> norm_num

/-- Unreduced characteristic polynomial of the actual physical model. -/
def physicalCharacteristic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ[X] :=
  (compartmentMatrix t x).charpoly

/-- Actual root-principal minor, with the original diagonals retained. -/
def physicalRootCofactor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ[X] :=
  ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly

/-! Identification of the rate-coordinate Jacobian with coordinates extracted
from the actual compartment matrix, rather than a surrogate parameter map. -/
open Matrix Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma no_reversed_tree_edges {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (i j : Fin n) :
    ¬(j.succ = t.parent i ∧ t.parent j = i.succ) := by
  rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
  have hpi := t.parent_le i
  have hpj := t.parent_le j
  have h1v := congrArg Fin.val h1
  have h2v := congrArg Fin.val h2
  simp only [Fin.val_succ] at h1v h2v
  omega

lemma single_diagonal_offdiag {n : ℕ} (v w i : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    (Matrix.single i i (1 : ℝ)) v w = 0 := by
  apply Matrix.single_apply_of_ne
  rintro ⟨hi,hj⟩
  exact hvw (hi.symm.trans hj)

lemma compartment_offdiag_formula {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w =
      ∑ e : Fin n, (x.1 e.succ * (if t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w then 1 else 0) +
        x.2 e * (if e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w then 1 else 0)) := by
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, edgeMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, single_diagonal_offdiag v w _ hvw,
    mul_zero, sub_zero, Matrix.single_apply]

/-- The entry toward the parent is exactly its physical inward rate. -/
theorem compartment_inward_entry {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x (t.parent i) i.succ = x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x _ _ (parent_ne_child t i), Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [parent_ne_child t i, Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)]
  · intro j _ hji
    have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
    simp [hs, no_reversed_tree_edges t i j]
  · simp

/-- The entry away from the parent is exactly its physical outward rate. -/
theorem compartment_outward_entry {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x i.succ (t.parent i) = x.2 i := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x _ _ (Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)),
    Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [parent_ne_child t i, Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)]
  · intro j _ hji
    have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
    have hr : ¬(t.parent j = i.succ ∧ j.succ = t.parent i) := by
      rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
      exact no_reversed_tree_edges t i j ⟨h2,h1⟩
    simp [hs,hr]
  · simp

/-- Diagonal and edge-product coordinates read from the actual matrix. -/
def matrixRateCoordinates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : TreeRates n :=
  (fun v => -compartmentMatrix t x v v,
    fun i => compartmentMatrix t x (t.parent i) i.succ *
      compartmentMatrix t x i.succ (t.parent i))

/-- No physical-coordinate identification is left as an assumption. -/
theorem matrixRateCoordinates_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    matrixRateCoordinates t = rateChart t := by
  funext x
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext v
    simp [matrixRateCoordinates, compartment_diagonal]
  · funext i
    simp [matrixRateCoordinates, compartment_inward_entry, compartment_outward_entry, rateChart]

theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixRateCoordinates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (matrixRateCoordinates t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  rw [matrixRateCoordinates_eq]
  exact hasFDerivAt_rateChart t x

def matrixCoordinateJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fderiv ℝ (matrixRateCoordinates t) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- Actual matrix-coordinate Jacobian, all finite topologically numbered trees,
all real rates, including zero-rate degenerations and the one-vertex case. -/
theorem matrixCoordinateJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    matrixCoordinateJacobian t x = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [matrixCoordinateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_matrixRateCoordinates t x).fderiv,
    det_rateChartDerivative]

/-- The parent function fixes the root and follows the unique inward edge elsewhere. -/
def parentVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Fin (n+1) → Fin (n+1) :=
  Fin.cases 0 t.parent

lemma parentVertex_lt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (parentVertex t v).val < v.val := by
  revert hv
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i _ => ?_) v
  · intro h
    exact False.elim (h rfl)
  · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (t.parent_le i)

/-- The parent encoding really is connected to the root: no disconnected
component or directed cycle can enter the theorem through its hypotheses. -/
theorem parent_reaches_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, (parentVertex t)^[k] v = 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa using hv⟩
    · obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv)
      refine ⟨k+1, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply] using hk

end HydrologyTree

/-! Pointwise formulas for actual physical transfer entries, including the root.
No invertibility, positivity or nonzero transfer rate is assumed. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Extend edge data to vertices by assigning zero to the original root. -/
def outwardByVertex {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : VertexValues n := Fin.cases 0 f

@[simp] lemma outwardByVertex_zero {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : outwardByVertex f 0 = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma outwardByVertex_succ {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) (i : Fin n) :
    outwardByVertex f i.succ = f i := rfl

lemma sum_inward_transfer {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (a : VertexValues n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ e : Fin n, a e.succ * (if t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w then 1 else 0)) =
      if w = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t w = v then a w else 0 := by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) w
  · simp [Fin.succ_ne_zero]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [parentVertex, mul_ite] <;> rfl
    · intro j _ hji
      have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
      simp [hs]
    · simp

lemma sum_outward_transfer {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ e : Fin n, f e * (if e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w then 1 else 0)) =
      if v = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t v = w then outwardByVertex f v else 0 := by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) v
  · simp [Fin.succ_ne_zero]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [parentVertex, mul_ite] <;> rfl
    · intro j _ hji
      have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
      simp [hs]
    · simp

/-- Only the two directed edges relating a vertex and its parent contribute. -/
theorem compartment_offdiag_parent_formula {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w =
      (if w = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t w = v then x.1 w else 0) +
      (if v = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t v = w then outwardByVertex x.2 v else 0) := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v w hvw, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    sum_inward_transfer, sum_outward_transfer]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Canonical root-branch partition of the original parent-encoded finite tree.
This is combinatorial data independent of every rate parameter. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The unique first vertex after root 0 on the parent path of v; root maps to 0. -/
def rootBranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : Fin (n+1) :=
  if hv : v = 0 then 0
  else if parentVertex t v = 0 then v
  else rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v)
termination_by v.val
decreasing_by exact parentVertex_lt t v hv

@[simp] lemma rootBranchVertex_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    rootBranchVertex t 0 = 0 := by rw [rootBranchVertex]; simp

lemma rootBranchVertex_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v = 0) : rootBranchVertex t v = v := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

lemma rootBranchVertex_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v = rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v) := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

/-- A nonroot vertex belongs to a nonroot branch. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v ≠ 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

/-- The branch representative is always a direct child of the root. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_parent_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    parentVertex t (rootBranchVertex t v) = 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

abbrev RootChild {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0 ∧ parentVertex t v = 0}

abbrev BranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // rootBranchVertex t v = c.val}

lemma branchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    v.val ≠ 0 := by
  intro hv
  have hh := v.property
  rw [hv, rootBranchVertex_zero] at hh
  exact c.property.1 hh.symm

def branchRootVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) : BranchVertex t c :=
  ⟨c.val, rootBranchVertex_child t c.val c.property.1 c.property.2⟩

def rootPartitionMap {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Unit ⊕ (Σ c : RootChild t, BranchVertex t c) → Fin (n+1)
  | .inl _ => 0
  | .inr v => v.2.val

lemma rootPartitionMap_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Injective (rootPartitionMap t) := by
  intro u v h
  rcases u with u | ⟨c,u⟩ <;> rcases v with v | ⟨d,v⟩
  · cases u; cases v; rfl
  · exact False.elim (branchVertex_ne_zero t d v h.symm)
  · exact False.elim (branchVertex_ne_zero t c u h)
  · have hc : c = d := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact u.property.symm.trans ((congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h).trans v.property)
    subst d
    have huv : u = v := Subtype.ext h
    subst v
    rfl

lemma rootPartitionMap_surjective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Surjective (rootPartitionMap t) := by
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · exact ⟨.inl (), hv.symm⟩
  · let c : RootChild t := ⟨rootBranchVertex t v,
      rootBranchVertex_ne_zero t v hv, rootBranchVertex_parent_zero t v hv⟩
    exact ⟨.inr ⟨c,⟨v,rfl⟩⟩,rfl⟩

/-- Exact rate-independent reindexing of all vertices into root and child branches. -/
def rootPartitionEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Unit ⊕ (Σ c : RootChild t, BranchVertex t c) ≃ Fin (n+1) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (rootPartitionMap t) ⟨rootPartitionMap_injective t,rootPartitionMap_surjective t⟩

@[simp] lemma rootPartitionEquiv_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    rootPartitionEquiv t (.inl ()) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma rootPartitionEquiv_branch {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    rootPartitionEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) = v.val := rfl

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact sparsity of the physical tree matrix under its proved root-branch
partition. No partition of the matrix is assumed as a proof input. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma rootBranch_edge_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (e : Fin n)
    (hp : t.parent e ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t e.succ = rootBranchVertex t (t.parent e) := by
  exact rootBranchVertex_step t e.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero e) hp

/-- Distinct nonroot branches have no direct physical transfer in either direction. -/
theorem compartment_cross_branch_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hb : rootBranchVertex t v ≠ rootBranchVertex t w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w = 0 := by
  have hvw : v ≠ w := fun h => hb (congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v w hvw]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h1]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh.symm
  have h2 : ¬(e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h2]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh
  simp [h1,h2]

/-- Actual principal branch block, retaining the outgoing-to-root diagonal. -/
def physicalBranchMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Matrix (BranchVertex t c) (BranchVertex t c) ℝ :=
  (compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

/-- The reindexed physical matrix has the exact actual branch on each diagonal block. -/
theorem rootPartition_same_block {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v w : BranchVertex t c) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨c,w⟩) = physicalBranchMatrix t x c v w := rfl

/-- Every cross-block entry of the actual reindexed matrix vanishes. -/
theorem rootPartition_different_blocks {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c d : RootChild t) (hcd : c ≠ d) (v : BranchVertex t c) (w : BranchVertex t d) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨d,w⟩) = 0 := by
  apply compartment_cross_branch_zero t x v.val w.val
    (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v) (branchVertex_ne_zero t d w)
  intro h
  apply hcd
  exact Subtype.ext (v.property.symm.trans (h.trans w.property))

lemma parentVertex_succ {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (e : Fin n) :
    parentVertex t e.succ = t.parent e := rfl

/-- A nondirect descendant has no inward transfer to the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_column_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x 0 v = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x 0 v (Ne.symm hv)]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = 0 ∧ e.succ = v) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    apply hp
    rw [← h2, parentVertex_succ, h1]
  simp [h1, Fin.succ_ne_zero]

/-- A nondirect descendant receives no outward transfer directly from the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_row_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v 0 = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v 0 hv]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h2 : ¬(e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    apply hp
    rw [← h1, parentVertex_succ, h2]
  simp [h2, Fin.succ_ne_zero]

lemma branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (v : BranchVertex t c) (hvc : v.val ≠ c.val) : parentVertex t v.val ≠ 0 := by
  intro hp
  have h := rootBranchVertex_child t v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v) hp
  rw [v.property] at h
  exact hvc h.symm

/-- The root row meets a branch only at that branch's actual root vertex. -/
theorem rootPartition_root_to_branch {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    compartmentMatrix t x 0 v.val =
      if v.val = c.val then compartmentMatrix t x 0 c.val else 0 := by
  by_cases h : v.val = c.val
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact compartment_root_column_zero t x v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v)
      (branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero t c v h)

/-- The root column meets a branch only at that branch's actual root vertex. -/
theorem rootPartition_branch_to_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v.val 0 =
      if v.val = c.val then compartmentMatrix t x c.val 0 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : v.val = c.val
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact compartment_root_row_zero t x v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v)
      (branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero t c v h)

OrderedTree. The numbering and all parent data are independent of rates. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma rootBranchVertex_le {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    rootBranchVertex t v ≤ v := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · subst v; simp
    · by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
      · rw [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
      · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
        exact le_trans (ih _ (parentVertex_lt t v hv)) (le_of_lt (parentVertex_lt t v hv))

lemma branchRoot_min {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    branchRootVertex t c ≤ v := by
  change c.val ≤ v.val
  exact v.property.symm.le.trans (rootBranchVertex_le t v.val)

lemma branch_card_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    0 < Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (BranchVertex t c) := ⟨branchRootVertex t c⟩
  exact Fintype.card_pos

/-- Number of internal edges in the actual child subtree. -/
def childEdgeCount {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) - 1

lemma child_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) = childEdgeCount t c + 1 := by
  unfold childEdgeCount
  have := branch_card_pos t c
  omega

/-- Original vertex order induces a canonical increasing enumeration of a child. -/
def childEnumeration {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Fin (childEdgeCount t c + 1) ≃o BranchVertex t c :=
  Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq _ (child_card t c)

@[simp] theorem childEnumeration_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    childEnumeration t c 0 = branchRootVertex t c := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := (childEnumeration t c).surjective (branchRootVertex t c)
    rw [← hj]
    exact (childEnumeration t c).monotone (Fin.zero_le j)
  · exact branchRoot_min t c _

lemma childEnumeration_ne_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c)) : (childEnumeration t c i.succ).val ≠ c.val := by
  intro h
  have he : childEnumeration t c i.succ = childEnumeration t c 0 := by
    rw [childEnumeration_zero]
    exact Subtype.ext h
  exact Fin.succ_ne_zero i ((childEnumeration t c).injective he)

/-- The parent of a nonroot child vertex belongs to the same branch. -/
def childParentVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c)) : BranchVertex t c :=
  ⟨parentVertex t (childEnumeration t c i.succ).val, by
    have hv := branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ)
    have hp := branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ)
      (childEnumeration_ne_root t c i)
    exact (rootBranchVertex_step t _ hv hp).symm.trans (childEnumeration t c i.succ).property⟩

/-- The actual parent map in the child's own topological numbering. -/
def childTree {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) : OrderedTree (childEdgeCount t c) where
  parent i := (childEnumeration t c).symm (childParentVertex t c i)
  parent_le i := by
    have h : (childEnumeration t c).symm (childParentVertex t c i) < i.succ := by
      apply (childEnumeration t c).lt_iff_lt.mp
      rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
      exact parentVertex_lt t _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ))
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ h

@[simp] theorem childTree_parent_transport {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c)) :
    (childEnumeration t c ((childTree t c).parent i)).val =
      parentVertex t (childEnumeration t c i.succ).val := by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((childEnumeration t c).apply_symm_apply (childParentVertex t c i))

theorem childEdgeCount_lt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    childEdgeCount t c < n := by
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun v : BranchVertex t c =>
      (⟨v.val, branchVertex_ne_zero t c v⟩ : {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0})) := by
    intro v w h
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0} => z.val) h)
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hi
  have hnon : Fintype.card {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0} = n := by
    simp
  rw [hnon, child_card] at hc
  omega

end HydrologyTree

/-! Rate extraction preserves the actual exit-to-parent rate as the child's
single leak. All constructions are defined for every real rate vector. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Pull back inward rates (including the new root leak) and internal outward rates. -/
def childRates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :
    TreeRates (childEdgeCount t c) :=
  (fun i => x.1 (childEnumeration t c i).val,
    fun i => outwardByVertex x.2 (childEnumeration t c i.succ).val)

@[simp] theorem childRates_leak {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (childRates t c x).1 0 = x.1 c.val := by
  simp [childRates, branchRootVertex]

lemma childEnumeration_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Function.Injective (fun i => (childEnumeration t c i).val) := by
  intro i j h
  exact (childEnumeration t c).injective (Subtype.ext h)

lemma childParent_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (i j : Fin (childEdgeCount t c + 1)) :
    parentVertex t (childEnumeration t c j).val = (childEnumeration t c i).val ↔
      j ≠ 0 ∧ parentVertex (childTree t c) j = i := by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun e => ?_) j
  · rw [childEnumeration_zero]
    have h : parentVertex t (branchRootVertex t c).val = 0 := c.property.2
    rw [h]
    simp only [ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and, iff_false]
    exact Ne.symm (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i))
  · rw [← childTree_parent_transport t c e]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨Fin.succ_ne_zero e, childEnumeration_injective t c h⟩
    · intro h
      exact congrArg (fun k => (childEnumeration t c k).val) h.2

lemma childRates_outward {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c + 1)) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    outwardByVertex (childRates t c x).2 i = outwardByVertex x.2 (childEnumeration t c i).val := by
  revert hi
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun e _ => ?_) i
  · intro h; exact False.elim (h rfl)
  · rfl

/-- Every off-diagonal entry of a child generator equals its original principal-block entry. -/
theorem childMatrix_offdiag {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (i j : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    compartmentMatrix (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i j =
      compartmentMatrix t x (childEnumeration t c i).val (childEnumeration t c j).val := by
  have hne : (childEnumeration t c i).val ≠ (childEnumeration t c j).val :=
    fun h => hij (childEnumeration_injective t c h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hij,
    compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hne]
  have hi := branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i)
  have hj := branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c j)
  simp only [ite_eq_right hi, ite_eq_right hj, childParent_eq_iff]
  by_cases h0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases h1 : j = 0
  all_goals simp only [h0, h1, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and,
    not_false_eq_true, true_and, ite_true, ite_false]
  all_goals try rfl
  all_goals rw [childRates_outward t c x _ h0]
  all_goals rfl

end HydrologyTree

/-! Conservation in actual principal child blocks. The exit to the original
root becomes exactly one child leak; its value is not discarded or recomputed. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma root_inward_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x 0 c.val = x.1 c.val := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula t x 0 c.val (Ne.symm c.property.1)]
  simp only [ite_eq_right c.property.1, c.property.2, ite_true, add_zero]

lemma root_column_split {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (w : BranchVertex t c) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), compartmentMatrix t x v w.val) =
      compartmentMatrix t x 0 w.val +
      ∑ v : BranchVertex t c, compartmentMatrix t x v.val w.val := by
  classical
  rw [← (rootPartitionEquiv t).sum_comp (fun v => compartmentMatrix t x v w.val)]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  simp only [rootPartitionEquiv_root, rootPartitionEquiv_branch, Fintype.sum_unique]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single c]
  · intro d _ hdc
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro v _
    exact rootPartition_different_blocks t x d c hdc v w
  · simp

/-- Each actual principal child block loses mass only through its own root. -/
theorem physicalBranch_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (w : BranchVertex t c) :
    (∑ v : BranchVertex t c, physicalBranchMatrix t x c v w) =
      if w.val = c.val then -x.1 c.val else 0 := by
  have h := root_column_split t c x w
  rw [compartment_column_sum, ite_eq_right (branchVertex_ne_zero t c w),
    rootPartition_root_to_branch, root_inward_child] at h
  change (∑ v : BranchVertex t c, compartmentMatrix t x v.val w.val) = _
  by_cases hw : w.val = c.val
  · rw [ite_eq_left hw] at h ⊢
    linarith
  · rw [ite_eq_right hw] at h ⊢
    simpa using h.symm

/-- Column conservation after the canonical increasing child renumbering. -/
theorem childPrincipal_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (j : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    (∑ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
      compartmentMatrix t x (childEnumeration t c i).val (childEnumeration t c j).val) =
      if j = 0 then -x.1 c.val else 0 := by
  have h := (childEnumeration t c).toEquiv.sum_comp
    (fun v : BranchVertex t c => compartmentMatrix t x v.val (childEnumeration t c j).val)
  apply h.trans
  change (∑ v : BranchVertex t c, physicalBranchMatrix t x c v (childEnumeration t c j)) = _
  rw [physicalBranch_column_sum]
  have he : (childEnumeration t c j).val = c.val ↔ j = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply (childEnumeration t c).injective
      rw [childEnumeration_zero]
      exact Subtype.ext h
    · intro h
      subst j
      simp [branchRootVertex]
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left (he.mpr hj), ite_eq_left hj]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hj (he.mp h)), ite_eq_right hj]

end HydrologyTree

entry. Inverses are totalized at poles; true two-sided inverses are asserted
only under a checked nonzero determinant hypothesis. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma scalar_sub_principal {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      Matrix.scalar (Fin n) s - A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ := by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]

/-- Exact cofactor identity for the root entry of the adjugate. -/
lemma root_adjugate_eq_principal_det {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) :
    A.adjugate 0 0 = (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det := by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
  simp

/-- The actual root inverse entry equals the unreduced characteristic/cofactor
ratio. This algebraic identity uses the library's totalized inverse at poles. -/
theorem root_inverse_entry_eq {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A)⁻¹ 0 0 =
      (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly.eval s / A.charpoly.eval s := by
  rw [Matrix.inv_def]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  rw [root_adjugate_eq_principal_det, scalar_sub_principal,
    ← Matrix.eval_charpoly, ← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  ring

    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : A.charpoly.eval s ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A)⁻¹ * (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A) = 1 ∧
    (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A) * (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A)⁻¹ = 1 := by
  have hd : IsUnit (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A).det := by
    rw [← Matrix.eval_charpoly, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    exact hs
  exact ⟨Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hd, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hd⟩

/-- Root-resolvent entry of the actual conservative tree generator. -/
def physicalRootResponse {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - compartmentMatrix t x)⁻¹ 0 0

theorem physicalRootResponse_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (s : ℝ) :
    physicalRootResponse t x s =
      (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval s / (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s :=
  root_inverse_entry_eq _ _

/-- The target coefficient map reads actual matrix characteristic polynomials.
Its all-tree Jacobian factorization is not assumed or declared here. -/
def physicalCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Coeff (n+1) × Coeff n :=
  (cut (n+1) (physicalCharacteristic t x), cut n (physicalRootCofactor t x))

lemma physicalCharacteristic_monic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (physicalCharacteristic t x).Monic := Matrix.charpoly_monic _

lemma physicalCharacteristic_natDegree {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (physicalCharacteristic t x).natDegree = n+1 := by
  simp [physicalCharacteristic]

lemma physicalRootCofactor_monic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (physicalRootCofactor t x).Monic := Matrix.charpoly_monic _

lemma physicalRootCofactor_natDegree {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (physicalRootCofactor t x).natDegree = n := by
  simp [physicalRootCofactor]

/-- The output coefficients encode the entire actual characteristic polynomial. -/
theorem physicalCoefficientMap_first_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (monicPoly (physicalCoefficientMap t x).1 : ℝ[X]) = physicalCharacteristic t x :=
  monic_reconstruct _ (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x) (physicalCharacteristic_natDegree t x)

/-- The second output encodes the actual root cofactor, with boundary diagonals retained. -/
theorem physicalCoefficientMap_second_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (monicPoly (physicalCoefficientMap t x).2 : ℝ[X]) = physicalRootCofactor t x :=
  monic_reconstruct _ (physicalRootCofactor_monic t x) (physicalRootCofactor_natDegree t x)

end HydrologyTree

bidirected edge. The field lemma only uses invertibility of one block;

open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Ring
variable {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

lemma add_single_eq_updateRow (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    A + Matrix.single i j c = A.updateRow i (A i + Pi.single j c) := by
  ext k l
  by_cases h : k = i
  · subst k
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, h, Ne.symm h]

/-- The cofactor determinant identity at every matrix, singular or not. -/
theorem det_add_single (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    (A + Matrix.single i j c).det = A.det + c * A.adjugate j i := by
  rw [add_single_eq_updateRow, Matrix.det_updateRow_add]
  have hs : (Pi.single j c : ι → R) = c • Pi.single j 1 := by
    funext k
    simp [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]
  rw [hs, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul, ← Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  simp

theorem det_sub_single (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    (A - Matrix.single i j c).det = A.det - c * A.adjugate j i := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Matrix.single_neg, det_add_single]
  ring

end Ring

section Field
variable {K ι κ : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
  [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

/-- Attach arbitrary blocks through just the specified pair of directed entries.
The diagonals are NOT recomputed; existing exit rates remain in each block. -/
def edgeJoin (A : Matrix ι ι K) (B : Matrix κ κ K) (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : K) :
    Matrix (ι ⊕ κ) (ι ⊕ κ) K :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.single i j a) (Matrix.single j i f) B

no invertibility or nonsingularity of the other block is needed. -/
theorem det_edgeJoin_of_right_ne_zero
    (A : Matrix ι ι K) (B : Matrix κ κ K) (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : K)
    (hB : B.det ≠ 0) :

  letI : Invertible B := Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet B (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hB)
  rw [edgeJoin, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₂₂, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv,
    Matrix.single_mul_mul_single, det_sub_single]
  rw [Matrix.inv_def]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

end Field

def rootInwardRow {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix Unit (BranchNodesOf t) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun _ v => if v.2.val = v.1.val then compartmentMatrix t x 0 v.1.val else 0

def rootOutwardColumn {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (BranchNodesOf t) Unit ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun v _ => if v.2.val = v.1.val then compartmentMatrix t x v.1.val 0 else 0

def physicalRootBlockMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Unit ⊕ BranchNodesOf t) (Unit ⊕ BranchNodesOf t) ℝ :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.of fun (_ _ : Unit) => -(rateChart t x).1 0)
    (rootInwardRow t x) (rootOutwardColumn t x)
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun c : RootChild t => physicalBranchMatrix t x c))

all rate vectors, with original boundary-exit diagonals retained. -/

    (compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t) =
      physicalRootBlockMatrix t x := by
  ext u v
  rcases u with u | ⟨c,u⟩ <;> rcases v with v | ⟨d,v⟩
  · cases u
    cases v
    exact compartment_diagonal t x 0
  · cases u
    exact rootPartition_root_to_branch t x d v
  · cases v
    exact rootPartition_branch_to_root t x c u
  · by_cases h : c = d
    · subst d
      simpa only [physicalRootBlockMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
        Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq] using rootPartition_same_block t x c u v
    · simpa only [physicalRootBlockMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
        Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne _ u v h] using rootPartition_different_blocks t x c d h u v

open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] {V : C → Type*}
  [∀ c, Fintype (V c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (V c)]

/-- Determinant of a finite family of blocks of arbitrary, possibly different sizes. -/
theorem det_dependent_blocks {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (B : (c : C) → Matrix (V c) (V c) R) :
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).det = ∏ c, (B c).det := by
  rw [(Matrix.blockTriangular_blockDiagonal' B).det_fintype]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  let e : V c ≃ {z : Σ c, V c // z.1 = c} := (Equiv.sigmaSubtype c).symm
  have h := Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self e
    ((Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).toSquareBlock Sigma.fst c)
  apply h.symm.trans
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp [e, Matrix.toSquareBlock_def, Matrix.toSquareBlockProp, Equiv.sigmaSubtype]

lemma scalar_sub_dependent_blocks (B : (c : C) → Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    Matrix.scalar (Σ c, V c) s - Matrix.blockDiagonal' B =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun c => Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c) := by
  change Matrix.scalar (Σ c, V c) s - Matrix.blockDiagonal' B =
    Matrix.blockDiagonal' ((fun c => Matrix.scalar (V c) s) - B)
  rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_sub]
  congr 1
  ext ⟨c,i⟩ ⟨d,j⟩
  by_cases h : c = d
  · subst d
    simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  · simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne, h]

/-- The characteristic polynomial retains every diagonal block, even at shared roots. -/
theorem charpoly_dependent_blocks (B : (c : C) → Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ) :
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).charpoly = ∏ c, (B c).charpoly := by
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro s
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly, scalar_sub_dependent_blocks, det_dependent_blocks]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_prod, Matrix.eval_charpoly]

/-- A proved inverse identity, with nonzero block determinants stated explicitly. -/
theorem inverse_dependent_blocks (B : (c : C) → Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ c, (B c).det ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B)⁻¹ = Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun c => (B c)⁻¹) := by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal'_mul]
  have he : (fun c => (B c)⁻¹ * B c) = fun c => (1 : Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ) := by
    funext c
    exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hB c))
  rw [he]
  exact Matrix.blockDiagonal'_one

open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] {V : C → Type*}
  [∀ c, Fintype (V c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (V c)]

def arrowRow (r : ∀ c, V c) (a : C → ℝ) : Matrix Unit (Σ c, V c) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun _ z => if z.2 = r z.1 then a z.1 else 0

def arrowColumn (r : ∀ c, V c) (f : C → ℝ) : Matrix (Σ c, V c) Unit ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun z _ => if z.2 = r z.1 then f z.1 else 0

/-- The root diagonal is d and every branch block is retained unaltered. -/
def arrowMatrix (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) : Matrix (Unit ⊕ (Σ c, V c)) (Unit ⊕ (Σ c, V c)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.of fun _ _ => d) (arrowRow r a) (arrowColumn r f)
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B)

    (G : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ) (c : C) (i : V c) :

  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sigma, Finset.sum_eq_single c]
  · simp only [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq]
    simp [arrowRow, ite_mul]
  · intro d _ hdc
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne G j i hdc, mul_zero]
  · simp

    (G : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ) :

      ∑ c, a c * G c (r c) (r c) * f c := by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  simp only [arrowRow_mul_block]
  simp [arrowColumn, mul_ite]

    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) (hB : ∀ c, (B c).det ≠ 0) :
    (arrowMatrix d B r a f).det =

  have hd : (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det_dependent_blocks]

    Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd)

    inverse_dependent_blocks B hB, det_dependent_blocks, Matrix.det_unique, Matrix.sub_apply,

theorem det_arrowMatrix_cofactors (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)

  rw [det_arrowMatrix_inverse d B r a f hB, mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum]

    intro c _
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (B j).det) (Finset.mem_univ c),
      Matrix.inv_def]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    field_simp [hB c]
    <;> ring

    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : ℝ) :

      A.charpoly * B.charpoly - C (a*f) * diagonalCofactor A i * diagonalCofactor B j ∧
    diagonalCofactor (edgeJoin A B i j a f) (Sum.inl i) =
      diagonalCofactor A i * B.charpoly :=
