/-! Exact leaf deletion for the characteristic polynomial of a finite real
matrix. Retained principal diagonals include all original boundary-exit rates. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

abbrev DeletedVertex (l : ι) := {v : ι // v ≠ l}

/-- Explicit reindexing into the retained vertices and the deleted leaf. -/
def deleteVertexEquiv (l : ι) : DeletedVertex l ⊕ Unit ≃ ι where
  toFun := Sum.elim Subtype.val (fun _ => l)
  invFun v := if h : v = l then Sum.inr () else Sum.inl ⟨v,h⟩
  left_inv v := by
    rcases v with v | u
    · simp [Sum.elim, v.property]
    · cases u
      simp [Sum.elim]
  right_inv v := by
    by_cases h : v = l <;> simp [Sum.elim, h]

/-- Literal principal submatrix; its diagonal is not recalculated. -/
def deletedMatrix (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l : ι) :
    Matrix (DeletedVertex l) (DeletedVertex l) ℝ := A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

def singletonMatrix (d : ℝ) : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ := Matrix.of fun _ _ => d

@[simp] lemma singletonMatrix_charpoly (d : ℝ) :
    (singletonMatrix d).charpoly = X-C d := by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly, Matrix.det_unique]
  simp [singletonMatrix, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]

@[simp] lemma singletonMatrix_cofactor (d : ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor (singletonMatrix d) () = 1 := by
  rw [diagonalCofactor, Matrix.adjugate_subsingleton]
  rfl

lemma charpoly_submatrix_equiv (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    (A.submatrix e e).charpoly = A.charpoly := by
  exact Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm A

/-- A structurally isolated leaf gives the actual edge-join matrix after
reindexing. The premises describe zero entries only, not any determinant formula. -/
theorem leaf_matrix_decomposition (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l p : ι) (hp : p ≠ l)
    (hrow : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A l v = if v = p then A l p else 0)
    (hcol : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A v l = if v = p then A p l else 0) :
    A.submatrix (deleteVertexEquiv l) (deleteVertexEquiv l) =
      edgeJoin (deletedMatrix A l) (singletonMatrix (A l l)) ⟨p,hp⟩ () (A p l) (A l p) := by
  ext u v
  rcases u with u | u <;> rcases v with v | v
  · rfl
  · cases v
    simpa [edgeJoin, deleteVertexEquiv, Sum.elim, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.single_apply,
      Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hcol u.val u.property
  · cases u
    simpa [edgeJoin, deleteVertexEquiv, Sum.elim, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.single_apply,
      Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hrow v.val v.property
  · cases u
    cases v
    rfl

/-- The exact finite-matrix leaf recurrence, valid at all rates and eigenvalues. -/
theorem charpoly_delete_leaf (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l p : ι) (hp : p ≠ l)
    (hrow : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A l v = if v = p then A l p else 0)
    (hcol : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A v l = if v = p then A p l else 0) :
    A.charpoly = (X-C (A l l)) * (deletedMatrix A l).charpoly -
      C (A p l * A l p) * diagonalCofactor (deletedMatrix A l) ⟨p,hp⟩ := by
  rw [← charpoly_submatrix_equiv A (deleteVertexEquiv l),
    leaf_matrix_decomposition A l p hp hrow hcol, charpoly_edgeJoin,
    singletonMatrix_charpoly, singletonMatrix_cofactor]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

/-! The endpoint catenary is the original conservative OrderedTree matrix.
The root-tail recurrence is proved directly from every actual matrix entry. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The path 0--1--...--n, with leak and observation at vertex 0. -/
def pathTree (n : ℕ) : OrderedTree n where
  parent i := i.castSucc
  parent_le i := le_rfl

@[simp] lemma pathTree_parent (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : (pathTree n).parent i = i.castSucc := rfl

@[simp] lemma path_zero_ne_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : (0 : Fin (n+1)) ≠ i.succ := Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)

@[simp] lemma pathCast_zero (n : ℕ) : (0 : Fin (n+1)).castSucc = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pathParent_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    parentVertex (pathTree n) i.succ = i.castSucc := rfl

lemma pathCast_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n+1)) : i.castSucc = 0 ↔ i = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun j : Fin (n+2) => j.val) h)
  · intro h; subst i; rfl

lemma pathCast_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : i.succ.castSucc = i.castSucc.succ := rfl

lemma path_root_exit (n : ℕ) (f : EdgeValues (n+1)) : parentCLM (pathTree (n+1)) f 0 = f 0 := by
  rw [parentCLM_apply]
  simp only [pathTree_parent, pathCast_zero_iff]; simp

lemma path_tail_exit (n : ℕ) (f : EdgeValues n) (g : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    parentCLM (pathTree (n+1)) (Fin.cons g f) i.succ = parentCLM (pathTree n) f i := by
  rw [parentCLM_apply, parentCLM_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [pathTree_parent, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, pathCast_succ,
    Fin.succ_inj, pathCast_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, zero_add]
  rfl

lemma path_tail_offdiag (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (n+1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) i.succ j.succ =
      compartmentMatrix (pathTree n) y i j := by
  have hs : i.succ ≠ j.succ := fun h => hij (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hs,
    compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hij]
  simp only [pathParent_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, outwardByVertex_succ,
    prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_succ]
  revert hij
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun u => ?_) i
  · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun v _ => ?_) j
    · intro h; exact False.elim (h rfl)
    · simp only [pathParent_succ, pathCast_succ, pathCast_zero, outwardByVertex_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, ite_true, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, zero_add, add_zero, eq_self]
      rfl
  · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun v _ => ?_) j
    · intro h
      simp only [pathParent_succ, pathCast_succ, pathCast_zero, outwardByVertex_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, ite_true, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, zero_add, add_zero, eq_self]
      rfl
    · simp only [pathParent_succ, pathCast_succ, pathCast_zero, outwardByVertex_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, ite_true, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, zero_add, add_zero, eq_self]
      rfl

/-- The actual principal tail block is the smaller physical path, with its
exit-to-parent rate as its leak. No diagonal is reset or omitted. -/
theorem path_tail_matrix (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    (compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f)))).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      compartmentMatrix (pathTree n) y := by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, compartment_diagonal, rateChart,
      Pi.add_apply, prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_succ]
    rw [path_tail_exit]
  · exact path_tail_offdiag n y ell f i j h

lemma path_root_inward (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) 0 i.succ =
      if i = 0 then y.1 0 else 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ (path_zero_ne_succ i)]
  simp only [pathParent_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, ite_true,
    prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_succ, pathCast_zero_iff, add_zero, eq_self]
  by_cases h : i = 0 <;> simp [h]

lemma path_root_outward (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) i.succ 0 =
      if i = 0 then f else 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)]
  simp only [pathParent_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, ite_true,
    outwardByVertex_succ, prependRateEquiv_apply, pathCast_zero_iff, zero_add, eq_self]
  by_cases h : i = 0 <;> simp [h]

def pathRootTailEquiv (n : ℕ) : Unit ⊕ Fin (n+1) ≃ Fin (n+2) where
  toFun := Sum.elim (fun _ => 0) Fin.succ
  invFun := Fin.cases (.inl ()) Sum.inr
  left_inv z := by rcases z with u | i; cases u <;> rfl; rfl
  right_inv i := by refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

/-- Exact root-tail edge attachment of the original physical path matrix. -/
theorem path_matrix_attachment (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    (compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f)))).submatrix
      (pathRootTailEquiv n) (pathRootTailEquiv n) =
      edgeJoin (singletonMatrix (-(ell+f))) (compartmentMatrix (pathTree n) y) () 0 (y.1 0) f := by
  ext u v
  rcases u with u | i <;> rcases v with v | j
  · cases u; cases v
    change compartmentMatrix _ _ 0 0 = -(ell+f)
    rw [compartment_diagonal]
    change -(ell + parentCLM (pathTree (n+1)) (Fin.cons f y.2) 0) = -(ell+f)
    rw [path_root_exit]
    rfl
  · cases u
    change compartmentMatrix _ _ 0 j.succ = Matrix.single () 0 (y.1 0) () j
    rw [path_root_inward]
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · cases v
    change compartmentMatrix _ _ i.succ 0 = Matrix.single 0 () f i ()
    rw [path_root_outward]
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · exact congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ => A i j)
      (path_tail_matrix n y ell f)

/-- Root cofactor recursion for the actual unreduced path model. -/
theorem path_cofactor_recursion (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    physicalRootCofactor (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y := by
  rw [physicalRootCofactor, path_tail_matrix]
  rfl

/-- The complete physical characteristic recurrence, valid at every real rate. -/
theorem path_characteristic_recursion (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    physicalCharacteristic (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      (X+C (ell+f)) * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y -
        C (y.1 0*f) * physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) y := by
  rw [physicalCharacteristic, ← charpoly_submatrix_equiv _ (pathRootTailEquiv n),
    path_matrix_attachment, charpoly_edgeJoin, singletonMatrix_charpoly, singletonMatrix_cofactor,
    diagonalCofactor_zero]
  simp only [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, mul_one, physicalCharacteristic, physicalRootCofactor]

/-- Actual endpoint-path coefficient map in physical arrays. -/
def pathCoefficientMap (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : PathCoefficients n :=
  physicalCoefficientMap (pathTree n) x

theorem pathCoefficientMap_recursion (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    pathCoefficientMap (n+1) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      pathStepCoefficients ((pathCoefficientMap n y).1,
        ((ell+f, y.1 0*f), (pathCoefficientMap n y).2)) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change cut (n+2) (physicalCharacteristic _ _) = _
    rw [path_characteristic_recursion]
    change _ = cut (n+2) ((X+C (ell+f)) * (monicPoly (physicalCoefficientMap (pathTree n) y).1 : ℝ[X]) -
      C (y.1 0*f) * (monicPoly (physicalCoefficientMap (pathTree n) y).2 : ℝ[X]))
    rw [physicalCoefficientMap_first_reconstruct, physicalCoefficientMap_second_reconstruct]
  · change cut (n+1) (physicalRootCofactor _ _) = _
    rw [path_cofactor_recursion]
    rfl

end HydrologyTree

/-! Single-child root coupling, retaining the actual child leak as a linear
function of all child parameters. No leak is assumed constant or nonzero. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def scalarCouplingFiber (a : ℝ) : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
    (a • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)

lemma det_scalarCouplingFiber (a : ℝ) : LinearMap.det (scalarCouplingFiber a).toLinearMap = a := by
  let b := (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ)
  have he : LinearMap.toMatrix b b (scalarCouplingFiber a).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 1 0 (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ)) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scalarCouplingFiber]
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, he, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  simp

def scalarCoupling (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) : E × (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (z.1,(z.2.1+z.2.2,a z.1*z.2.2))

def scalarCouplingDerivative (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) ((0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (z.2.2 • a))
    (scalarCouplingFiber (a z.1))

theorem hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    HasFDerivAt (scalarCoupling a) (scalarCouplingDerivative a z) z := by
  let P : (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E _
  let L := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  let F := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  have hl := (L.hasFDerivAt (x := z)).add F.hasFDerivAt
  have hc := (a.hasFDerivAt.comp z P.hasFDerivAt).mul F.hasFDerivAt
  apply (P.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hl.prodMk hc)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + h.2.2 = 0 + (h.2.1+h.2.2)
      simp
    · change a z.1 * h.2.2 + z.2.2 * a h.1 = z.2.2 * a h.1 + a z.1 * h.2.2
      ring

theorem scalarCoupling_jacobian [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) : endJacobian (scalarCoupling a) z = a z.1 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling a z), scalarCouplingDerivative,
    endDet_lowerBlock, det_scalarCouplingFiber]
  simp

end HydrologyTree

is allowed; all coordinate changes are explicit linear permutations. -/

noncomputable section

  pathCoefficientEquiv n (pathCoefficientMap n (pathRateEquiv n z))

lemma normalizedPhysicalPath_zero : normalizedPhysicalPath 0 = id := by
  funext a
  letI : Subsingleton (Fin (0+1)) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (Fin 1))
  change ((cut 1 (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree 0) (singletonRateEquiv a)) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = a
  rw [cut_coeff 1 _ (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
  rw [physicalCharacteristic, Matrix.charpoly,
    Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin (0+1))]
  simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq, compartmentMatrix, singletonRateEquiv]

@[simp] lemma pathTransitionEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :

      (((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm z.1).1, (z.2,((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm z.1).2)) := rfl

  unfold normalizedPhysicalPath
  rw [pathRateEquiv_succ, pathCoefficientMap_recursion]
  unfold normalizedPathStep keepFunction scalarCoupling
  rw [pathTransitionEquiv_apply]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, pathLeak_apply]

    normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1) = normalizedPathStep n ∘
      (keepFunction (F := ℝ × ℝ) (normalizedPhysicalPath n) ∘ scalarCoupling (pathLeak n)) := by
  funext z
  exact normalizedPhysicalPath_succ n z

theorem differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedPhysicalPath n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_zero]; exact differentiable_id
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_succ_fun]
    intro z
    have hc := (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z).differentiableAt
    have hk := (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z) (ih z.1)).differentiableAt

    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1)) z =

        endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z.1 := by
  have hc := (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z).differentiableAt
  have hk := (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z)
    (differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n z.1)).differentiableAt
  rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_succ_fun,
    endJacobian_comp (differentiable_normalizedPathStep n _) (hk.comp z hc),
    endJacobian_comp hk hc, normalizedPathStep_jacobian,
    endJacobian_keepFunction (normalizedPhysicalPath n) (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z)
      (differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n z.1),
    scalarCoupling_jacobian]
  change (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * (pathLeak n z.1 * z.2.2)^n *
      (endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z.1 * pathLeak n z.1) = _
  rw [mul_pow, pow_succ]

    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z = pathOrientation n * pathWeight n z := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_zero, endJacobian]
    simp [pathOrientation, pathWeight]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian_succ, ih, pathOrientation, pathWeight]
    ring

/-- Recover the unnormalized actual coefficient map by inverse permutations. -/
lemma pathCoefficientMap_from_normalized (n : ℕ) : pathCoefficientMap n =
    fun x => (pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x)) := by
  funext x
  simp [normalizedPhysicalPath]

theorem differentiable_pathCoefficientMap (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) := by
  rw [pathCoefficientMap_from_normalized]
  intro x
  exact (pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp x
    ((differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n _).comp x
      (pathRateEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

end HydrologyTree

/-! Endpoint-catenary Jacobian for every finite size, evaluated on the actual
physical characteristic/root-cofactor coefficient map and original rate arrays.
The displayed bases only permute the explicitly defined scalar coordinates. -/
open Module Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def PathCoordinateIndex : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => Unit
  | n+1 => PathCoordinateIndex n ⊕ (Unit ⊕ Unit)

instance pathCoordinateFintype : (n : ℕ) → Fintype (PathCoordinateIndex n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (Fintype Unit)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathCoordinateFintype n
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (PathCoordinateIndex n ⊕ (Unit ⊕ Unit)))

instance pathCoordinateDecidableEq (n : ℕ) : DecidableEq (PathCoordinateIndex n) := Classical.decEq _

/-- Every basis vector is a single unscaled physical rate coordinate. -/
def pathRateBasis : (n : ℕ) → Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => Basis.singleton Unit ℝ
  | n+1 => (pathRateBasis n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ))

def catenaryInputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (TreeRates n) :=
  (pathRateBasis n).map (pathRateEquiv n)

def catenaryOutputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (PathCoefficients n) :=
  (pathRateBasis n).map (pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm

/-- The determinant of fderiv of the actual original path coefficient map. -/
def catenaryJacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryInputBasis n) (catenaryOutputBasis n)
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap).det

lemma toMatrix_coordinate_transport {E X Y I : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]
    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module ℝ Y] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (ein : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] X) (eout : Y ≃ₗ[ℝ] E) (L : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (b.map ein) (b.map eout.symm) L =
      LinearMap.toMatrix b b (eout.toLinearMap.comp (L.comp ein.toLinearMap)) := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Basis.map_repr]

/-- Exact transport from the common-coordinate induction to the actual derivative. -/
theorem normalizedPathJacobian_eq_catenary (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z = catenaryJacobian n (pathRateEquiv n z) := by
  have hc := (differentiable_pathCoefficientMap n (pathRateEquiv n z)).hasFDerivAt
  have h := (pathCoefficientEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hc.comp z (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt)
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z =
      (pathCoefficientEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        ((fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) (pathRateEquiv n z)).comp
          (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, hd, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (pathRateBasis n),
    catenaryJacobian, catenaryInputBasis, catenaryOutputBasis, toMatrix_coordinate_transport]
  rfl

/-- Full all-size endpoint-catenary formula, including every zero-rate boundary.
For n edges the inward exponents are n,n-1,...,1 and the outward exponents
are n-1,n-2,...,0. The root leak is unrestricted and contributes no factor. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_eq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x = pathOrientation n *
      ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by
  have h := normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x)
  rw [normalizedPathJacobian_eq_catenary, pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial] at h
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, pathRateMonomial] using h

/-- Orientation-free form of the same exact identity. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_sq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x ^ 2 =
      (∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)) ^ 2 := by
  rw [catenaryJacobian_eq, mul_pow, pathOrientation_sq, one_mul]

lemma pathOrientation_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : pathOrientation n ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hs := pathOrientation_sq n
  rw [h] at hs
  norm_num at hs

lemma pathRateMonomial_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    pathRateMonomial n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [pathRateMonomial, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i,_,hi⟩
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hi with ha | hf
    · left
      refine ⟨i,?_⟩
      by_contra h
      exact (pow_ne_zero _ h) ha
    · right
      have hp : 0 < n-i.val-1 := by
        by_contra h
        have he : n-i.val-1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
        rw [he, pow_zero] at hf
        exact one_ne_zero hf
      refine ⟨i, by omega, ?_⟩
      by_contra h
      exact (pow_ne_zero _ h) hf
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨i,ha⟩ | ⟨i,hi,hf⟩
    · refine ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,?_⟩
      have hp : n-i.val ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.isLt)
      simp [ha, hp]
    · refine ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,?_⟩
      have hp : n-i.val-1 ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp [hf, hp]

/-- Exact real singular set of the original unreduced coefficient map. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [catenaryJacobian_eq, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [pathOrientation_ne_zero, false_or]
  exact pathRateMonomial_zero_iff n x

/-- Inward rates and nonterminal outward rates are exactly the required nonzeros.
The last outward rate and root leak may vanish without Jacobian singularity. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0)
    (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n → x.2 i ≠ 0) : catenaryJacobian n x ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  rcases (catenaryJacobian_zero_iff n x).mp hz with (⟨i,hi⟩ | ⟨i,hi,h0⟩)
  · exact ha i hi
  · exact hf i hi h0

/-! Transport to the usual ascending coefficient and physical-array bases.
The conversion factor is explicit, nonzero and depends only on the number of
compartments, never on the rates. No change of the physical coefficient map. -/
open Module Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev CatenaryArrayIndex (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) ⊕ Fin n

def catenaryArrayInputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (CatenaryArrayIndex n) ℝ (TreeRates n) :=
  (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))

def catenaryArrayOutputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (CatenaryArrayIndex n) ℝ (PathCoefficients n) :=
  (degreeLT.basis ℝ (n+1)).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)

/-- Usual physical rate arrays and ascending non-leading P/F coefficients. -/
def catenaryCanonicalJacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- Explicit linear coefficient permutation, independent of all rate parameters. -/
def catenaryCoordinateReturn (n : ℕ) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  (pathCoefficientEquiv n).trans (pathRateEquiv n)

def catenaryCoordinateDet (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
    (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toLinearMap).det

lemma catenaryCoordinateDet_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : catenaryCoordinateDet n ≠ 0 := by
  let e := catenaryCoordinateReturn n
  have he : e.toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact e.apply_symm_apply x
  have hm := congrArg
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)) he
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (catenaryArrayInputBasis n), LinearMap.toMatrix_id] at hm
  have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hm
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_one] at hd
  intro hz
  change catenaryCoordinateDet n * _ = 1 at hd
  rw [hz, zero_mul] at hd
  exact zero_ne_one hd

lemma array_normalized_jacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    endJacobian (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) x =
      catenaryCoordinateDet n * catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x := by
  have h := (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (differentiable_pathCoefficientMap n x).hasFDerivAt
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) x =
      (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, hd, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ ((catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toLinearMap.comp
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap)).det = _
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (catenaryArrayInputBasis n), Matrix.det_mul]
  rfl

lemma catenaryCanonicalJacobian_transport (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCoordinateDet n * catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x =
      pathOrientation n * pathRateMonomial n x := by
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    (normalizedPhysicalPath n) x
    (differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x))
  have he : (fun y => (pathRateEquiv n) (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm y))) =
      (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) := by
    funext y
    simp [normalizedPhysicalPath, catenaryCoordinateReturn]
  change endJacobian (fun y => (pathRateEquiv n) (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm y))) x = _ at h
  rw [he, array_normalized_jacobian, normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian,
    pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial] at h
  have hh : (pathRateEquiv n) ((pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.symm x) = x :=
    (pathRateEquiv n).apply_symm_apply x
  rwa [hh] at h

/-- A fixed explicit nonzero constant for the chosen ascending coordinate order. -/
def catenaryCanonicalFactor (n : ℕ) : ℝ := pathOrientation n / catenaryCoordinateDet n

lemma catenaryCanonicalFactor_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : catenaryCanonicalFactor n ≠ 0 :=
  div_ne_zero (pathOrientation_ne_zero n) (catenaryCoordinateDet_ne_zero n)

/-- In standard ascending coefficient and physical-array coordinates, the exact
Jacobian has precisely the conjectured monomial, with an explicit nonzero
size-dependent constant. There are no additional parameter-dependent factors. -/
theorem catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = catenaryCanonicalFactor n *
      ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by
  have h := catenaryCanonicalJacobian_transport n x
  have he : catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x =
      (pathOrientation n * pathRateMonomial n x) / catenaryCoordinateDet n := by
    apply (eq_div_iff (catenaryCoordinateDet_ne_zero n)).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  rw [he, catenaryCanonicalFactor, pathRateMonomial]
  ring

/-- Exact standard-coordinate singular locus, including the zero-rate boundary. -/
theorem catenaryCanonicalJacobian_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [catenaryCanonicalFactor_ne_zero, false_or]
  exact pathRateMonomial_zero_iff n x

end HydrologyTree

standard coefficient coordinates with standard real rate-shaped arrays; it
introduces no parameter-dependent normalization or surrogate model. -/

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Ascending characteristic and cofactor coefficients, as ordinary coordinate arrays. -/
def coefficientArrayEquiv (n : ℕ) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  (degreeLTEquiv ℝ (n+1)).prodCongr (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)

@[simp] lemma coefficientArrayEquiv_first (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients n) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    (coefficientArrayEquiv n p).1 i = (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

@[simp] lemma coefficientArrayEquiv_second (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients n) (i : Fin n) :
    (coefficientArrayEquiv n p).2 i = (p.2 : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

lemma coefficientArrayEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    physicalRateDot n (coefficientArrayEquiv n p) (coefficientArrayEquiv n q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := rfl

lemma toMatrix_coefficientArrayEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
      (coefficientArrayEquiv n).toLinearMap = 1 := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, catenaryArrayInputBasis, catenaryArrayOutputBasis,
      coefficientArrayEquiv, Matrix.one_apply, Polynomial.degreeLT.basis_repr, Fin.val_inj]

/-- Actual coefficient map in standard rate-shaped coordinate arrays. -/

  coefficientArrayEquiv n (physicalCoefficientMap t x)

/-- The original coefficient-map Jacobian in standard ascending bases. -/
def treeCanonicalJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x).toLinearMap).det

lemma normalizedPhysicalTree_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalTree t) x = treeCanonicalJacobian t x := by
  have h := (coefficientArrayEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    hx.hasFDerivAt
  calc
    _ = LinearMap.det ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x)).toLinearMap := endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt h
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)]
      change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).toLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x).toLinearMap)).det = _
      rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
        (catenaryArrayInputBasis n), Matrix.det_mul, toMatrix_coefficientArrayEquiv,
        Matrix.det_one, one_mul]

/-! Exact bijective preparation of independent physical child coefficient arrays,
connector scales, and a root diagonal for the proved all-arity local coefficient
map. No independence or dimension matching is postulated. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I]

abbrev IndependentChildData (m : I → ℕ) := ((i : I) → TreeRates (m i)) × (ℝ × (I → ℝ))
abbrev IndependentChildPolynomials (m : I → ℕ) :=
  ((i : I) → PathCoefficients (m i)) × (ℝ × (I → ℝ))
abbrev IndependentSlots (m : I → ℕ) :=
  (((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) × ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1))) × ℝ

/-- Only regrouping, before the independent leading-coefficient equivalences. -/
def childSlotRegroup (m : I → ℕ) : IndependentChildPolynomials m ≃ₗ[ℝ]
    ((((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) × ((i : I) → ℝ × Coeff (m i))) × ℝ) where
  toFun z := ((fun i => (z.1 i).1,fun i => (z.2.2 i,(z.1 i).2)),z.2.1)
  invFun z := (fun i => (z.1.1 i,(z.1.2 i).2),(z.2,fun i => (z.1.2 i).1))
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- Pair child lower cofactor coefficients with their independent connector scale. -/
def childPolynomialSlots (m : I → ℕ) : IndependentChildPolynomials m ≃ₗ[ℝ] IndependentSlots m :=
  (childSlotRegroup m).trans
    (((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1))).prodCongr
      (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun i => leadingEquiv (m i)))).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ))

/-- Fixed-rate-independent equivalence into the actual gluing/root coefficient spaces. -/
def prepareFamilyEquiv (m : I → ℕ) : IndependentChildData m ≃ₗ[ℝ] BranchStepInputs (degreeSequence m) :=
  (((LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun i => (coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm)).prodCongr
    (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × (I → ℝ)))).trans (childPolynomialSlots m)) |>.trans
      (((piScaledEquiv m).prodCongr (piScaledEquiv m)).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ))

lemma prepareFamilyEquiv_apply (m : I → ℕ) (z : IndependentChildData m) :
    prepareFamilyEquiv m z =
      ((piScaledEquiv m (fun i => ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (z.1 i)).1),
        piScaledEquiv m (fun i => leadingEquiv (m i)
          (z.2.2 i,((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (z.1 i)).2))),z.2.1) := rfl

/-- Root coordinates and every child coordinate are serialized without rescaling. -/
def independentChildDot (m : I → ℕ) (x y : IndependentChildData m) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : I, physicalRateDot (m i) (x.1 i) (y.1 i)) + x.2.1*y.2.1 + ∑ i : I, x.2.2 i*y.2.2 i

def branchInputDot (ms : List ℕ) (x y : BranchStepInputs ms) : ℝ :=
  familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) x.1.1 y.1.1 +
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) x.1.2 y.1.2 + x.2*y.2

lemma coefficientArrayEquiv_symm_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) :
    pathCoefficientDot n ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm x) ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm y) =
      physicalRateDot n x y := by
  have h := coefficientArrayEquiv_dot n ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm x)
    ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm y)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- Coordinate preparation is an unscaled permutation in the actual coefficient
Euclidean bilinear form. This later certifies determinant magnitude one. -/
theorem prepareFamilyEquiv_dot (m : I → ℕ) (x y : IndependentChildData m) :
    branchInputDot (degreeSequence m) (prepareFamilyEquiv m x) (prepareFamilyEquiv m y) =
      independentChildDot m x y := by
  rw [branchInputDot,prepareFamilyEquiv_apply,prepareFamilyEquiv_apply,piScaled_dot,piScaled_dot]
  simp only [leadingEquiv_dot,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  unfold independentChildDot
  have h : (∑ i : I, physicalRateDot (m i) (x.1 i) (y.1 i)) =
      (∑ i : I, coefficientDot (m i+1)
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (x.1 i)).1
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (y.1 i)).1) +
      (∑ i : I, coefficientDot (m i)
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (x.1 i)).2
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (y.1 i)).2) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact (coefficientArrayEquiv_symm_dot (m i) (x.1 i) (y.1 i)).symm
  rw [h]
  ring

/-- The local scaling factors are exactly the given connector products, not
coefficients introduced by an unproved change of basis. -/
theorem prepareFamilyEquiv_scaleWeight (m : I → ℕ) (z : IndependentChildData m) :
    scaleFamilyWeight (degreeSequence m) (prepareFamilyEquiv m z).1.2 = ∏ i : I, (z.2.2 i) ^ m i := by
  rw [prepareFamilyEquiv_apply,piScaled_weight]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h := split_joinLeading (z.2.2 i,((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (z.1 i)).2)
  exact congrArg (fun c : ℝ => c ^ m i) (congrArg Prod.fst h)

end HydrologyTree

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev NumberedChildNodes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  Σ c : RootChild t, Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)

/-- Exact reindexing from the original vertices to root and numbered children. -/
def numberedRootEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Unit ⊕ NumberedChildNodes t ≃ Fin (n+1) :=
  (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit)
    (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight fun c => (childEnumeration t c).toEquiv)).trans (rootPartitionEquiv t)

@[simp] theorem numberedRootEquiv_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    numberedRootEquiv t (.inl ()) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] theorem numberedRootEquiv_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    numberedRootEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,i⟩) = (childEnumeration t c i).val := rfl

/-- Each nonroot vertex labels precisely one outward rate, including connector edges. -/
def numberedEdgeIndex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : NumberedChildNodes t) : Fin n :=
  (childEnumeration t z.1 z.2).val.pred (branchVertex_ne_zero t z.1 _)

@[simp] lemma numberedEdgeIndex_succ {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : NumberedChildNodes t) :
    (numberedEdgeIndex t z).succ = (childEnumeration t z.1 z.2).val := Fin.succ_pred _ _

lemma numberedEdgeIndex_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Injective (numberedEdgeIndex t) := by
  intro z w h
  have hs := congrArg Fin.succ h
  rw [numberedEdgeIndex_succ, numberedEdgeIndex_succ] at hs
  have he : numberedRootEquiv t (.inr z) = numberedRootEquiv t (.inr w) := hs
  exact Sum.inr_injective ((numberedRootEquiv t).injective he)

lemma numberedEdgeIndex_surjective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Surjective (numberedEdgeIndex t) := by
  intro e
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (numberedRootEquiv t).surjective e.succ
  rcases z with u | z
  · cases u
    exact False.elim (Fin.succ_ne_zero e hz.symm)
  · refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.succ_injective
    exact (numberedEdgeIndex_succ t z).trans hz

/-- This is a bijection, not an assumption that the extracted rates are independent. -/
def numberedEdgeEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : NumberedChildNodes t ≃ Fin n :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (numberedEdgeIndex t)
    ⟨numberedEdgeIndex_injective t, numberedEdgeIndex_surjective t⟩

theorem outward_at_numbered_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    f (numberedEdgeEquiv t ⟨c,i⟩) = outwardByVertex f (childEnumeration t c i).val := by
  rw [← numberedEdgeIndex_succ t ⟨c,i⟩]
  rfl

/-- Exact dimension count for the complete child partition. -/
theorem sum_child_vertices {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    (∑ c : RootChild t, (childEdgeCount t c+1)) = n := by
  have h := Fintype.card_congr (numberedEdgeEquiv t)
  simpa only [Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_fin] using h

end HydrologyTree

edge products. Its Jacobian is proved at zero rates, without dividing by leaks. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {C Y : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]

def sumCoordinates : (C → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ∑ c : C, ContinuousLinearMap.proj c

@[simp] lemma sumCoordinates_apply (f : C → ℝ) : sumCoordinates f = ∑ c, f c := by
  simp [sumCoordinates]

/-- With the child rates frozen, the root leak has coefficient one and each
connector has coefficient equal to its child leak. -/
def couplingFiber (a : C → ℝ) : (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)) +
    sumCoordinates.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c => a c •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)))

    couplingFiber a z = (z.1 + ∑ c, z.2 c, fun c => a c * z.2 c) := by
  simp [couplingFiber]

    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C))
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)) (couplingFiber a).toLinearMap =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) (Matrix.of fun _ _ => 1) 0 (Matrix.diagonal a) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, couplingFiber, sumCoordinates,
      Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply,
      Pi.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C))
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)) (couplingFiber a).toLinearMap).det =
      ∏ c, a c := by
  rw [toMatrix_couplingFiber, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  simp

def couplingCross (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (f : C → ℝ) : Y →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) :=
  (0 : Y →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c => f c • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp a)

def rootCouplingDerivative (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (z : Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :
    (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) →L[ℝ] (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Y) (couplingCross a z.2.2) (couplingFiber (a z.1))

/-- Actual derivative, including changes of child leaks with child parameters. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (z : Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :
    HasFDerivAt (rootCoupling a) (rootCouplingDerivative a z) z := by
  let P : (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) →L[ℝ] Y := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ Y _
  let Q : (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ Y _
  let L := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)).comp Q
  let F := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)).comp Q
  have hd := L.hasFDerivAt.add (sumCoordinates.hasFDerivAt.comp z F.hasFDerivAt)
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun w => fun c => a (P w) c * F w c)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c =>
        a (P z) c • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp F +
        F z c • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp (a.comp P)) z := by
    apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro c
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp (a.comp P)).hasFDerivAt.mul
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp F).hasFDerivAt
  apply (P.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hd.prodMk hc)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + sumCoordinates h.2.2 = 0 + (h.2.1 + sumCoordinates h.2.2)
      simp
    · funext c
      change a z.1 c * h.2.2 c + z.2.2 c * a h.1 c =

/-- The missing connector factor is exactly the product of the child leaks,
even if some or every leak is zero. -/
theorem det_rootCouplingDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ Y) (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (z : Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)))

    (b : Basis ι ℝ Y) (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (z : Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)))

  rw [(hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling a z).fderiv, det_rootCouplingDerivative]

  constructor
  · intro hp

    have he := (childEnumeration t c i).property.symm.trans h

  simp only [numberedEdge_parent, childEnumeration_parent_zero_iff]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · rw [ite_eq_left rfl, outward_at_numbered_child t f c 0, childEnumeration_zero]
    rfl
  · intro i _ hi
    exact ite_eq_right hi
  · simp

namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

def branchNumeratorSum (P R : I → ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X] :=
  ∑ i : I, R i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j

theorem coprime_branch_numerators_unique (P R S : I → ℝ[X])

    (hR : ∀ i, (R i).degree < (P i).degree)
    (hS : ∀ i, (S i).degree < (P i).degree)

    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

    apply Finset.dvd_sum

    apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_right

  have hterm : (R i-S i) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) =
      -(∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (R j-S j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, P k) := by
    linear_combination he
  have hdiv : P i ∣ (R i-S i) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) := by
    rw [hterm]
    exact dvd_neg.mpr hd

    apply IsCoprime.prod_right

    intro j hj

  have hdiv : P i ∣ (R i-S i) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using dvd_sub hall hd
  have hc : IsCoprime (P i) (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) := by
    apply IsCoprime.prod_right
    intro j hj
    exact hP i j (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)
  have hdiff : (R i-S i).degree < (P i).degree :=
    (Polynomial.degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (max_lt (hR i) (hS i))
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Polynomial.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt
    (hc.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdiv) hdiff)

/-- A monic polynomial times a nonzero scalar is recovered completely, including
its scale, from its actual coefficients. -/
theorem scalar_monic_polynomial_unique (P Q : ℝ[X]) (hP : P.Monic) (hQ : Q.Monic)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : C a * P = C b * Q) : a = b ∧ P = Q := by
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb
    rw [hb, map_zero, zero_mul] at h
    exact (mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr ha) hP.ne_zero) h
  have hc := congrArg Polynomial.leadingCoeff h
  simp only [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C, hP.leadingCoeff,
    hQ.leadingCoeff, mul_one] at hc
  refine ⟨hc,?_⟩
  rw [← hc] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr ha) h

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.ScaledSerialization
import HydrologyTree.CoprimeBranchRecovery

/-! The serialized all-child numerator is the actual finite sum over original
child indices, including zero factors. No cancellation or divisions are used. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma product_erase_eq_product_ite {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (P : I → ℝ[X]) (i : I) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) = ∏ j : I, if j=i then 1 else P j := by
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => if j=i then 1 else P j) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [ite_true,one_mul]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact (if_neg (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1).symm

lemma branchNumeratorSum_ite {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (P R : I → ℝ[X]) :
    branchNumeratorSum P R = ∑ i : I, R i * ∏ j : I, if j=i then 1 else P j := by
  simp only [branchNumeratorSum, product_erase_eq_product_ite]

lemma product_erase_fin_zero {k : ℕ} (P : Fin (k+1) → ℝ[X]) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (0 : Fin (k+1)), P j) = ∏ i : Fin k, P i.succ := by
  rw [product_erase_eq_product_ite,Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [ite_true,Fin.succ_ne_zero,ite_false,one_mul]

lemma product_erase_fin_succ {k : ℕ} (P : Fin (k+1) → ℝ[X]) (i : Fin k) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i.succ, P j) =
      P 0 * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j.succ := by
  rw [product_erase_eq_product_ite,Fin.prod_univ_succ,
    product_erase_eq_product_ite]
  have hz : (0 : Fin (k+1)) ≠ i.succ := Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)
  simp only [hz,ite_false,Fin.succ_inj]

lemma branchNumeratorSum_fin_succ {k : ℕ} (P R : Fin (k+1) → ℝ[X]) :
    branchNumeratorSum P R = R 0 * (∏ i : Fin k, P i.succ) +
      P 0 * branchNumeratorSum (fun i : Fin k => P i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => R i.succ) := by
  rw [branchNumeratorSum,Fin.sum_univ_succ,product_erase_fin_zero]
  congr 1
  rw [branchNumeratorSum,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [product_erase_fin_succ]
  ring

lemma serializedFinNumerator {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p r : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList m))
      (piScaledFinEquiv m p) (piScaledFinEquiv m r) =
      branchNumeratorSum (fun i => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) (fun i => (r i : ℝ[X])) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    change (0 : ℝ[X]) = ∑ i : Fin 0, _
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [branchNumeratorSum_fin_succ]
    change (r 0 : ℝ[X]) *
      (monicPoly (familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ))) : ℝ[X]) +
      (monicPoly (p 0) : ℝ[X]) *
        familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))
          (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ))
          (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => r i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih,familyProduct_reconstruct,piScaledFin_polynomials,List.prod_ofFn]

lemma branchNumeratorSum_equiv {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (e : I ≃ J) (P R : J → ℝ[X]) :
    branchNumeratorSum (fun i => P (e i)) (fun i => R (e i)) = branchNumeratorSum P R := by
  rw [branchNumeratorSum_ite,branchNumeratorSum_ite]
  rw [← e.sum_comp (fun j => R j * ∏ k : J, if k=j then 1 else P k)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 1
  rw [← e.prod_comp (fun k => if k=e i then 1 else P k)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]

/-- No original child is lost, repeated or assigned a spurious numerator. -/
theorem serializedNumerator {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (m : I → ℕ) (p r : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m)) (piScaledEquiv m p) (piScaledEquiv m r) =
      branchNumeratorSum (fun i => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) (fun i => (r i : ℝ[X])) := by
  change familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList _))
    (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)))
    (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => r ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))) = _
  rw [serializedFinNumerator]
  exact branchNumeratorSum_equiv (Fintype.equivFin I).symm
    (fun i : I => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) (fun i : I => (r i : ℝ[X]))

end HydrologyTree

/-! The actual derivative determinant of independent children of different
sizes. The module proves, rather than assumes, heterogeneous Jacobian multiplication. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
variable {E : I → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)]
  [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℝ (E i)]

def dependentPiEnd (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i) : (i : I) → E i :=
  fun i => f i (z i)

def dependentPiFDeriv (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i) :
    ((i : I) → E i) →L[ℝ] ((i : I) → E i) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun i => (fderiv ℝ (f i) (z i)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i)

theorem hasFDerivAt_dependentPiEnd (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i)
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) (z i)) :
    HasFDerivAt (dependentPiEnd f) (dependentPiFDeriv f z) z := by
  apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  exact (hf i).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : ((j : I) → E j) →L[ℝ] E i).hasFDerivAt

lemma determinant_dependentPi (L : (i : I) → E i →ₗ[ℝ] E i) :
    (LinearMap.pi (fun i => (L i).comp (LinearMap.proj i))).det = ∏ i : I, (L i).det := by
  let b := fun i : I => Module.finBasis ℝ (E i)
  have hM : LinearMap.toMatrix (Pi.basis b) (Pi.basis b)
      (LinearMap.pi (fun i => (L i).comp (LinearMap.proj i))) =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => LinearMap.toMatrix (b i) (b i) (L i)) := by
    ext ⟨i,a⟩ ⟨j,c⟩
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Pi.basis_apply, Pi.basis_repr]
    · simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Pi.basis_apply, Pi.basis_repr,
        Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne, h, Ne.symm h]
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (Pi.basis b), hM, det_dependent_blocks]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => LinearMap.det_toMatrix (b i) (L i))

/-- The full Fréchet determinant of the actual independent-child transformation. -/
theorem endJacobian_dependentPiEnd (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i)
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) (z i)) :
    endJacobian (dependentPiEnd f) z = ∏ i : I, endJacobian (f i) (z i) := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_dependentPiEnd f z hf)]
  exact determinant_dependentPi (fun i => (fderiv ℝ (f i) (z i)).toLinearMap)

end HydrologyTree

proved to be a fixed sign, not an unspecified nonzero normalization constant. -/
open Polynomial Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma arrayInput_basisDot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) :
    basisDot (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) x y = physicalRateDot n x y := by
  simp [basisDot, catenaryArrayInputBasis, physicalRateDot]

lemma arrayOutput_basisDot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    basisDot (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) p q = pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  simp [basisDot, catenaryArrayOutputBasis, pathCoefficientDot, coefficientDot,
    Polynomial.degreeLT.basis_repr]

/-- The two actual coordinate rearrangements are unscaled; no numerical determinant
or finite-dimensional sample is used to certify the normalization. -/
theorem catenaryCoordinateDet_sq (n : ℕ) : catenaryCoordinateDet n ^ 2 = 1 := by
  apply det_sq_of_basisDot_preserved (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
  intro p q
  rw [arrayInput_basisDot, arrayOutput_basisDot]
  change physicalRateDot n (pathRateEquiv n (pathCoefficientEquiv n p))
    (pathRateEquiv n (pathCoefficientEquiv n q)) = pathCoefficientDot n p q
  rw [pathRateEquiv_dot, pathCoefficientEquiv_dot]

/-- The standard-coordinate normalization constant has magnitude exactly one. -/
theorem catenaryCanonicalFactor_sq (n : ℕ) : catenaryCanonicalFactor n ^ 2 = 1 := by
  rw [catenaryCanonicalFactor, div_pow, pathOrientation_sq, catenaryCoordinateDet_sq]
  norm_num

lemma real_sq_one_sign (c : ℝ) (hc : c^2 = 1) : c = 1 ∨ c = -1 := by
  have h : (c-1)*(c+1) = 0 := by nlinarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
  · left; linarith
  · right; linarith

/-- A sign independent of every rate vector, for every number n+1 of compartments.
This is the actual physical coefficient-map determinant in standard ascending
P/F coefficient and physical-array bases, including all zero-rate boundaries. -/
theorem catenary_standard_jacobian (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧ ∀ x : TreeRates n,
      catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = ε *
        ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by
  exact ⟨catenaryCanonicalFactor n,
    real_sq_one_sign _ (catenaryCanonicalFactor_sq n), catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq n⟩

/-- Orientation-free exact polynomial identity for the actual canonical Jacobian. -/
theorem catenary_standard_jacobian_sq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x ^ 2 =
      (∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)) ^ 2 := by
  rw [catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq, mul_pow, catenaryCanonicalFactor_sq, one_mul]

/-- Exact singular locus in standard physical and polynomial coordinates. -/
theorem catenary_standard_singular_locus (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) :=
  catenaryCanonicalJacobian_zero_iff n x

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.DependentJacobian

/-! Rate-independent preparation and coefficient return for the ACTUAL physical
branching tree. Sizes, coefficient identities and coordinate normalization are proved. -/
open Polynomial Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev TreeBranchDegrees {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) := degreeSequence (childEdgeCount t)
abbrev TreeWork {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) := IndependentChildData (childEdgeCount t)

lemma treeBranchDegree_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    (ChildFactorDegrees (TreeBranchDegrees t)).sum = n := by
  rw [← degreeSequence_addOne,degreeSequence_sum,sum_child_vertices]

def pathCoefficientsCast {n m : ℕ} (h : n=m) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathCoefficients m := by
  subst m
  exact LinearEquiv.refl ℝ _

lemma pathCoefficientsCast_cut {n m : ℕ} (h : n=m) (P F : ℝ[X]) :
    pathCoefficientsCast h (cut (n+1) P,cut n F) = (cut (m+1) P,cut m F) := by
  subst m
  rfl

lemma pathCoefficientsCast_dot {n m : ℕ} (h : n=m) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    pathCoefficientDot m (pathCoefficientsCast h p) (pathCoefficientsCast h q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  subst m
  rfl

/-- The actual parent coefficient output, in the same independent-child coordinates
as the input. All constituent transformations are fixed linear equivalences. -/
def parentCoefficientWorkEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeWork t :=
  ((pathCoefficientsCast (treeBranchDegree_sum t).symm).trans
    (branchCoefficientEquiv (TreeBranchDegrees t))).trans (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).symm

lemma parentCoefficientWorkEquiv_dot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    independentChildDot (childEdgeCount t) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t p) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  rw [← prepareFamilyEquiv_dot]
  have hp : prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t p) =
      branchCoefficientEquiv (TreeBranchDegrees t) (pathCoefficientsCast (treeBranchDegree_sum t).symm p) := by
    exact (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).apply_symm_apply _
  have hq : prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t q) =
      branchCoefficientEquiv (TreeBranchDegrees t) (pathCoefficientsCast (treeBranchDegree_sum t).symm q) := by
    exact (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).apply_symm_apply _
  rw [hp,hq]
  change _ = pathCoefficientDot n p q
  rw [branchInputDot,branchCoefficientEquiv_dot,pathCoefficientsCast_dot]

/-- Return the parent coefficient array to the original physical coordinate array. -/
def treeCoordinateReturn {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t).trans (originalWorkEquiv t).symm

lemma treeCoordinateReturn_dot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    physicalRateDot n (treeCoordinateReturn t p) (treeCoordinateReturn t q) = pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  rw [← originalWorkEquiv_dot t]
  have hp : originalWorkEquiv t (treeCoordinateReturn t p) = parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t p :=
    (originalWorkEquiv t).apply_symm_apply _
  have hq : originalWorkEquiv t (treeCoordinateReturn t q) = parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t q :=
    (originalWorkEquiv t).apply_symm_apply _
  rw [hp,hq,parentCoefficientWorkEquiv_dot]

def treeCoordinateDet {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
    (treeCoordinateReturn t).toLinearMap).det

/-- The global coordinate normalization has magnitude one, independently of rates. -/
theorem treeCoordinateDet_sq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : treeCoordinateDet t ^ 2 = 1 := by
  apply det_sq_of_basisDot_preserved (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
  intro p q
  rw [arrayInput_basisDot,arrayOutput_basisDot]
  exact treeCoordinateReturn_dot t p q

/-- Child coefficient outputs and the actual root/edge-product data at an original rate vector. -/
def actualBranchInputs {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : BranchStepInputs (TreeBranchDegrees t) :=
  prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)
    ((fun c => normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)),
      ((rateChart t x).1 0,fun c => x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val))

lemma actualBranchInputs_denominators {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (actualBranchInputs t x).1.1 =
      piScaledEquiv (childEdgeCount t) (fun c => (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)).1) := by
  have h := prepareFamilyEquiv_apply (childEdgeCount t)
    ((fun c => normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)),
      ((rateChart t x).1 0,fun c => x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val))
  simpa only [actualBranchInputs,normalizedPhysicalTree,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using
    congrArg (fun z : BranchStepInputs (TreeBranchDegrees t) => z.1.1) h

lemma actualBranchInputs_numeratorSlots {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (actualBranchInputs t x).1.2 =
      piScaledEquiv (childEdgeCount t) (fun c => leadingEquiv (childEdgeCount t c)
        (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val,
          (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)).2)) := by
  have h := prepareFamilyEquiv_apply (childEdgeCount t)
    ((fun c => normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)),
      ((rateChart t x).1 0,fun c => x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val))
  simpa only [actualBranchInputs,normalizedPhysicalTree,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using
    congrArg (fun z : BranchStepInputs (TreeBranchDegrees t) => z.1.2) h

lemma actualBranchInputs_product {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (monicPoly (familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees (TreeBranchDegrees t)) (actualBranchInputs t x).1.1) : ℝ[X]) =

  rw [actualBranchInputs_denominators,piScaled_product,physicalRootCofactor_child_product]

/-! Exact zero-frequency determinant and cofactor formulas of the original
physical tree matrix. Valid at all real rates, including zero-rate boundaries;
no steady-state, stability or noncancellation premise is inserted. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Conservation forces the full characteristic constant to be the root leak
 times its original root cofactor constant. No divisions by edge rates occur. -/
theorem physicalCharacteristic_eval_zero_leak {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval 0 = x.1 0 * (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval 0 := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    have hc (c : RootChild t) :
        (childCharacteristic t x c).eval 0 = x.1 c.val * (childCofactor t x c).eval 0 := by
      have h := ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
      simpa only [childCharacteristic, childCofactor, childRates_leak] using h
    rw [physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion, physicalRootCofactor_child_product]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, zero_add, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum]
    have hterm (c : RootChild t) :
        (x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) * (childCofactor t x c).eval 0 *
          (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, (childCharacteristic t x j).eval 0) =
        outwardByVertex x.2 c.val * ∏ j : RootChild t, (childCharacteristic t x j).eval 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (childCharacteristic t x j).eval 0)
        (Finset.mem_univ c), hc c]
      ring
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    change (x.1 0 + parentCLM t x.2 0) * _ - _ = _
    rw [rootConnectors_sum]
    ring

/-- Each inward coordinate appears exactly once in the physical child partition. -/
lemma child_inward_product {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (∏ c : RootChild t, ∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1), (childRates t c x).1 i) =
      ∏ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ := by
  change (∏ c : RootChild t, ∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
    x.1 (childEnumeration t c i).val) = _
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sigma (f := fun z : NumberedChildNodes t =>
    x.1 (childEnumeration t z.1 z.2).val)]
  apply Fintype.prod_equiv (numberedEdgeEquiv t)
  intro z
  change x.1 (childEnumeration t z.1 z.2).val = x.1 (numberedEdgeIndex t z).succ
  rw [numberedEdgeIndex_succ]

/-- The actual root principal cofactor constant is the product of all inward
rates. In particular this identity remains valid when one or more rates vanish. -/
theorem physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval 0 = ∏ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [physicalRootCofactor_child_product, Polynomial.eval_prod, ← child_inward_product t x]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro c _
    rw [childCharacteristic, physicalCharacteristic_eval_zero_leak,
      ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x),
      Fin.prod_univ_succ]

/-- Exact all-tree characteristic constant, at arbitrary real physical rates. -/
theorem physicalCharacteristic_eval_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval 0 = x.1 0 * ∏ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ := by
  rw [physicalCharacteristic_eval_zero_leak, physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero]

variable {P E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- Complete triangular recovery, including the dimension-zero numerator case. -/
theorem rootTransition_fiber_unique (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E)
    (z w : RootTransitionSpace P E)
    (hz : z.2.1.2 ≠ 0 ∨ Subsingleton E)
    (h : rootTransition α β L K z = rootTransition α β L K w) : z = w := by
  have hp := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.1) h
  change z.1 = w.1 at hp
  have hd0 := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.2.1.1) h
  change z.2.1.1 + α z.1 = w.2.1.1 + α w.1 at hd0
  rw [hp] at hd0
  have hd : z.2.1.1 = w.2.1.1 := add_right_cancel hd0
  have hc0 := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.2.1.2) h
  change β z.1 + z.2.1.1 * α z.1 - z.2.1.2 =
    β w.1 + w.2.1.1 * α w.1 - w.2.1.2 at hc0
  rw [hp,hd] at hc0
  have hc : z.2.1.2 = w.2.1.2 := sub_right_inj.mp hc0
  have hq : z.2.2 = w.2.2 := by
    rcases hz with hz | hs
    · have hw : w.2.1.2 ≠ 0 := by rwa [← hc]
      have hq0 := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.2.2) h
      change L z.1 + z.2.1.1 • K z.1 - z.2.1.2 • z.2.2 =
        L w.1 + w.2.1.1 • K w.1 - w.2.1.2 • w.2.2 at hq0
      rw [hp,hd,hc] at hq0
      have hq1 := sub_right_inj.mp hq0
      have hq2 := congrArg (fun v : E => (w.2.1.2)⁻¹ • v) hq1
      simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw, one_smul] using hq2

theorem pathStepCoefficients_fiber_unique {n : ℕ} (z w : PathPolyData n)
    (hz : z.2.1.2 ≠ 0 ∨ n = 0) (h : pathStepCoefficients z = pathStepCoefficients w) : z = w := by
  have hh := congrArg (parentCoefficientEquiv n) h
  rw [parentCoefficient_step_eq, parentCoefficient_step_eq] at hh
  apply rootTransition_fiber_unique _ _ _ _ z w _ hh
  rcases hz with hz | hn
  · exact Or.inl hz
  · subst n
    right
    refine ⟨fun p q => ?_⟩
    apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective
    funext i
    exact Fin.elim0 i

end HydrologyTree

This is field algebra, including repeated zeros and the empty family. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {K C : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]

def branchValueNumerator (p b : C → K) : K :=
  ∑ c, b c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j

/-- At a zero of one denominator, every other summand vanishes exactly. -/
lemma branchValueNumerator_at_zero (p b : C → K) (c : C) (hc : p c = 0) :
    branchValueNumerator p b = b c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j := by
  unfold branchValueNumerator
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single c]
  · intro j _ hj
    have hz : (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, p i) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr
      exact ⟨c, by simp [Ne.symm hj], hc⟩
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · simp

/-- A local common zero is exactly either a child common zero or a collision
between two distinct child denominators, provided the connector coefficients are nonzero. -/
theorem finite_branch_cancellation_iff (d : K) (p f a : C → K) (ha : ∀ c, a c ≠ 0) :
    ((∏ c, p c) = 0 ∧ d * (∏ c, p c) - branchValueNumerator p (fun c => a c * f c) = 0) ↔
      ∃ c, p c = 0 ∧ (f c = 0 ∨ ∃ j, j ≠ c ∧ p j = 0) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp,hN⟩
    obtain ⟨c,_,hc⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp hp
    refine ⟨c,hc,?_⟩
    rw [hp, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, branchValueNumerator_at_zero p _ c hc] at hN
    have hz : f c = 0 ∨ (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hN with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ((mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (ha c))
      · exact Or.inr h
    rcases hz with hf | hz
    · exact Or.inl hf
    · obtain ⟨j,hj,hp⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
      exact Or.inr ⟨j, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨c,hc,h⟩
    have hp : (∏ c, p c) = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨c,Finset.mem_univ c,hc⟩
    refine ⟨hp,?_⟩
    rw [hp, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, branchValueNumerator_at_zero p _ c hc]
    rcases h with hf | ⟨j,hjc,hj⟩
    · rw [hf, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · have he : (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p i) = 0 :=
        Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨j, by simp [hjc], hj⟩
      rw [he, mul_zero]

noncomputable section

/-- Only internal directed rates must be nonzero; the original root leak is unrestricted. -/
def NonzeroTreeEdges {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  (∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ e : Fin n, x.2 e ≠ 0)

lemma inward_nonroot_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : x.1 v ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv]
  exact hx.1 _

lemma outward_nonroot_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : outwardByVertex x.2 v ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv, outwardByVertex_succ]
  exact hx.2 _

    (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) : NonzeroTreeEdges (childRates t c x) := by
  constructor
  · intro e
    exact inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))
  · intro e
    exact outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))

/-- An actual common zero, with no cancellation of the stored polynomials. -/
def PhysicalCommonRoot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  aeval z (physicalRootCofactor t x) = 0 ∧ aeval z (physicalCharacteristic t x) = 0

def SiblingCollisionAtRoot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  ∃ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d ∧
    aeval z (childCharacteristic t x c) = 0 ∧ aeval z (childCharacteristic t x d) = 0

/-- Exact common-root recursion, including simultaneous cancellations in several children. -/
theorem physicalCommonRoot_local_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔ SiblingCollisionAtRoot t x z ∨
      ∃ c : RootChild t, PhysicalCommonRoot (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) z := by
  classical
  let p : RootChild t → K := fun c => aeval z (childCharacteristic t x c)
  let f : RootChild t → K := fun c => aeval z (childCofactor t x c)
  let a : RootChild t → K := fun c => algebraMap ℝ K (x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)
  have ha : ∀ c, a c ≠ 0 := by
    intro c
    exact (map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℝ K)).mpr (mul_ne_zero (inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ c.property.1)
      (outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ c.property.1))
  have h := finite_branch_cancellation_iff (z + algebraMap ℝ K ((rateChart t x).1 0)) p f a ha
  have he : PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔
      ∃ c, p c = 0 ∧ (f c = 0 ∨ ∃ j, j ≠ c ∧ p j = 0) := by
    rw [PhysicalCommonRoot, physicalRootCofactor_child_product,
      physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion]
    simpa only [map_prod, map_sub, map_mul, map_sum, map_add, aeval_X, aeval_C,
      mul_one,
      p, f, a, branchValueNumerator] using h
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c,hp,hc⟩
    rcases hc with hf | ⟨j,hjc,hj⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨c,hf,hp⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨c,j,Ne.symm hjc,hp,hj⟩
  · rintro (⟨c,d,hcd,hc,hd⟩ | ⟨c,hf,hp⟩)
    · exact ⟨c,hc,Or.inr ⟨d,Ne.symm hcd,hd⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨c,hp,Or.inl hf⟩

end HydrologyTree

  C (x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) * childCofactor t x c

    unfold childCharacteristic
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _).ne_zero]
    exact congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (k : WithBot ℕ)) (physicalCharacteristic_natDegree _ _)

  · simp [physicalChildNumerator, hc]
  · rw [physicalChildNumerator, Polynomial.degree_C_mul hc]
    unfold childCofactor
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (physicalRootCofactor_monic _ _).ne_zero,
      physicalRootCofactor_natDegree]

    branchNumeratorSum (childCharacteristic t x) (physicalChildNumerator t x) =

        physicalCharacteristic t x := by

      branchNumeratorSum (childCharacteristic t x) (physicalChildNumerator t x) at h

      IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d))

namespace HydrologyTree
variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]

lemma differentiable_linear_conjugate (e : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] F) (f : F → F)

  exact e.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiable.comp

  exact endJacobian_conjugate e.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv f x hf

/-! Complete physical parent pipeline in independent child coordinates. Only
smaller-child differentiability appears in the local induction lemmas; the
following tree induction must discharge it, not assume the main conclusion. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
namespace HydrologyTree


/-- Apply the actual normalized physical coefficient map independently in each child. -/
def treeChildStep {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : TreeWork t → TreeWork t :=
  keepFunction (F := ℝ × (RootChild t → ℝ))
    (dependentPiEnd (fun c => normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c)))

/-- The proved all-arity local step, conjugated into independent child coordinates. -/
def treeLocalStep {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : TreeWork t) : TreeWork t :=
  (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).symm
    (normalizedBranchStep (TreeBranchDegrees t) (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t) z))

def treePipeline {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : TreeWork t → TreeWork t :=
  treeLocalStep t ∘ (treeChildStep t ∘ rootCoupling (childLeakMap t))

lemma treeChildStep_actual {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)
      (treeChildStep t (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x))) =
        actualBranchInputs t x := by
  rw [originalWorkEquiv_originalCoupling,rootCoupling_physical_coordinates]
  rfl

/-- Exact end-to-end physical identification, with all rates and degenerate
boundaries included and no coefficient-Jacobian assumption. -/
theorem treePipeline_actual {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treePipeline t (originalWorkEquiv t x) =
      parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t (physicalCoefficientMap t x) := by
  change (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).symm
    (normalizedBranchStep (TreeBranchDegrees t)
      (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)
        (treeChildStep t (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x))))) = _
  rw [treeChildStep_actual,actualBranchInputs_normalized]

lemma differentiable_treeLocalStep {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Differentiable ℝ (treeLocalStep t) := by
  unfold treeLocalStep
  apply differentiable_linear_conjugate (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t))
  exact differentiable_normalizedBranchStep (TreeBranchDegrees t)

lemma differentiableAt_treeChildStep {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : TreeWork t)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c)) (z.1 c)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (treeChildStep t) z :=
  (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction z (hasFDerivAt_dependentPiEnd _ _ hc).differentiableAt).differentiableAt

lemma treeChildStep_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : TreeWork t)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c)) (z.1 c)) :
    endJacobian (treeChildStep t) z =
      ∏ c : RootChild t, treeCanonicalJacobian (childTree t c) (z.1 c) := by
  have hn (c : RootChild t) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c)) (z.1 c) :=
    (coefficientArrayEquiv (childEdgeCount t c)).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp _ (hc c)
  rw [treeChildStep,endJacobian_keepFunction _ _
    (hasFDerivAt_dependentPiEnd _ _ hn).differentiableAt,endJacobian_dependentPiEnd _ _ hn]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => normalizedPhysicalTree_jacobian _ _ (hc c))

    endJacobian (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t)) z = ∏ c : RootChild t, (z.1 c).1 0 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) z),

      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (RootChild t)))),det_rootCouplingDerivative]
  rfl

/-- Sibling resultant product in a fixed enumeration of the actual child polynomials. -/
def treeSiblingResultant {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  pairwiseResultants (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (RootChild t)) =>
    childCharacteristic t x ((Fintype.equivFin (RootChild t)).symm i)))

lemma actualBranchInputs_resultants {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (TreeBranchDegrees t))
      (actualBranchInputs t x).1.1) = treeSiblingResultant t x := by
  rw [actualBranchInputs_denominators,piScaled_polynomials]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  funext i

lemma actualBranchInputs_weight {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    scaleFamilyWeight (TreeBranchDegrees t) (actualBranchInputs t x).1.2 =
      ∏ c : RootChild t, (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) ^ childEdgeCount t c := by
  exact prepareFamilyEquiv_scaleWeight _ _

/-- The exact local parent Jacobian on actual child outputs and physical connector products. -/
lemma treeLocalStep_actual_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    endJacobian (treeLocalStep t)
      (treeChildStep t (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x))) =
      (-1 : ℝ)^n * treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 *

  unfold treeLocalStep
  rw [endJacobian_linear_conjugate (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t))
    (normalizedBranchStep (TreeBranchDegrees t)) _
    (differentiable_normalizedBranchStep (TreeBranchDegrees t) _)]
  rw [treeChildStep_actual,normalizedBranchStep_jacobian,treeBranchDegree_sum,
    actualBranchInputs_resultants,actualBranchInputs_weight]
