/-! Actual all-rate branching-tree derivative induction step. Every local map,
physical child, and normalization was proved before applying this chain rule. -/
open Module Polynomial Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma treePipeline_differentiableAt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c)) (childRates t c x)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (treePipeline t) (originalWorkEquiv t x) := by
  have hz : (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).1 = fun c => childRates t c x := by
    rw [originalWorkEquiv_originalCoupling,rootCoupling_physical_coordinates]
  have hn : ∀ c : RootChild t,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c))
        ((rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).1 c) := by
    intro c
    rw [hz]
    exact (coefficientArrayEquiv (childEdgeCount t c)).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp _ (hc c)
  exact (differentiable_treeLocalStep t _).comp _
    ((differentiableAt_treeChildStep t _ hn).comp _ (hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) _).differentiableAt)

/-- The actual parent coefficient map is differentiable whenever the strictly
smaller actual child coefficient maps are. The later strong induction discharges this. -/
theorem physicalCoefficientMap_differentiableAt_of_children {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c)) (childRates t c x)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x := by
  have h := (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp x
    ((treePipeline_differentiableAt t x hc).comp x
      (originalWorkEquiv t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)
  have he : (fun y : TreeRates n => (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t).symm
      (treePipeline t (originalWorkEquiv t y))) = physicalCoefficientMap t := by
    funext y
    rw [treePipeline_actual,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact he ▸ h

/-- The fixed coefficient-return map contributes its actual determinant, not a
numerically fitted or unspecified nonzero factor. -/
lemma treeCoordinateReturn_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x) :
    endJacobian (fun y => treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t y)) x =
      treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x := by
  have h := (treeCoordinateReturn t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x hx.hasFDerivAt
  calc
    _ = LinearMap.det ((treeCoordinateReturn t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x)).toLinearMap := endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt h
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)]
      change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ ((treeCoordinateReturn t).toLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x).toLinearMap)).det = _
      rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
        (catenaryArrayInputBasis n),Matrix.det_mul]
      rfl

lemma treePipeline_jacobian_transport {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x) :
    endJacobian (treePipeline t) (originalWorkEquiv t x) =
      treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x := by
  have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t y)) x :=
    (treeCoordinateReturn t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp x hx
  have h := endJacobian_linear_conjugate (originalWorkEquiv t).symm
    (fun y => treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t y)) (originalWorkEquiv t x)
    (by simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hf)
  have he : (fun z : TreeWork t => originalWorkEquiv t
      (treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t ((originalWorkEquiv t).symm z)))) = treePipeline t := by
    funext z
    have hh := treePipeline_actual t ((originalWorkEquiv t).symm z)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hh
    exact (originalWorkEquiv t).apply_symm_apply _ |>.trans hh.symm
  change endJacobian (fun z : TreeWork t => originalWorkEquiv t
      (treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t ((originalWorkEquiv t).symm z)))) _ = _ at h
  rw [he,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,treeCoordinateReturn_jacobian t x hx] at h
  exact h

/-- Exact local physical factors a_c^(m_c+1) f_c^m_c for all root connectors. -/
def treeRootRateFactor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ c : RootChild t, x.1 c.val ^ (childEdgeCount t c+1) *
    outwardByVertex x.2 c.val ^ childEdgeCount t c

lemma treeRootRateFactor_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (∏ c : RootChild t, (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)^childEdgeCount t c) *
      (∏ c : RootChild t, x.1 c.val) = treeRootRateFactor t x := by
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  rw [mul_pow,pow_succ]
  ring

/-- The complete actual parent Jacobian recurrence, including singular rate
vectors. The only induction premises concern strictly smaller physical children. -/
theorem treeCanonicalJacobian_recurrence_of_children {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c)) (childRates t c x)) :
    treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x =
      (-1 : ℝ)^n * treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 * treeRootRateFactor t x *
        ∏ c : RootChild t, treeCanonicalJacobian (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
  have hp := physicalCoefficientMap_differentiableAt_of_children t x hc
  rw [← treePipeline_jacobian_transport t x hp]
  have hCouple := (hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).differentiableAt
  have hz : (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).1 = fun c => childRates t c x := by
    rw [originalWorkEquiv_originalCoupling,rootCoupling_physical_coordinates]
  have hChild : DifferentiableAt ℝ (treeChildStep t)
      (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)) := by
    apply differentiableAt_treeChildStep
    intro c
    rw [hz]
    exact (coefficientArrayEquiv (childEdgeCount t c)).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp _ (hc c)
  rw [treePipeline,endJacobian_comp (differentiable_treeLocalStep t _) (hChild.comp _ hCouple),
    endJacobian_comp hChild hCouple,Function.comp_apply,treeLocalStep_actual_jacobian,
    treeChildStep_jacobian t _ (by simpa only [hz] using hc),rootCoupling_endJacobian]
  rw [hz,originalWorkEquiv_apply]
  simp only [childRates_leak]
  have hfac := treeRootRateFactor_eq t x
  rw [← hfac]
  ring

/-- UNCONDITIONAL all-size differentiability of the actual tree coefficient map. -/
theorem differentiable_physicalCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Differentiable ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro x
    apply physicalCoefficientMap_differentiableAt_of_children
    intro c
    exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

/-- UNCONDITIONAL all-size, all-rate canonical physical Jacobian recurrence. -/
theorem treeCanonicalJacobian_recurrence {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x =
      (-1 : ℝ)^n * treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 * treeRootRateFactor t x *
        ∏ c : RootChild t, treeCanonicalJacobian (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) :=
  treeCanonicalJacobian_recurrence_of_children t x
    (fun c => differentiable_physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c x))

end HydrologyTree

flattening to the original vertex set is proved in the subsequent module. -/

noncomputable section

/-- Fixed orientation depending only on the actual tree and coefficient ordering. -/
def treeProofOrientation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : ℝ :=
  treeCoordinateDet t * (-1 : ℝ)^n * ∏ c : RootChild t, treeProofOrientation (childTree t c)

def allTreeJacobianWeight {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 * treeRootRateFactor t x *
    ∏ c : RootChild t, allTreeJacobianWeight (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [treeProofOrientation,mul_pow,mul_pow,treeCoordinateDet_sq,one_mul]
    have hp : (∏ c : RootChild t, treeProofOrientation (childTree t c))^2 = 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_pow]
      have hsub : ∀ c : RootChild t, treeProofOrientation (childTree t c)^2 = 1 :=

  real_sq_one_sign _ (treeProofOrientation_sq t)

rooted tree and every real rate vector, including every zero-rate or repeated-root
boundary. Only fixed coordinate orientation remains outside the explicit factors. -/
theorem all_tree_canonical_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x = treeProofOrientation t * allTreeJacobianWeight t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>

      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl

    treeCanonicalJacobian t x ^ 2 = allTreeJacobianWeight t x ^ 2 := by

/-! Flatten exact recursive factors onto the ORIGINAL finite vertex and edge
sets. Subtrees are the previously constructed actual principal child models. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The number of vertices of the actual rooted principal subtree at vertex v. -/
def subtreeVertexCount {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : ℕ :=
  match (numberedRootEquiv t).symm v with
  | .inl _ => n+1
  | .inr ⟨c,i⟩ => subtreeVertexCount (childTree t c) i
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

@[simp] lemma subtreeVertexCount_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    subtreeVertexCount t 0 = n+1 := by
  change subtreeVertexCount t (numberedRootEquiv t (.inl ())) = _
  rw [subtreeVertexCount,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

@[simp] lemma subtreeVertexCount_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    subtreeVertexCount t (childEnumeration t c i).val = subtreeVertexCount (childTree t c) i := by
  change subtreeVertexCount t (numberedRootEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,i⟩)) = _
  rw [subtreeVertexCount,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

lemma subtreeVertexCount_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    0 < subtreeVertexCount t v := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := (numberedRootEquiv t).surjective v
    rcases u with u | ⟨c,i⟩
    · cases u
      rw [numberedRootEquiv_zero,subtreeVertexCount_root]
      omega
    · rw [numberedRootEquiv_child,subtreeVertexCount_child]
      exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) i

/-- Actual local quantity at the original vertex, via the proved child-principal transport. -/
def subtreeNodeValue {α : Type*}
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : α :=
  match (numberedRootEquiv t).symm v with
  | .inl _ => f t x
  | .inr ⟨c,i⟩ => subtreeNodeValue f (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

@[simp] lemma subtreeNodeValue_root {α : Type*}
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : subtreeNodeValue f t x 0 = f t x := by
  change subtreeNodeValue f t x (numberedRootEquiv t (.inl ())) = _
  rw [subtreeNodeValue,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

@[simp] lemma subtreeNodeValue_child {α : Type*}
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    subtreeNodeValue f t x (childEnumeration t c i).val =
      subtreeNodeValue f (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i := by
  change subtreeNodeValue f t x (numberedRootEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,i⟩)) = _
  rw [subtreeNodeValue,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

lemma original_node_product_recursion {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α]
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (∏ v : Fin (n+1), subtreeNodeValue f t x v) = f t x *
      ∏ c : RootChild t, ∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
        subtreeNodeValue f (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i := by
  rw [← (numberedRootEquiv t).prod_comp (fun v => subtreeNodeValue f t x v),Fintype.prod_sum_type]
  simp only [Fintype.prod_unique,Fintype.prod_sigma,numberedRootEquiv_zero,
    numberedRootEquiv_child,subtreeNodeValue_root,subtreeNodeValue_child]

/-- The exact rate monomial, indexed by every original directed edge pair. -/
def originalTreeRateMonomial {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ^ subtreeVertexCount t e.succ *
    x.2 e ^ (subtreeVertexCount t e.succ-1)

lemma originalTreeRateMonomial_recursion {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    originalTreeRateMonomial t x = treeRootRateFactor t x *
      ∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeRateMonomial (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
  rw [originalTreeRateMonomial,← (numberedEdgeEquiv t).prod_comp,Fintype.prod_sigma,
    treeRootRateFactor,← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  simp only [← numberedEdgeIndex_succ t, outward_at_numbered_child]
  change (∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
      x.1 (childEnumeration t c i).val ^ subtreeVertexCount t (childEnumeration t c i).val *
      outwardByVertex x.2 (childEnumeration t c i).val ^
        (subtreeVertexCount t (childEnumeration t c i).val-1)) = _
  simp only [subtreeVertexCount_child,Fin.prod_univ_succ,childEnumeration_zero,
    subtreeVertexCount_root,Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  congr 1
  unfold originalTreeRateMonomial
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [childRates_outward t c x i.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)]
  rfl

/-- Squared actual sibling-resultant factors at every original vertex. -/
def originalTreeSiblingProduct {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ v : Fin (n+1), subtreeNodeValue (fun {m} (s : OrderedTree m) y => treeSiblingResultant s y ^ 2) t x v

lemma originalTreeSiblingProduct_recursion {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    originalTreeSiblingProduct t x = treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 *
      ∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeSiblingProduct (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
  exact original_node_product_recursion _ t x

/-- The recursive factor is exactly the original-vertex rate/subtree formula. -/
theorem allTreeJacobianWeight_eq_original_products {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    allTreeJacobianWeight t x = originalTreeRateMonomial t x * originalTreeSiblingProduct t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [allTreeJacobianWeight,originalTreeRateMonomial_recursion,originalTreeSiblingProduct_recursion]
    have he : (∏ c : RootChild t, allTreeJacobianWeight (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) =
        (∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeRateMonomial (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) *
          (∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeSiblingProduct (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c)
        (childTree t c) (childRates t c x))
    rw [he]
    ring

/-- Full all-size all-real-rate formula in ORIGINAL edge and vertex indices.
The fixed sign has been proved, including every zero-rate/repeated-root boundary. -/
theorem full_tree_standard_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, (ε=1 ∨ ε= -1) ∧ ∀ x : TreeRates n,
      treeCanonicalJacobian t x = ε * originalTreeRateMonomial t x * originalTreeSiblingProduct t x := by
  refine ⟨treeProofOrientation t,treeProofOrientation_sign t,?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [all_tree_canonical_jacobian,allTreeJacobianWeight_eq_original_products]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

/-! Global all-size uniqueness for a prescribed recursive assignment of actual
subtree characteristic polynomials. This proves uniqueness per assignment;
existence of all assignments and their total count are separate obligations. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Every local sibling family of the actual recursive principal model is coprime. -/
def CoprimeAtEveryBranch {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  (∀ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d →
    IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d)) ∧
  ∀ c : RootChild t, CoprimeAtEveryBranch (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Fixed labelled factor assignment at every vertex, using ACTUAL principal
subtree characteristic polynomials. Cofactors and rates are not assumed equal. -/
def SameSubtreeCharacteristics {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  physicalCharacteristic t x = physicalCharacteristic t y ∧
  ∀ c : RootChild t, SameSubtreeCharacteristics (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) (childRates t c y)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Every recursive child-denominator assignment has AT MOST one realization
among all real rate vectors when the reference has nonzero internal rates and
coprime siblings. The competitor needs no positivity or regularity hypothesis. -/
theorem physical_subtree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (hcop : CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x)
    (hassign : SameSubtreeCharacteristics t x y) : x = y := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [CoprimeAtEveryBranch] at hcop
    rw [SameSubtreeCharacteristics] at hassign
    have hchild : ∀ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c = childCharacteristic t y c := by
      intro c
      have hh := hassign.2 c
      rw [SameSubtreeCharacteristics] at hh
      exact hh.1
    have hcofactor : physicalRootCofactor t x = physicalRootCofactor t y := by
      rw [physicalRootCofactor_child_product, physicalRootCofactor_child_product]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => hchild c)
    have hcoeff : physicalCoefficientMap t x = physicalCoefficientMap t y :=
      (physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff t x y).mpr ⟨hassign.1,hcofactor⟩
    have hleak := physical_root_leak_identified t x y hx.1 hcoeff
    have hconnectors := physical_child_data_and_connectors_identified t x y hx hcop.1 hchild hassign.1
    have hstates (c : RootChild t) : childRates t c x = childRates t c y :=
      ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
        (childRates t c y) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx) (hcop.2 c) (hassign.2 c)
    apply (ratePartitionEquiv t).injective
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hleak
    · funext c
      rw [ratePartition_child,ratePartition_child,hstates c,(hconnectors c).2]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Complete all-size common-root classification for the original physical
characteristic/cofactor polynomials. Spectral collisions are located at actual
sibling principal blocks, not arbitrary recursively postulated polynomials. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]

/-- A spectral collision between two distinct sibling blocks at some vertex.
All descendants are the actual rate-preserving principal child models. -/
def SiblingCollisionSomewhere {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  SiblingCollisionAtRoot t x z ∨
    ∃ c : RootChild t, SiblingCollisionSomewhere (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) z
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Complete classification of common zeros of the actual root cofactor and
characteristic polynomial, for every finite tree and every field extension.
Internal rates need only be nonzero; positivity and root-leak nonzero are unnecessary. -/
theorem physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔ SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [physicalCommonRoot_local_iff t x hx, SiblingCollisionSomewhere]
    apply or_congr Iff.rfl
    apply exists_congr
    intro c
    exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
      (childRates t c x) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx)

/-- Absence of every sibling collision rules out all cancellations at that value. -/
theorem no_common_root_of_no_sibling_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) (hz : ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) :
    ¬PhysicalCommonRoot t x z := by
  exact mt (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mp hz

/-- Every detected sibling collision actually cancels the original root response:
both original, unreduced polynomials vanish. -/
theorem sibling_collision_gives_common_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) (hz : SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) :
    Polynomial.aeval z (physicalRootCofactor t x) = 0 ∧
      Polynomial.aeval z (physicalCharacteristic t x) = 0 := by
  exact (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mpr hz

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact Jacobian regularity for actual branching trees with nonzero internal
rates. The full determinant, rather than a presumed minimality equivalence,
is the input proved by the preceding all-tree induction. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma list_map_prod_ne_zero {α : Type*} (f : α → ℝ) (l : List α) :
    (l.map f).prod ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ a ∈ l, f a ≠ 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => simp [ih]

lemma monic_resultant_ne_zero_iff (p q : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.Monic) :
    p.resultant q ≠ 0 ↔ IsCoprime p q := by
  rw [← isUnit_iff_ne_zero,Polynomial.isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime hp]

lemma pairwiseResultants_ne_zero_iff (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hm : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) :
    pairwiseResultants ps ≠ 0 ↔ ps.Pairwise IsCoprime := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp [pairwiseResultants]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hp : p.Monic := hm p (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic := fun q hq => hm q (by simp [hq])
    simp only [pairwiseResultants,mul_ne_zero_iff,List.pairwise_cons]
    rw [list_map_prod_ne_zero,ih ht]
    exact and_congr (forall_congr' fun q => forall_congr' fun _ =>
      monic_resultant_ne_zero_iff p q hp) Iff.rfl

lemma treeSiblingResultant_ne_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treeSiblingResultant t x ≠ 0 ↔
      ∀ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d → IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d) := by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (RootChild t)
  have hm : ∀ p ∈ List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (RootChild t)) => childCharacteristic t x (e.symm i)),
      p.Monic := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hp
    exact physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _
  rw [treeSiblingResultant,pairwiseResultants_ne_zero_iff _ hm,List.pairwise_ofFn]
  constructor
  · intro h c d hcd
    have hn : e c ≠ e d := fun he => hcd (e.injective he)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hlt | hgt
    · simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h hlt
    · simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using (h hgt).symm
  · intro h i j hij
    exact h _ _ (fun he => (ne_of_lt hij) (e.symm.injective he))

lemma treeRootRateFactor_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) : treeRootRateFactor t x ≠ 0 := by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro c _
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx c.val c.property.1))
    (pow_ne_zero _ (outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx c.val c.property.1))

lemma real_square_ne_zero_iff (a : ℝ) : a^2 ≠ 0 ↔ a ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h ha
    apply h
    rw [ha]
    norm_num
  · exact pow_ne_zero 2

/-- All recursive factors are nonzero precisely when each actual sibling
polynomial family is coprime. There is no positivity premise. -/
theorem allTreeWeight_ne_zero_iff_coprime {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) :
    allTreeJacobianWeight t x ≠ 0 ↔ CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    have hchildren : (∏ c : RootChild t, allTreeJacobianWeight (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) ≠ 0 ↔
        ∀ c : RootChild t, CoprimeAtEveryBranch (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
      simp only [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff,Finset.mem_univ,true_implies]
      exact forall_congr' fun c => ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c)
        (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx)
    rw [allTreeJacobianWeight,mul_ne_zero_iff,mul_ne_zero_iff,real_square_ne_zero_iff,
      treeSiblingResultant_ne_zero_iff,hchildren,CoprimeAtEveryBranch]
    simp only [treeRootRateFactor_ne_zero t x hx,and_true]

/-- Actual full coefficient-map regularity, not the simpler matrix-coordinate
Jacobian: every nonzero-edge real reference is regular iff all siblings are coprime. -/
theorem treeJacobian_ne_zero_iff_coprime {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) : treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ↔ CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x := by
  have he : treeProofOrientation t ≠ 0 := by
    rcases treeProofOrientation_sign t with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  rw [all_tree_canonical_jacobian,mul_ne_zero_iff,allTreeWeight_ne_zero_iff_coprime t x hx]
  simp only [he,true_and]

lemma coprime_no_common_aeval {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]
    (p q : ℝ[X]) (hpq : IsCoprime p q) (z : K) :
    ¬(aeval z p = 0 ∧ aeval z q = 0) := by
  rintro ⟨hp,hq⟩
  obtain ⟨a,b,h⟩ := hpq
  have hval := congrArg (fun r : ℝ[X] => aeval z r) h
  simp only [map_add,map_mul,map_one,hp,hq,mul_zero,zero_add] at hval
  exact zero_ne_one hval

/-- Coprime actual sibling polynomials exclude common roots over every real
field extension, not only at a finite set of tested eigenvalues. -/
theorem coprime_branches_no_sibling_collisions {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (hcop : CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x) :
    ∀ z : K, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [CoprimeAtEveryBranch] at hcop
    intro z hz
    rw [SiblingCollisionSomewhere] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨c,d,hcd,hc,hd⟩ | ⟨c,hc⟩
    · exact coprime_no_common_aeval _ _ (hcop.1 c d hcd) z ⟨hc,hd⟩
    · exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
        (childRates t c x) (hcop.2 c) z hc

end HydrologyTree

/-! Constructed detailed-balance weights of the actual finite physical tree.
These weights are not added as an existence hypothesis. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def balanceWeight {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : ℝ :=
  if hv : v = 0 then 1 else
    balanceWeight t x (parentVertex t v) * outwardByVertex x.2 v / x.1 v
termination_by v.val
decreasing_by exact parentVertex_lt t v hv

@[simp] theorem balanceWeight_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    balanceWeight t x 0 = 1 := by
  rw [balanceWeight]
  simp

lemma balanceWeight_succ {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (e : Fin n) :
    balanceWeight t x e.succ = balanceWeight t x (t.parent e) * x.2 e / x.1 e.succ := by
  rw [balanceWeight]
  simp only [Fin.succ_ne_zero, dite_false]
  rfl

/-- Every constructed weight is strictly positive for positive internal rates;
the root leak need not be positive or nonzero. -/
theorem balanceWeight_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) : 0 < balanceWeight t x v := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · subst v
      rw [balanceWeight_zero]
      norm_num
    · let e : Fin n := v.pred hv
      have he : e.succ = v := Fin.succ_pred v hv
      have hlt : (t.parent e).val < v.val := by
        rw [← he]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (t.parent_le e)
      rw [← he, balanceWeight_succ]
      exact div_pos (mul_pos (ih (t.parent e) hlt) (hf e)) (ha e)

/-- Exact opposed-edge detailed balance, supplied by the construction. -/
theorem balanceWeight_edge {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) (e : Fin n) :
    x.1 e.succ * balanceWeight t x e.succ = x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e) := by
  rw [balanceWeight_succ]
  field_simp [ha e]
  <;> ring

end HydrologyTree

/-! The actual weighted compartment matrix is a grounded tree Dirichlet form.
All matrix equalities and the quadratic identity are proved edge by edge. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

lemma single_mul_weight_diagonal (i j : I) (r : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ) :
    Matrix.single i j r * Matrix.diagonal w = Matrix.single i j (r*w j) := by
  ext u v
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hi : i = u <;> by_cases hj : j = v <;>
    simp [Matrix.single_apply,hi,hj]

/-- The rank-one Laplacian form (e_i-e_j)(e_i-e_j)^T. -/
def edgeGram (i j : I) : Matrix I I ℝ :=
  Matrix.single i i 1 + Matrix.single j j 1 - Matrix.single i j 1 - Matrix.single j i 1

lemma edgeGram_transpose (i j : I) : (edgeGram i j).transpose = edgeGram i j := by
  ext u v
  simp only [edgeGram, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.single_apply]
  simp [and_comm]
  <;> ring

lemma edgeGram_energy (i j : I) (z : I → ℝ) :
    z ⬝ᵥ (edgeGram i j *ᵥ z) = (z i-z j)^2 := by
  simp only [edgeGram, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_add,
    Matrix.single_mulVec_eq, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_single_one, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

/-- Actual weighted negative generator, not an assumed symmetric proxy. -/
def weightedNegativeGenerator {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  -(compartmentMatrix t x * Matrix.diagonal (balanceWeight t x))

lemma edge_weighted_matrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) (e : Fin n) :
    edgeMatrix t x e * Matrix.diagonal (balanceWeight t x) =
      -(x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e)) • edgeGram (t.parent e) e.succ := by
  rw [edgeMatrix, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.sub_mul]
  simp only [single_mul_weight_diagonal, one_mul, smul_sub, Matrix.smul_single,
    smul_eq_mul, balanceWeight_edge t x ha e]
  simp only [edgeGram, smul_sub, smul_add, Matrix.smul_single, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]
  simp only [← Matrix.single_neg]
  abel

/-- Edgewise exact decomposition. All positive rates will be supplied only when
needed for positivity; here inward rates merely need to be nonzero. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_decomposition {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) :
    weightedNegativeGenerator t x = x.1 0 • Matrix.single 0 0 1 +
      ∑ e : Fin n, (x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e)) • edgeGram (t.parent e) e.succ := by
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator, compartmentMatrix, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, single_mul_weight_diagonal, balanceWeight_zero]
  simp only [one_mul]
  simp_rw [edge_weighted_matrix t x ha, neg_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  abel

/-- Exact energy identity for the constructed physical matrix. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_energy {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) (z : VertexValues n) :
    z ⬝ᵥ (weightedNegativeGenerator t x *ᵥ z) = x.1 0 * (z 0)^2 +
      ∑ e : Fin n, (x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e)) * (z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2 := by
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator_decomposition t x ha, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.single_mulVec_eq, dotProduct_smul,
    dotProduct_single_one, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  · ring
  · rw [Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, edgeGram_energy]
    rfl

/-- Symmetry is derived from the actual generator and the proved weights. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_isHermitian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) : (weightedNegativeGenerator t x).IsHermitian := by
  rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm]
  change (weightedNegativeGenerator t x).transpose = weightedNegativeGenerator t x
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator_decomposition t x ha]
  simp [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_sum, Matrix.transpose_smul,
    edgeGram_transpose]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Strict positivity of the constructed physical tree energy.
Connectedness is proved from the actual parent inequalities, not assumed. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- A value constant across every edge and zero at the root vanishes everywhere. -/
theorem zero_of_tree_edge_equalities {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : VertexValues n)
    (hz0 : z 0 = 0) (hzedge : ∀ e : Fin n, z (t.parent e) = z e.succ) : z = 0 := by
  funext v
  change z v = 0
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · rwa [hv]
    · let e : Fin n := v.pred hv
      have he : e.succ = v := Fin.succ_pred v hv
      have hlt : (t.parent e).val < v.val := by
        rw [← he]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (t.parent_le e)
      rw [← he, ← hzedge e]
      exact ih (t.parent e) hlt

def groundedTreeEnergy {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ) (ell : ℝ)
    (z : VertexValues n) : ℝ := ell*(z 0)^2 + ∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2

/-- Exact strict positivity, also including the one-vertex tree. -/
theorem groundedTreeEnergy_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ) (ell : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ e, 0 < g e) (hell : 0 < ell) (z : VertexValues n) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    0 < groundedTreeEnergy t g ell z := by
  have hterms (e : Fin n) : 0 ≤ g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hg e)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => hterms e)
  have hroot : 0 ≤ ell*(z 0)^2 := mul_nonneg hell.le (sq_nonneg _)
  by_contra h
  have ht : ell*(z 0)^2 + (∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2) ≤ 0 :=
    le_of_not_gt h
  have hr0 : ell*(z 0)^2 = 0 := by linarith
  have hz0 : z 0 = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hr0).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hell))
  have hs0 : (∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2) = 0 := by linarith
  apply hz
  apply zero_of_tree_edge_equalities t z hz0
  intro e
  have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) => hterms j)
    (Finset.mem_univ e)
  rw [hs0] at hle
  have he0 := le_antisymm hle (hterms e)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp he0).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (hg e))))

/-- A positive-leak, positive-internal-rate physical tree has a positive-definite
weighted negative generator, with the weighting constructed explicitly. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_posDef {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) : (weightedNegativeGenerator t x).PosDef := by
  have hane : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0 := fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e)
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (weightedNegativeGenerator_isHermitian t x hane)
  intro z hz
  simp only [star_trivial]
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator_energy t x hane]
  exact groundedTreeEnergy_pos t (fun e => x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e))
    (x.1 0) (fun e => mul_pos (hf e) (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf _)) hell z hz

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.GroundedPositivity
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

/-! Actual positive diagonal similarity to a negative definite symmetric matrix.
The change of basis and its inverse are explicitly constructed from rates. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def sqrtWeightDiagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal (fun v => Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))

def invSqrtWeightDiagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal (fun v => (Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))⁻¹)

lemma sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = 1 := by
  rw [sqrtWeightDiagonal, invSqrtWeightDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  have hpos (v : Fin (n+1)) : 0 < Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf v)
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ne_of_gt (hpos i)]
  · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, h]

lemma invSqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_sqrt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x = 1 := by
  have h := Matrix.commute_diagonal
    (fun v : Fin (n+1) => (Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))⁻¹)
    (fun v : Fin (n+1) => Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))
  change invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x =
    sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x at h
  rw [h]
  exact sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf

lemma weight_mul_invSqrt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    Matrix.diagonal (balanceWeight t x) * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = sqrtWeightDiagonal t x := by
  rw [invSqrtWeightDiagonal, sqrtWeightDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext v
  have hs : Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf v))
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf v).le
  change balanceWeight t x v / Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v) = Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v)
  apply (div_eq_iff hs).mpr
  nlinarith [hsq]

/-- The actual congruence form whose positivity is linked to the physical generator. -/
def symmetricNegativeGenerator {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * weightedNegativeGenerator t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x

lemma invSqrtWeightDiagonal_hermitian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x)ᴴ = invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x := by
  simp [invSqrtWeightDiagonal]

/-- Positivity of the actual symmetrized negative generator. -/
theorem symmetricNegativeGenerator_posDef {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) : (symmetricNegativeGenerator t x).PosDef := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x).mulVec := by
    intro z w h
    have hh := congrArg (fun v => sqrtWeightDiagonal t x *ᵥ v) h
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf,
      Matrix.one_mulVec] using hh
  have h := (weightedNegativeGenerator_posDef t x hell ha hf).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinj
  simpa only [invSqrtWeightDiagonal_hermitian, symmetricNegativeGenerator] using h

/-- Exact similarity identity, including the explicit inverse change of basis. -/
theorem physical_negative_similarity {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    symmetricNegativeGenerator t x =
      -(invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * compartmentMatrix t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x) := by
  rw [symmetricNegativeGenerator, weightedNegativeGenerator, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, weight_mul_invSqrt t x ha hf]

/-- Actual characteristic polynomial equals that of a negative-definite symmetric
matrix. This is a proved similarity, not an assumption about real eigenvalues. -/
theorem physical_charpoly_symmetric {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    physicalCharacteristic t x = (-symmetricNegativeGenerator t x).charpoly := by
  rw [physical_negative_similarity t x ha hf, neg_neg]
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf]
  simp [physicalCharacteristic]

end HydrologyTree

import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.PosDef

/-! Strictly negative real characteristic roots for the actual positive physical
tree generator. Spectrum and positivity are derived from the constructed energy
form and the library spectral theorem, not assumed as a stability hypothesis. -/
open Matrix Polynomial Unitary
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma charpoly_neg_posDef {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (B : Matrix I I ℝ) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (-B).charpoly = ∏ i : I, (X + C (hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)) := by
  have hn : -B = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ hB.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
      (-Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues)) := by
    rw [map_neg, ← hB.isHermitian.spectral_theorem]
  rw [hn, conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp [Matrix.diagonal_neg, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Function.comp_def]

/-- Complete factorization into strictly negative real modes, with algebraic
multiplicity retained. No simplicity or absence of cancellations is claimed. -/
theorem physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization {n : ℕ}
    (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    ∃ r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = ∏ i : Fin (n+1), (X + C (r i)) := by
  have hB := symmetricNegativeGenerator_posDef t x hell ha hf
  refine ⟨hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues, fun i => hB.eigenvalues_pos i, ?_⟩
  rw [physical_charpoly_symmetric t x ha hf]
  exact charpoly_neg_posDef _ hB

/-- In particular the actual resolvent has no nonnegative real poles. -/
theorem physical_characteristic_pos_on_nonnegative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    0 < (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hP⟩ := physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization t x hell ha hf
  rw [hP, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i _
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
  exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hs (hr i)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PositiveSpectrum
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalCancellation
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Coprime.Lemmas

/-! Positive-rate hypotheses and the proved negative-real factorization pass
to every ACTUAL principal child model. No principal spectral input is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma inward_nonroot_pos {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < x.1 v := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv]
  exact ha _

lemma outward_nonroot_pos {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < outwardByVertex x.2 v := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv,outwardByVertex_succ]
  exact hf _

/-- The child's root leak is positive because it is the original exit-to-parent rate. -/
theorem positive_child_rates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    0 < (childRates t c x).1 0 ∧
      (∀ e : Fin (childEdgeCount t c), 0 < (childRates t c x).1 e.succ) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin (childEdgeCount t c), 0 < (childRates t c x).2 e) := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [childRates_leak]
    exact inward_nonroot_pos x ha c.val c.property.1
  · intro e
    exact inward_nonroot_pos x ha (childEnumeration t c e.succ).val
      (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))
  · intro e
    exact outward_nonroot_pos x hf (childEnumeration t c e.succ).val
      (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))

lemma coprime_linear_of_ne (a b : ℝ) (h : a ≠ b) : IsCoprime (X+C a) (X+C b) := by
  have hn : a-b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  refine ⟨C ((a-b)⁻¹), -C ((a-b)⁻¹), ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = C ((a-b)⁻¹) * C (a-b) := by rw [map_sub]; ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [← map_mul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hn,map_one]

/-- For completely real factorizations, absence of actual common real roots
proves polynomial coprimality; algebraic closure is not silently invoked. -/
theorem linear_factorizations_coprime {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (r : I → ℝ) (q : J → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℝ, (∏ i : I, (X+C (r i))).eval z = 0 →
      (∏ j : J, (X+C (q j))).eval z ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (∏ i : I, (X+C (r i))) (∏ j : J, (X+C (q j))) := by
  classical
  apply IsCoprime.prod_left
  intro i _
  apply IsCoprime.prod_right
  intro j _
  apply coprime_linear_of_ne
  intro hij
  have hp : (∏ k : I, (X+C (r k))).eval (-r i) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp
  have hq : (∏ k : J, (X+C (q k))).eval (-r i) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j)
    simp [hij]
  exact h (-r i) hp hq

/-- Actual sibling polynomials are coprime whenever their real principal
spectra are disjoint, for positive physical internal rates. -/
theorem positive_child_characteristics_coprime {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (c d : RootChild t)
    (h : ∀ z : ℝ, (childCharacteristic t x c).eval z = 0 →
      (childCharacteristic t x d).eval z ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d) := by
  have hc := positive_child_rates t x c ha hf
  have hd := positive_child_rates t x d ha hf
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hP⟩ := physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization
    (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hQ⟩ := physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization
    (childTree t d) (childRates t d x) hd.1 hd.2.1 hd.2.2
  change IsCoprime (physicalCharacteristic _ _) (physicalCharacteristic _ _)
  rw [hP,hQ]
  apply linear_factorizations_coprime
  intro z hp hq
  apply h z
  · change (physicalCharacteristic _ _).eval z = 0
    rwa [hP]
  · change (physicalCharacteristic _ _).eval z = 0
    rwa [hQ]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact nonpole resolvent expansion of a positive definite real symmetric
matrix, with nonnegative spectral weights summing to one. -/
open Matrix Polynomial Unitary
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

lemma unitary_conjugation_scalar (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.scalar I s) = Matrix.scalar I s := by
  exact (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U).toAlgEquiv.commutes s

lemma conjugation_diagonal_entry (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (d : I → ℝ) (o : I) :
    (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal d)) o o = ∑ i : I, (U o i)^2 * d i := by
  rw [conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.star_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial]
  ring

/-- The normalization of the observable spectral weights follows from unitarity. -/
lemma unitary_row_squares_sum (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (o : I) :
    (∑ i : I, (U o i)^2) = 1 := by
  have h := conjugation_diagonal_entry U (fun _ => 1) o
  simpa using h.symm

lemma inverse_diagonal_explicit (d : I → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.diagonal d * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹) = (1 : Matrix I I ℝ) := by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hd]
  · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, h]

/-- True resolvent inverse on the exact nonpole domain. -/
theorem conjugated_diagonal_resolvent (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (r : I → ℝ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s + r i ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.scalar I s + conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal r)) *
      conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (s+r i)⁻¹)) = 1 := by
  have he : Matrix.scalar I s + conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal r) =
      conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => s+r i)) := by
    rw [← unitary_conjugation_scalar U s, ← map_add]
    congr 1
    rw [Matrix.scalar_apply, ← Matrix.diagonal_add]
  rw [he, ← map_mul, inverse_diagonal_explicit _ hs, map_one]

/-- Nonnegative unit-mass weights for the actual root inverse of any positive
definite matrix. Coincident eigenvalues and zero observation weights are retained. -/
theorem posDef_resolvent_representation (B : Matrix I I ℝ) (hB : B.PosDef) (o : I) :
    ∃ r w : I → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧
      (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
      (-B).charpoly = ∏ i, (X+C (r i)) ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ i, s + r i ≠ 0) →
        (Matrix.scalar I s + B)⁻¹ o o = ∑ i, w i / (s+r i) := by
  let U := hB.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let r := hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  refine ⟨r, fun i => (U o i)^2, hB.eigenvalues_pos, fun i => sq_nonneg _,
    unitary_row_squares_sum U o, charpoly_neg_posDef B hB, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have hspec : B = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal r) := by
    simpa only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, Function.id_comp] using hB.isHermitian.spectral_theorem
  have hi := conjugated_diagonal_resolvent U r s hs
  rw [← hspec] at hi
  rw [Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hi, conjugation_diagonal_entry]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm

end HydrologyTree

/-! The actual positive-rate physical tree has a normalized finite Stieltjes
root resolvent. Every weight and spectral mode comes from the proved diagonal
similarity. No observational/spectral representation is supplied as an axiom. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma similarity_inverse {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (D E A : Matrix I I ℝ) (hDE : D*E = 1) (hED : E*D = 1)
    (hA : IsUnit A.det) : (D*A*E)⁻¹ = D*A⁻¹*E := by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  calc
    (D*A*E)*(D*A⁻¹*E) = D*(A*(E*D)*A⁻¹)*E := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hED, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hA, Matrix.mul_one, hDE]

lemma scalar_matrix_eq_smul_one {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (s : ℝ) :
    Matrix.scalar I s = s • (1 : Matrix I I ℝ) := by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, h]

/-- The same fixed diagonal change of variables transports the entire resolvent pencil. -/
theorem physical_scalar_similarity {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) (s : ℝ) :
    sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s + symmetricNegativeGenerator t x) *
        invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - compartmentMatrix t x := by
  rw [scalar_matrix_eq_smul_one, physical_negative_similarity t x ha hf]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul]
  have hh : sqrtWeightDiagonal t x *
      (invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * compartmentMatrix t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x) *
        invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = compartmentMatrix t x := by
    calc
      _ = (sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x) * compartmentMatrix t x *
          (sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf]; simp
  rw [hh, sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf]
  rfl

/-- The root entry is unchanged because the constructed root balance weight is 1. -/
theorem physical_root_resolvent_transport {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0) :
    physicalRootResponse t x s =
      (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s + symmetricNegativeGenerator t x)⁻¹ 0 0 := by
  have hA : IsUnit (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s + symmetricNegativeGenerator t x).det := by
    rw [← sub_neg_eq_add, ← Matrix.eval_charpoly, ← physical_charpoly_symmetric t x ha hf,
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    exact hs
  unfold physicalRootResponse
  rw [← physical_scalar_similarity t x ha hf s,
    similarity_inverse _ _ _ (sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf)
      (invSqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_sqrt t x ha hf) hA]
  simp [sqrtWeightDiagonal, invSqrtWeightDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]

/-- Actual physical roots and normalized observation weights. Hidden modes may
have zero weights; repeated characteristic roots are NOT silently ruled out. -/
theorem physical_finite_stieltjes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    ∃ r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧
      (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = ∏ i, (X + C (r i)) ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) →
        physicalRootResponse t x s = ∑ i, w i / (s+r i) := by
  have hB := symmetricNegativeGenerator_posDef t x hell ha hf
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,hR⟩ := posDef_resolvent_representation _ hB (0 : Fin (n+1))
  have hphys : physicalCharacteristic t x = ∏ i, (X+C (r i)) :=
    (physical_charpoly_symmetric t x ha hf).trans hP
  refine ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hphys,?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have hne : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hphys, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i _
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C] using hs i
  rw [physical_root_resolvent_transport t x ha hf s hne]
  exact hR s hs

import HydrologyTree.PhysicalStieltjes
import HydrologyTree.EdgeCharacteristic

/-! Exact numerator reconstruction and noncancellation criterion for finite
Stieltjes representations. Coincident rates and zero weights are kept until
noncancellation is proved; they are not silently removed by the definitions. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

def stieltjesDenominator (r : I → ℝ) : ℝ[X] := ∏ i : I, (X+C (r i))
def stieltjesNumerator (r w : I → ℝ) : ℝ[X] :=
  ∑ i : I, C (w i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r j))

lemma stieltjesDenominator_monic (r : I → ℝ) : (stieltjesDenominator r).Monic :=
  Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (r i))

@[simp] lemma eval_stieltjesDenominator (r : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s = ∏ i : I, (s+r i) := by
  simp [stieltjesDenominator, Polynomial.eval_prod]

@[simp] lemma eval_stieltjesNumerator (r w : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval s =
      ∑ i : I, w i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s+r j) := by
  simp [stieltjesNumerator, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_prod]

lemma stieltjes_sum_mul_denominator (r w : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : I, w i/(s+r i)) * (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s =
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval s := by
  rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator, eval_stieltjesNumerator, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j : I => s+r j) (Finset.mem_univ i),
    ← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hs i)]

/-- Equality of actual rational functions off their poles fixes the complete
unreduced numerator, even when some pole factors later cancel. -/
theorem polynomial_stieltjes_recovery (F : ℝ[X]) (r w : I → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) →
      F.eval s/(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s = ∑ i : I, w i/(s+r i)) :
    F = stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots _ (stieltjesDenominator_monic r).ne_zero).mono
  intro s hs
  have hp : (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s ≠ 0 := hs
  have hi : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff] at hp
    exact fun i => hp i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have he := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z*(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s) (h s hi)
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp, stieltjes_sum_mul_denominator r w s hi] at he
  exact he

@[simp] lemma stieltjesDenominator_eval_pole (r : I → ℝ) (i : I) :
    (stieltjesDenominator r).eval (-r i) = 0 := by
  rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by ring)

/-- Exact numerator value at a pole; valid even when other rates coincide. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole (r w : I → ℝ) (i : I) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i) =
      w i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (r j-r i) := by
  rw [eval_stieltjesNumerator, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  · intro j _ hji
    have hi : i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j := by simp [Ne.symm hji]
    have hz : (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (-r i+r k)) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero hi (by ring)
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · simp

/-- Absence of cancellation forces distinct poles and nonzero observation weights. -/
theorem stieltjes_noncancellation_forces_modes (r w : I → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℝ, (stieltjesDenominator r).eval z = 0 →
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval z ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective r ∧ ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 := by
  have hm (i : I) : w i * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (r j-r i)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole] using h (-r i) (stieltjesDenominator_eval_pole r i)
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    have hj : j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i := by simp [Ne.symm hne]
    have hz : (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (r k-r i)) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero hj (sub_eq_zero.mpr hij.symm)
    exact hm i (by rw [hz, mul_zero])
  · intro i
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul (hm i)

/-- Distinct poles with nonzero observation weights also rule out every common
root; with nonnegative weights this is equivalent to every weight being positive. -/
theorem stieltjes_modes_force_noncancellation (r w : I → ℝ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0) :
    ∀ z : ℝ, (stieltjesDenominator r).eval z = 0 →
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval z ≠ 0 := by
  intro z hz
  rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at hz
  obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := hz
  have he : z = -r i := by linarith
  rw [he, stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole]
  apply mul_ne_zero (hw i)
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hji
  exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1 (hr hji)

/-- The actual unreduced cofactor has the complete positive-tree spectral
numerator formula, not just a fitted response or selected pole values. -/
theorem physical_stieltjes_polynomials {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    ∃ r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i)=1 ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator r ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,hR⟩ := physical_finite_stieltjes t x hell ha hf
  refine ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,?_⟩
  apply polynomial_stieltjes_recovery
  intro s hs
  have h := hR s hs
  rw [physicalRootResponse_eq, hP] at h
  exact h

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.StieltjesNumerator
import HydrologyTree.TreeCancellation

/-! Full positive-mode classification in terms of the original tree's actual
sibling principal spectra. This is not a substitute for the still separate
coefficient-Jacobian singularity or ODE controllability statements. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- No pole cancellation in the actual unreduced physical polynomials. -/
def NoRealPhysicalCancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  ∀ z : ℝ, (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval z = 0 →
    (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval z ≠ 0

lemma physicalCommonRoot_real {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : ℝ) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔
      (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval z = 0 ∧ (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval z = 0 := by
  simp [PhysicalCommonRoot, Polynomial.aeval_def]

/-- The common-root theorem now gives a noncancellation statement on actual
real principal spectra, without any assumed stability or minimality bridge. -/
theorem noCancellation_iff_noSiblingCollision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) :
    NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x ↔ ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  constructor
  · intro h z hz
    have hh := (physicalCommonRoot_real t x z).mp
      ((physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mpr hz)
    exact h z hh.2 hh.1
  · intro h z hp hf
    apply h z
    apply (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mp
    exact (physicalCommonRoot_real t x z).mpr ⟨hf,hp⟩

/-- The exact full-size Stieltjes class: all n+1 distinct poles have strictly
positive weights; BOTH unreduced polynomials must equal the displayed formulas. -/
def FullPositiveModes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  ∃ r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ Function.Injective r ∧
    (∀ i, 0 < w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i)=1 ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator r ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator r w

/-- Positive physical parameters plus noncancellation give the full simple
positive-mode class, rather than assuming simple poles or positive residues. -/
theorem fullPositiveModes_of_noncancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (h : NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x) : FullPositiveModes t x := by
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,hF⟩ := physical_stieltjes_polynomials t x hell ha hf
  have hnc : ∀ z : ℝ, (stieltjesDenominator r).eval z = 0 →
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [← hP] at hz
    rw [← hF]
    exact h z hz
  obtain ⟨hinj,hwn⟩ := stieltjes_noncancellation_forces_modes r w hnc
  exact ⟨r,w,hr,hinj,fun i => lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i) (Ne.symm (hwn i)),hm,hP,hF⟩

/-- Full-size positive modes rule out actual common roots, with no regularity
assumption on a coefficient Jacobian. -/
theorem fullPositiveModes_noncancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (h : FullPositiveModes t x) : NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x := by
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hinj,hw,hm,hP,hF⟩ := h
  intro z hz
  rw [hP] at hz
  rw [hF]
  exact stieltjes_modes_force_noncancellation r w hinj (fun i => ne_of_gt (hw i)) z hz

/-- Complete all-size positive-mode/collision equivalence for the ACTUAL tree.
Repeated poles or invisible modes occur precisely when a sibling spectral
collision occurs somewhere in the original tree. -/
theorem physical_full_modes_iff_no_sibling_collisions {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    FullPositiveModes t x ↔ ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  have hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x := ⟨fun i => ne_of_gt (ha i), fun i => ne_of_gt (hf i)⟩
  rw [← noCancellation_iff_noSiblingCollision t x hx]
  exact ⟨fullPositiveModes_noncancellation t x,
    fullPositiveModes_of_noncancellation t x hell ha hf⟩

end HydrologyTree

/-! Global uniqueness per prescribed subtree-denominator assignment for actual
positive-rate trees without spectral cancellations. Assignment existence and
complete assignment/fiber enumeration are NOT supplied as hypotheses or claimed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Positivity and the actual no-collision criterion prove the recursively
coprime denominators needed by exact constructive branch recovery. -/
theorem coprime_branches_of_no_spectral_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (hno : ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) : CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [CoprimeAtEveryBranch]
    constructor
    · intro c d hcd
      apply positive_child_characteristics_coprime t x ha hf c d
      intro z hc hd
      apply hno z
      rw [SiblingCollisionSomewhere]
      left
      refine ⟨c,d,hcd,?_,?_⟩
      · simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def] using hc
      · simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def] using hd
    · intro c
      have hc := positive_child_rates t x c ha hf
      apply ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
        (childRates t c x) hc.2.1 hc.2.2
      intro z hz
      apply hno z
      rw [SiblingCollisionSomewhere]
      exact Or.inr ⟨c,hz⟩

/-- At most one real realization corresponds to a prescribed recursive
characteristic-factor assignment of a positive noncancelling reference tree.
All child-rate recoveries and the final original-rate permutation are proved. -/
theorem positive_subtree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (hno : ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z)
    (hassign : SameSubtreeCharacteristics t x y) : x = y := by
  exact physical_subtree_assignment_unique t x y
    ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e), fun e => ne_of_gt (hf e)⟩
    (coprime_branches_of_no_spectral_collision t x ha hf hno) hassign

/-- The complete positive-mode hypothesis can be used instead of a no-collision
hypothesis; the actual equivalence was proved from physical energy and spectra. -/
theorem full_modes_subtree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (hm : FullPositiveModes t x) (hassign : SameSubtreeCharacteristics t x y) : x = y := by
  exact positive_subtree_assignment_unique t x y ha hf
    ((physical_full_modes_iff_no_sibling_collisions t x hell ha hf).mp hm) hassign

end HydrologyTree

/-! Actual coefficient-Jacobian / spectral equivalences for positive physical
trees. No controllability, ODE identification or global fiber-count claim is
made without its corresponding theorem. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Positive physical edges: regularity of the full actual coefficient Jacobian
is exactly absence of sibling spectral collisions anywhere in the real tree. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  have hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x := ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e),fun e => ne_of_gt (hf e)⟩
  rw [treeJacobian_ne_zero_iff_coprime t x hx]
  exact ⟨coprime_branches_no_sibling_collisions t x,
    coprime_branches_of_no_spectral_collision t x ha hf⟩

/-- A positive-rate reference is singular exactly when an actual sibling
spectral collision exists; no unproved observability premise is present. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_zero_iff_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x = 0 ↔ ∃ z : ℝ, SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  classical
  have h := positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision t x ha hf
  constructor
  · intro hj
    by_contra hn
    exact (h.mpr (by simpa only [not_exists] using hn)) hj
  · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
    by_contra hj
    exact (h.mp hj) z hz

/-- Equality is for the original unreduced polynomials of the real physical
matrix; this does not silently replace them with a cancelled transfer fraction. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_cancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ↔ NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x := by
  have hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x := ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e),fun e => ne_of_gt (hf e)⟩
  rw [positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision t x ha hf,
    noCancellation_iff_noSiblingCollision t x hx]

/-- With a positive root leak, full distinct positive-weight Stieltjes modes
are equivalent to nonsingularity of the ACTUAL coefficient Jacobian. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_iff_full_modes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ↔ FullPositiveModes t x := by
  rw [positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision t x ha hf,
    physical_full_modes_iff_no_sibling_collisions t x hell ha hf]

/-- For each prescribed recursive subtree factor assignment, a regular
nonzero-edge real reference admits at most one real rate realization. This
is not uniqueness from the root response without specifying the assignment. -/
theorem regular_tree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (hJ : treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0)
    (hassign : SameSubtreeCharacteristics t x y) : x = y := by
  exact physical_subtree_assignment_unique t x y hx
    ((treeJacobian_ne_zero_iff_coprime t x hx).mp hJ) hassign

end HydrologyTree

/-! A uniform boundary construction: set all outward rates to zero. The actual
matrix becomes triangular, and injective inward rates give disjoint sibling
spectra throughout every finite tree. Positivity is deliberately not assumed. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma outward_zero_function (n : ℕ) : outwardByVertex (0 : EdgeValues n) = 0 := by
  funext v
  exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) v

lemma zero_outward_upper_triangular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (a : VertexValues n) :
    (compartmentMatrix t (a,0)).IsUpperTriangular := by
  intro i j hji
  have hij : i ≠ j := ne_of_gt (show j < i from hji)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula t (a,0) i j hij]
  have hparent : j ≠ 0 → parentVertex t j ≠ i := by
    intro hj hp
    have hlt := parentVertex_lt t j hj
    rw [hp] at hlt
    have hji' : j.val < i.val := hji
    omega
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · simp [hj,outward_zero_function]
  · simp [hj,hparent hj,outward_zero_function]

/-- Exact factorization of the true characteristic polynomial on the entire
zero-outward-rate subspace, including arbitrary repeated and zero inward rates. -/
theorem zero_outward_characteristic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (a : VertexValues n) :
    physicalCharacteristic t (a,0) = ∏ v : Fin (n+1), (X+C (a v)) := by
  rw [physicalCharacteristic,Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ (zero_outward_upper_triangular t a)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro v _
  rw [compartment_diagonal]
  simp [rateChart]

lemma childRates_zero_outward {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (a : VertexValues n) :
    childRates t c (a,0) = ((fun i => a (childEnumeration t c i).val),0) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · funext i
    simp [childRates,outward_zero_function]

lemma child_enumerations_distinct {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c d : RootChild t) (hcd : c ≠ d)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) (j : Fin (childEdgeCount t d+1)) :
    (childEnumeration t c i).val ≠ (childEnumeration t d j).val := by
  intro h
  apply hcd
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hb := congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h
  rw [(childEnumeration t c i).property,(childEnumeration t d j).property] at hb
  exact hb

/-- Disjoint actual child-vertex sets and injective inward rates give coprime
child characteristic polynomials, even though every outward rate is zero. -/
theorem zero_outward_coprime_siblings {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (a : VertexValues n)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (c d : RootChild t) (hcd : c ≠ d) :
    IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t (a,0) c) (childCharacteristic t (a,0) d) := by
  change IsCoprime (physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c (a,0)))
    (physicalCharacteristic (childTree t d) (childRates t d (a,0)))
  rw [childRates_zero_outward,childRates_zero_outward,zero_outward_characteristic,zero_outward_characteristic]
  apply IsCoprime.prod_left
  intro i _
  apply IsCoprime.prod_right
  intro j _
  apply coprime_linear_of_ne
  exact fun h => child_enumerations_distinct t c d hcd i j (ha h)

/-- The construction works recursively at every original vertex, not merely
at the observed root. It is a universal exact boundary witness, not a finite test. -/
theorem zero_outward_coprime_everywhere {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (a : VertexValues n)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) : CoprimeAtEveryBranch t (a,0) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [CoprimeAtEveryBranch]
    refine ⟨zero_outward_coprime_siblings t a ha,?_⟩
    intro c
    rw [childRates_zero_outward]
    exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
      (fun i => a (childEnumeration t c i).val) (ha.comp (childEnumeration_injective t c))

/-- An explicit injective real assignment vanishing at any specified vertex. -/
def separatingInward {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n+1)) : VertexValues n :=
  fun v => (v.val : ℝ) - (j.val : ℝ)

lemma separatingInward_injective {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n+1)) : Function.Injective (separatingInward j) := by
  intro u v h
  have hc : (u.val : ℝ) = (v.val : ℝ) := sub_right_injective h
  apply Fin.ext
  exact_mod_cast hc

@[simp] lemma separatingInward_self {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n+1)) : separatingInward j j = 0 := sub_self _

theorem zero_coordinate_coprime_witness {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (j : Fin (n+1)) :
    (separatingInward j) j = 0 ∧ CoprimeAtEveryBranch t (separatingInward j,0) :=
  ⟨separatingInward_self j,zero_outward_coprime_everywhere t _ (separatingInward_injective j)⟩

end HydrologyTree
